title: $\lambda$ jest proizvoljno
isv: Proizvoljno označaje, že λ ne jest ograničeno osobnym izborom. Zapis se opira na obyčno matematično vyraženje v ruskom i ukrajinskom i na doslědnost s upotrěbljenjem v oddělu 18. To jest razlog registra i doslědnosti, ne čisleno sravnjenje vseh slovjanskyh jezykov.
en: Proizvoljno expresses that λ is arbitrary. The recorded reasons are ordinary Russian and Ukrainian mathematical usage and consistency with Section 18. This is a register-and-consistency argument, not a numerical comparison across all Slavic languages.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use standard arbitrary-parameter language. Interslavic proizvoljno continues the more formal mathematical-register choice from Section 18.

title: $\Omega$-proces
isv: Symbol $\Omega$ ostavaje čestju nazvanja operacije. Arhivny razlog izrično daje prědnost čuvanju Noetherinoj oznaki pred opisnym prěimenovanjem operatora. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože čuvajut grčku bukvu, s prilagodjenym slovom proces. V rabotě 2, §1, normalna forma opisana jest uslovjem, že $\Omega$-proces po ukazanyh parah proměnnyh davaje nulu. Nazvanje zato nosi konkretnu ulogu v oprěděljenju, a ne samo ukrašajuču simboliku. Sama bukva ne dokazuje svezu s vsakoj drugoju $\Omega$ v korpusu: v rabotě 34 ona, na priměr, označaje oblast operatorov. To sut različne ulohy iste oznaki, ne jeden termin za avtomatično objedinjenje.
en: The symbol $\Omega$ remains part of the operation's name. The recorded reason explicitly prefers preserving Noether's notation to replacing the operator name with a descriptive paraphrase. Russian and Ukrainian likewise retain the Greek letter with adapted forms of process. In Paper 2, §1, normal form is characterized by the $\Omega$-process giving zero for specified pairs of variables. The name therefore has a concrete defining role rather than decorative symbolism. The letter alone does not establish a connection with every other $\Omega$ in the corpus: in Paper 34 it denotes an operator domain, for example. These are different roles of the same symbol, not one term to merge automatically.

comparisons.text: V rabotě 2, §1, priměna $\Omega$-procesa k ukazanym proměnnym poničuje normalnu formu. Zachovanje symbola daje neposrědnu svezu s tym kriterijem. To ne jest ista uloga $\Omega$, ktora v rabotě 34 imenuje množstvo operatorov; sovpadanje bukvy ne jest terminologičnym dokazom.
comparisons.english: In Paper 2, §1, applying the $\Omega$-process to the specified variables annihilates a normal form. Preserving the symbol keeps a direct link to that criterion. This is not the role of $\Omega$ naming a collection of operators in Paper 34; sharing a letter is not terminological evidence.

passages.quote: V prvom slučaju govorimo o kontrakciji formy $S$ s formoju $T$, v drugom slučaju o «kontrakciji formy $A$ samej so soboju». Dlja kratkosti v slědujučem vsegda prědpokladamo (to v istině jest slučaj pri vsih pozdněje razgledanyh formah), že
s_\sigma^\lambda=0,\qquad t_\tau^\chi=0

za vsake $\lambda$ i $\chi$, različne od nule, i zajedno s kakymikoli drugymi kontrakcijami. To govori, že forma $s_x^m t_y^n u_\sigma^\mu u_\tau^\nu$ jest tak nazyvana «normalna forma», to jest pri priměnjenju $\Omega$-procesa ona izčezaje i po prěměnnyh $x$ i $u$, i po prěměnnyh $y$ i $v$.
Uslovje (a) zato ne jest ograničenje; jego možno vsegda dosegnuti.\footnote{Srav. Gordan, \emph{Math. Annalen}, tom V, s. 104.}

original_reasons.text: Keep Noether's symbolic name; do not paraphrase the operator.

title: $n$-e korenje iz jedinice
isv: Korenje iz jedinice jest prěmy algebraičny izraz. Zapis upotrěbjaje poznate sostavne slova i ne vidi potrěbu tvoriti osobny novy termin. Čislo n ostavaje čestju matematičnogo opreděljenja; zapis sam ne dokazuje, že vsaka padežna forma jest normativno prověrena.
en: The proposal uses the familiar algebraic expression for roots of unity rather than coining a separate term. The index n remains part of the mathematical specification. The short original reason does not establish that every inflected form has been independently checked.

original_reasons.text: Literal standard algebraic term; no need for an artificial calque.

title: (p)^alpha abo jediničny ideal
isv: Izraz zachovuje dvě alternativy: stepen lokalnogo prostogo generatora i jediničny ideal. Razlog se odnosi na tų matematičnu razliku. Sam zapis ne dava nezavisnogo opravdanja za veznik abo; on zato ne dostaje za rekomendaciju vsej historijnoj formy.
en: The reason preserves the dichotomy between a power of the local prime generator and the unit ideal. It concerns that mathematical distinction. It does not independently justify the conjunction abo, so the record alone cannot recommend the entire historical wording.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the dichotomy between the power of the local prime generator and the unit ideal.

title: -1 kako suma dvoh kvadratov
isv: Vyraženje jest kriterij, ktory se pojavjaje v oběh napravjenjah dokaza. Zato -1, čislo dva i kvadraty morajut ostati jasno razpoznajeme. Razlog podpira semantičnu doslědnost; padežna forma dvoh trěbuje samostojnu gramatičnu prověrku.
en: The phrase states the criterion used in both directions of the proof. The value -1, the number two, and the squares must remain identifiable. The reason supports semantic consistency; the inflected form dvoh requires a separate grammatical assessment.

original_reasons.text: This is the criterion phrase and must stay recognizable across the two proof directions.

title: -ajut i -aju: kto jest subjekt?
isv: Tretje lice množiny ima koncovky -ut/-et, pri kontrakciji -ajut. Prvo lice jedinstvenogo čisla može završati se na -aju. Zato dodavanje t potrěbuje subjekt ili odnosnu predhodnu frazu: avtorovo vybiraju, naměrjaju, podaju, pripominaju ili dodaju ne jest množinna ošibka. Imennye formy slučaju i algebraju takože ne sut glagoly. Zapis odlišaje 107 množinnyh predikatov od peti avtorskyh jedinstvenyh i od imennogo materijala. Kogda subjekt jest koordinovany, padežna forma slova okolo glagola sama ne dostava za opreděljenje broja. Pravilo popravjaje soglasje, čuvajuči korenj, aspekt, originalnu notaciju i avtorsku perspektivu. To jest kontekstna gramatika, ne zaměna vsakej koncovky -aju.
en: Third-person plurals end in -ut/-et, or contracted -ajut; first-person singulars can end in -aju. Adding t therefore requires the subject or relative antecedent: the author's vybiraju, naměrjaju, podaju, pripominaju or dodaju are not plural errors. Nominal slučaju and algebraju are not verbs either. The record distinguishes 107 plural predicates from five authorial singulars and from nominal material. With a coordinated subject, the case of a nearby word alone is insufficient to determine number. The rule repairs agreement while retaining stem, aspect, original notation and authorial perspective. This is contextual grammar, not substitution of every -aju ending.
sources_isv: Gramatika, Glagoly, prezentne koncovky i kontrakcija.
sources_en: Grammar, Verbs, present endings and contraction.

evidence.finding: Third-person plurals end in -ut/-et, or contracted -ajut; first-person singulars can end in -aju. Adding t therefore requires the subject or relative antecedent: the author's vybiraju, naměrjaju, podaju, pripominaju or dodaju are not plural errors. Nominal slučaju and algebraju are not verbs either. The record distinguishes 107 plural predicates from five authorial singulars and from nominal material. With a coordinated subject, the case of a nearby word alone is insufficient to determine number. The rule repairs agreement while retaining stem, aspect, original notation and authorial perspective. This is contextual grammar, not substitution of every -aju ending.

title: -yh v pridavnikah, zaimenah i participah
isv: Osemdeset pojavjenij v dvadeseti formah slěduje tvrdemu genitivu/lokativu množiny. Sravnenja vključajut drugih → drugyh, ktorih → ktoryh, prvih → prvyh, takih → takyh i vzętih → vzętyh. Drugy/prvy sut porědkove čislovniky s pridavnikovym sklonjenjem; ktory jest pridavnikovo zaimeno; vzęty jest pasivny particip. Jednaka koncovka zato ne znači jednaku leksičnu kategoriju. Mekke pridavniky, osobne zaimena, někoj- i oddělne čislovnične paradigmy ostajut izvan pravila. Polna tablica vseh 20 par ostaje v sravnitelnyh dannyh, aby priměry ne zaměnili obseg.
en: Eighty occurrences across twenty forms follow hard-stem genitive/locative plural inflection. Examples include drugih → drugyh, ktorih → ktoryh, prvih → prvyh, takih → takyh and vzętih → vzętyh. Drugy/prvy are adjectivally declined ordinals; ktory is an adjectival determiner; vzęty is a passive participle. A shared ending therefore does not imply one lexical category. Soft adjectives, personal pronouns, někoj- and distinct numeral paradigms remain outside the rule. The full twenty-pair mapping is retained in the comparison data so the examples do not substitute for coverage.
sources_isv: Gramatika, Pridavniky; Čislovniky, porědkove; Zaimena, ktory/kaky; Glagoly, particip na -ty.
sources_en: Grammar, Adjectives; Numerals, ordinals; Pronouns, ktory/kaky; Verbs, participles in -ty.

evidence.finding: Eighty occurrences across twenty forms follow hard-stem genitive/locative plural inflection. Examples include drugih → drugyh, ktorih → ktoryh, prvih → prvyh, takih → takyh and vzętih → vzętyh. Drugy/prvy are adjectivally declined ordinals; ktory is an adjectival determiner; vzęty is a passive participle. A shared ending therefore does not imply one lexical category. Soft adjectives, personal pronouns, někoj- and distinct numeral paradigms remain outside the rule. The full twenty-pair mapping is retained in the comparison data so the examples do not substitute for coverage.

title: 11. poręd / 12. poręd / 13. poręd / 15. poręd
isv: Kratke podzaglavja zachovujut numeričny poręd izloženja. Poręd byl prědložen radi kratkosti, ale sam izvorny zapis ostavjaje otvorjeno sravnjenje s poręda i s vyraženjem čisla slovom. Historijna kandidatna forma zato ne znači zaključen normativny izbor.
en: The short subsection labels preserve the enumeration. Poręd was proposed for compactness, but the record expressly leaves comparison with poręda and a written-out ordinal unresolved. The historical proposal is not a settled normative recommendation.

original_reasons.text: Short subsection labels preserve the enumerative structure. Interslavic poręd is compact but must be authority-reviewed against poręda or an ordinal-word form.

title: 117 form
isv: Čislo 117 jest čestju matematičnogo zaključka, ne redakcijna ocěna. Prěvod zachovuje točno čislo i predmet brojanja, formy. Zapis objasnjaje věrnost zaključku, ne novo tvorjenje terminologije.
en: The number 117 belongs to the mathematical conclusion, not to an editorial estimate. The translation preserves the exact count and the objects counted, forms. The reason concerns fidelity rather than a newly coined term.

original_reasons.text: Numeral and count preserved exactly as source conclusion evidence.

title: 30. marca 1926.
isv: Nazvanje měsęca jest prěvedeno, a denj i godina ostavajut neizměnjene. Medžuslovjanska forma upotrěbjaje poręd denj–měsęc–godina; rusky i ukrajinsky zapisy imajut svoje obyčne kratke oznaky godiny. Zapis neopravdava směnu samogo datuma.
en: The month name is localized while the day and year remain unchanged. The Interslavic proposal uses day–month–year order; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use their ordinary year abbreviations. Nothing in the decision licenses a change to the date itself.

original_reasons.text: Month names are localized rather than leaving the German März; abbreviations for Ukrainian/Russian year markers follow ordinary scholarly-date conventions, while Interslavic keeps a simple day-month-year form.

title: 5./6./... poręd
isv: Terminom poręd se zachovuje nazvanje reda upotrěbljeno pri invariantah v drugom dělu. Izvorny zapis podpira doslědnost, ale izrično ostavjaje ortografiju za jezyčnu prověrku. Skračenje s tri točkami jest zapis skupiny zaglavij, ne zaměna za vsako polno zaglavje.
en: Poręd continues the invariant-order vocabulary used in Paper 2. The reason is consistency, with orthography explicitly left for linguistic assessment. The ellipsis summarizes a group of headings; it is not a substitute for their complete text.

original_reasons.text: Order vocabulary follows the established invariant-order lane. Interslavic poręd is transparent and already present in earlier Paper 02 logs; orthography remains authority-review-visible.

title: \D
isv: Komanda \D označaje isti matematičny znak kako \mathfrak D. Opreděljenje komandy omogožnjaje nabrati znak bez změny njegova značenja. Tuto jest pravilo matematičnogo zapisa, ne slovnično zaglavno slovo.
en: The command \D denotes the same mathematical sign as \mathfrak D. Defining the command supplies the typesetting instruction without changing the sign's meaning. This is a notation convention, not a dictionary headword.

original_reasons.text: The standalone section defines \D as \mathfrak D for compilability while preserving the source's notation.

title: \mathrm{A)}, \mathrm{B)}, \mathrm{C)}
isv: \mathrm{A)}, \mathrm{B)} i \mathrm{C)} nabirajut strukturne oznaky kako nepreměnjenu matematičnu latinicu. Cělj jest odlišiti oznaku od jezyčnogo teksta i zachovati upučivanja. To jest redakcijna konvencija, ne novy leksičny termin.
en: The commands \mathrm{A)}, \mathrm{B)}, and \mathrm{C)} typeset structural labels in upright mathematical Latin. The purpose is to distinguish identifiers from prose and preserve references. This is an editorial convention rather than a lexical innovation.

original_reasons.text: The Interslavic Latin source protects display labels as math roman so the Cyrillic reader variant does not convert C) into Ц). This is a production rule for structural labels, not a lexical translation choice.

title: \pmod{(\sigma,s)}
isv: \pmod{(\sigma,s)} jest tipografsko vyraženje istogo uslovja kongruencije kako iztočna komanda \modu{(\sigma,s)}. σ i s ostavajut točne matematične oznaky. Sadržina skobok ne podleži prěpisivanju v drugy alfabet.
en: The standard command \pmod{(\sigma,s)} expresses the same congruence condition as the source-specific \modu{(\sigma,s)}. The identifiers σ and s are preserved exactly. The parenthesized mathematical content is not transliterated.

original_reasons.text: Target TeX renders the source modulus macro as standard \pmod while preserving mathematical intent; Cyrillic generation protects the argument as math.

title: \pmod{(\varrho,t)}
isv: \pmod{(\varrho,t)} zachovuje matematičny uslov iztočnoj komandy \modu{(\varrho,t)}. Izbor se odnosi na nabirku, ne na proměnu kongruencije; ϱ i t ostavajut iste oznaky v oběh alfabeth.
en: The standard command \pmod{(\varrho,t)} preserves the condition expressed by \modu{(\varrho,t)}. The choice concerns typesetting, not a change to the congruence. The identifiers ϱ and t remain the same in both scripts.

original_reasons.text: Target TeX renders the local source macro as standard \pmod while preserving mathematical intent; Cyrillic generation protects the argument as math.

title: a jest děljiva črez t / ideal a, kratny od t
source: a ist teilbar durch t / Vielfaches a von t
russian: a делится на t / идеал a, кратный t
ukrainian: a ділиться на t / ідеал a, кратний t
isv: V glavnom tekstu prěvod izrično govori o děljivosti; v podčrtnoj primětce upotrěbjaje smysl kratnogo objekta. Taka razlika slijedi različna vyraženja iztočnika i ne zaměnjaje jih novym abstraktnym pojmom teorije idealov. Historijna slova črez i kratny od trěbajut odvojen jezyčny sud.
en: The main text states divisibility, while the footnote uses the wording of a multiple. This follows the source's distinct expressions without introducing a new ideal-theoretic abstraction. The historical expressions črez and kratny od need separate linguistic assessment.

original_reasons.text: Keeps divisibility literal in the body and uses the 'multiple' wording only in the scan-restored footnote, matching the printed relation between a and t without introducing a new ideal-theoretic abstraction.

title: a priori
isv: A priori jest zachovano kako internacionalno naučno latinsko vyraženje. To samo po sobě ne rěšaje, kako vsaky latinizm trěba pisati v kiriličnom tekstu. V originalnom razlogu nijedno opče pravilo za vse latinizmy ne bylo ustanovjeno.
en: A priori is retained as an international scholarly Latin expression. That does not, by itself, determine how every Latinism should be written in Cyrillic text. The original reason establishes no general rule covering all Latinisms.

original_reasons.text: Preserved as international scholarly Latin. In the Cyrillic reader the surrounding prose is Cyrillicized but formula labels stay stable; if a future public style guide wants Cyrillicized Latinisms, revise consistently.

title: A) / B) / C) / D)
isv: A), B), C) i D) sut oznaky česti argumenta, ne jezyčne jedinice. Njihova latinska identičnost ostavaje neizměnjena pri kiriličnom prěpisu; \mbox{...} jest jedan način tipografskoj zaščity. Osobno C) ne směje stati Ц).
en: A), B), C), and D) identify parts of the argument rather than words. Their Latin identities remain unchanged in Cyrillic text; \mbox{...} is one means of protecting them in the source. In particular, C) must not become Ц).

original_reasons.text: These are structural labels, not target-language words. They are protected with \mbox{...} after visual inspection caught Cyrillic C) becoming Ц).

title: A) / B) / C) / D), a) / b)
isv: Velike A), B), C), D) i male a), b) organizujut iztočny argument. Prěpis v kirilicu ne menja te oznaky. Zaščita oznak jest nezavisna od prěvoda obkružajučej prozy.
en: The uppercase labels A), B), C), D) and lowercase a), b) organize the source argument. Conversion to Cyrillic does not change these identifiers. Their protection is independent of the translation of surrounding prose.

original_reasons.text: These are source-structural labels, not target-language words. They are protected with \mbox{...} for deterministic Cyrillic generation.

title: A) / B) / C), a) / b) / c)
isv: Oznaky A), B), C) i a), b), c) ostavajut latinske, ibo upučujut na iste česti dokaza v vseh jezyčnyh verzijah. Tuto pravilo se priměnjaje na strukturne oznaky; ne govori, že vsaka latinska bukva v običnoj prozě ima tų rolu.
en: The labels A), B), C) and a), b), c) remain Latin because they refer to the same parts of the proof across language versions. The rule applies to structural labels, not indiscriminately to every Latin letter in ordinary prose.

original_reasons.text: These are source-structural labels, not target-language words. They are protected with \mbox{...} after earlier checkpoints showed deterministic Cyrillic generation can otherwise alter Latin labels.

title: Abelove grupy/polja
isv: Abelove zachovuje běžno algebraično nazvanje, sravnjeno s ruskoju i ukrajinskoju pridavničnomu formoju. Izbor se takože opira na doslědnost s ranějšimi pojavjenjami tutogo pridavnika. Sam zapis ne daje opče pravilo za vse imenske pridavniki.
en: Abelove follows conventional algebraic adjective formation, with Russian and Ukrainian comparanda and consistency with earlier occurrences. The record does not supply a general rule for every adjective derived from a personal name.

original_reasons.text: Conventional algebraic adjective in Ukrainian/Russian; Interslavic keeps the already-established Abelove pattern.

title: absolutna nerazložimost / absolutno nerazložimy
isv: Familija razložiti/nerazložimy jest izbrana vměsto čisto internacionalnogo pridavnika, ibo argument povtorno sravnjaje nerazloženost s faktičnoju faktorizacijeju. Presudny razlog jest prozirnost toj smyslovoj vezy. Rusky i ukrajinsky izrazy služet sravnjenju tehničnogo smysla.
en: The razložiti/nerazložimy family is preferred to a purely international adjective because the argument repeatedly contrasts remaining undecomposed with actual factorization. The decisive reason is that semantic connection. Russian and Ukrainian terms provide comparanda for the technical sense.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian and Russian use the established modern irreducibility terms. Interslavic uses the transparent Slavic family razložiti/razpadanje rather than a purely international irreducibilny adjective, because the paper repeatedly contrasts remaining un-decomposed with actual factorization.

title: absolutna oblast množiteljev
isv: Oblast množiteljev zachovuje nazvanje upotrěbljeno v oddělah 1 i 8. Oblast ne jest skryto zaměnjena slovom algebra, ibo iztočny pojem jest vezany s avtorskim opisom operatornoj oblasti. Absolutna ostavaje čestju tehničnogo izraza.
en: The term continues the designation used in Sections 1 and 8. Oblast is not silently replaced by algebra, because the source concept is tied to Noether's operator-domain formulation. Absolutna remains part of the technical expression.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the Section1/Section8 lane's technical term for the absolute multiplier domain.
Maintains the established project term; the domain/range word is not collapsed into 'algebra' because the source concept is tied to Noether's operator-domain phrasing.

title: absolutna prosta funkcija / absolutno nerazložimy polinom
russian: абсолютная простая функция / абсолютно неприводимый полином
ukrainian: абсолютна проста функція / абсолютно незвідний поліном
isv: Prosta funkcija zachovuje historijno slovo funkcija; polinom v objasnjenju ukazuje sučasny algebraičny smysl. Taka para ne dozvoljaje avtomatično zaměniti vsako iztočno funkcija slovom polinom. Ona razděljuje avtorsko imenovanje od objasnjenja.
en: Prosta funkcija retains the historical function-language, while the polynomial expression clarifies the modern algebraic reading. The pairing does not license replacing every source occurrence of function by polynomial. It distinguishes the author's designation from an explanatory gloss.

original_reasons.text: `prosta funkcija` tracks Noether's function-language without modernizing it into only `polynomial`; the parenthetical irreducibility gloss supplies the modern algebraic reading.

title: absolutno algebraično polje
isv: Absolutno zachovuje historijno imenovanje algebraičnogo polja nad prostym poljem. Izvorny razlog upučuje na pozdnějše opreděljenja algebraično cělyh i drobnyh veličin. Objem pojma trěba čitati v tųh opreděljenjah, ne izvedati samo iz sučasnogo značenja pridavnika.
en: Absolutno preserves the historical designation of the algebraic field over the prime field, to which later definitions of algebraically integral and fractional quantities refer. Its scope must be read in those definitions, not inferred solely from a modern adjective.

original_reasons.text: The term names the algebraic closure generated over the prime field. The lanes preserve the “absolute” wording because the later definitions of algebraically integral/fractional quantities refer to this absolute algebraic field.

title: absolutno ireducibilno predstavjenje
isv: Predstavjenje i ireducibilno prodolžujut tehničnu terminologiju děla 34 i oddělov 21–23. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje podpira matematičny smysl nerazložimosti. Zapis dokumentuje doslědnost jednoj kandidatnoj familije, ne pobědu nad vsemi alternativami.
en: Predstavjenje and ireducibilno continue the terminology of Paper 34 and Sections 21–23. Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the mathematical sense of irreducibility. The record documents consistency within a candidate family, not a demonstrated victory over every alternative.

original_reasons.text: Living-language lanes use their standard irreducibility terms. Interslavic continues the project choice ireducibilny for technical consistency with Sections 21--23.
Matches the prior Paper34 representation vocabulary.

title: absolutno ireducibilny
isv: Internacionalna forma ireducibilny jest tu objasnjena doslědnostju s terminologijeju reducibilnosti v oddělah 16–20 děla 34. Zapis ne tvrdi, že internacionalny korenj mora iměti prědnost v vseh kontekstah; druge zapisy upotrěbjajut familiju nerazložim-.
en: The international ireducibilny is justified here by consistency with the reducibility vocabulary of Paper 34, Sections 16–20. The record does not establish a universal preference for that root; other records use the nerazložim- family.

original_reasons.text: Matches the established reducibility lanes from Paper34 Sections 16--20.

title: absolutno nerazložime sostavne česti
isv: Sostavne česti razlikuje sastojki od predstavjenij i klasov. Pridavnik vyražaje absolutnu nerazložimost. Zapis se opira na rusko i ukrajinsko odborno vyraženje i na doslědnost s dělom 17, ale označaje slabu podkrepu medžuslovjanskogo registra teorije predstavjenij.
en: Sostavne česti distinguishes constituents from representations and classes; the adjective expresses absolute irreducibility. The record invokes Russian and Ukrainian mathematical phrasing and consistency with Paper 17, while acknowledging limited evidence for an Interslavic representation-theory register.

original_reasons.text: Constituent is kept distinct from representation and class. Ukrainian/Russian use readable modern constituent wording; Interslavic continues the Paper17 'sostavne česti' family, with a review flag because the representation-theory register remains under-resourced.

title: absolutno polny sistem
isv: V zachovanom terminologičnom zapisu ne jest osobno objasnjeno, zašto byla izbrana tuta forma. Par absolut vollständiges System — absolutno polny sistem jest dokumentovany, ale njegove istorijne vage, alternativy i razlog ne možut byti izmysljene. Vsako novo opravdanje trěba jasno odlišiti od izvornogo dokaza.
en: No separate rationale survives in this terminology record. The source–candidate pair is documented, but its historical weights, alternatives, and justification cannot be invented. Any new justification must be explicitly distinguished from the original evidence.

title: absolutny prost ideal
isv: Prost ideal zachovuje razliku medžu prostym i primarnym idealom; absolutny jest internacionalny pridavnik. Izvorny razlog govori o toj algebraičnoj razlicě i o doslědnosti. On ne odlučaje sam po sobě medžu kratkoju formoju prost i formoju prosty.
en: The proposal preserves the algebraic distinction between prime and primary ideals and combines it with the international adjective absolutny. The reason concerns that distinction and consistency; it does not independently decide between prost and prosty.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the project's established algebraic distinction between simple/prime ideal and primary ideal. Interslavic uses international `absolutny` plus the already canonical `prost ideal`.

title: absolutny prosty ideal
isv: Izraz neposrědno veže absolutny prosty ideal s diskusijeju o absolutnoj nerazložimosti. Tuto jest zabilěženy smyslovy razlog. Zapis ne dava osobnu morfologičnu argumentaciju za formu prosty nasuprot prost.
en: The expression maintains the link between an absolute prime ideal and the discussion of absolute irreducibility. This is the recorded semantic reason. No separate morphological argument for prosty over prost is supplied.

original_reasons.text: Literal term keeps the link to Noether's absolute irreducibility discussion.

title: abstraktna izgradnja teorije idealov
isv: Izgradnja zachovuje iztočnu metaforu tvorenja teorije. Zapis ne zaměnjaje Aufbau pozdnějšim nazvanjem aksiomatizacije, ktoro by pribavilo interpretaciju k zaglavju.
en: Izgradnja preserves the source's construction metaphor. The record avoids substituting the later label axiomatization, which would add an interpretation to the title.

original_reasons.text: All lanes keep a direct construction/building metaphor rather than replacing the title by a later axiomatization label.

title: abstraktna konstrukcija teorije idealov
isv: Konstrukcija takože tumači Aufbau kako organizaciju teorije, ale dava prědnost poznatomu internacionalnomu imeniku prěd doslovnoju arhitektoničnoju skovanicoju. To jest druga zabilěžena możliwość uz izgradnja, ne dokaz, že oba zapisy sut jedna jedina odluka.
en: Konstrukcija likewise interprets Aufbau as the organization of a theory, but prefers a familiar international noun to a literal architectural calque. It is a separately recorded alternative to izgradnja, not evidence that the two records constitute one settled decision.

original_reasons.text: Keeps Aufbau as a constructive organization of theory while using a modern mathematical noun. Interslavic uses the international `konstrukcija` rather than a brittle architectural calque.

title: abstraktna teorija idealov
isv: Prěma internacionalna konstrukcija označaje abstraktnu teoriju idealov, v ktorej Noether nanovo formuluje rezultat Hentzelta o eliminaciji. Razlog izbora jest jasno nazvanje teorijnoj perspektivy, ne zaměna samogo rezultata.
en: The direct international expression names the abstract ideal-theoretic perspective in which Noether formulates Hentzelt's elimination result. The choice identifies that perspective clearly without replacing the result itself.

original_reasons.text: Direct international phrasing is clearest here; the phrase marks Noether's conceptual reframing of Hentzelt's elimination result.

title: Adaptacija imen Weber i Steinitz
isv: Veber i E. Štejnic sut adaptovane pisanja vlastnyh imen, ne novy matematičny leksikon. Historijny izbor měl tehničnu pričinu: neprěvedene Weber moglo dati směšane pismo pri avtomatičnoj kirilizaciji. Aktualna pasaža doista ima Veberu i E. Štejnicu pri připisaniu abstraktnoj definicije polja. Pisanje dolžno sohraniti prepoznavanje Webera i Steinitza i njihove kredity. Kontrola pisma sama ne ustanavjaje, že adaptacija jest jedina jezyčno dopustima forma.
en: Veber and E. Štejnic are adapted spellings of proper names, not new mathematical vocabulary. The recorded choice had a technical reason: unadapted Weber could produce mixed script during automatic Cyrillic conversion. The current passage does have Veberu and E. Štejnicu when crediting the abstract definition of a field. The spelling must preserve identification of Weber and Steinitz and their scholarly credit. Script checking alone does not establish the adaptation as the only linguistically permissible form.

comparisons.title_en: Names in the attribution of the field definition
comparisons.text: Adaptovano pisanje ne odstranjaje ljudsky kredit.
comparisons.english: Adapted spelling does not remove human credit.

passages.quote: dopuščajut {\itshape obobčenje na najobčejše polje}, ktore po Veberu i
E. Štejnicu\footnote{Na tom samom městu, uvod.} abstraktno oprědělja se kako
``sistem elementov s dvoma operacijami, dodavanjem i množenjem, ktore podčinjene
sut asociativnomu i komutativnomu zakonu, povezane sut distributivnym zakonom i
dopuščajut neograničene i jednoznačne obratne operacije''.\footnote{Izključiti
trěba samo děljenje nulom.}

original_reasons.text: The Interslavic Latin lane originally risked a mixed-script Cyrillic render from “Weber.” It was normalized to “Veber” and “Štejnic” before final render so the Cyrillic reader has clean Slavic-script names.

title_en: Adaptation of the names Weber and Steinitz

title: Adaptovane imena i točna avtorska identičnost
isv: Lurot, Kastelnuovo i Enrikes sut adaptovane osnovy vlastnyh imen, s genitivom pri teorem. Arhiv objašnjaje Lurot kako način izběgnuti mehanično prěpisano th v kirilici. To jest redakcijna pravopisna odluka, ne dokaz, že izvorno ime Lüroth trěba izbrisati iz bibliografije. V rabotě 11 Lurot i Kastelnuovo podpirajut pozitivne tvrdženja o minimalnoj bazi, dokole Enrikes jest citovany za protivny priměr pri vyšem čislu neizvěstnyh. Tri imena v arhivnom spisku zato ne označajut tri sinonimne teoremy. Bibliografija mora dati točnu identičnost citovanyh avtorov; jezyčna adaptacija v prozě ne směje odstraniti avtorsky prinos.
en: Lurot, Kastelnuovo, and Enrikes are adapted proper-name stems, used in the genitive after teorem. The archive explains Lurot as avoiding a mechanical th rendering in Cyrillic. This is an editorial spelling choice, not a reason to erase Lüroth's original name from bibliographic identification. In Paper 11, Lüroth and Castelnuovo support positive minimal-basis assertions, while Enriques is cited for a counterexample with more indeterminates. The three names in the archival list therefore do not designate three synonymous theorems. Bibliography must identify the actual cited authors; linguistic adaptation in prose must not remove their contributions.

comparisons.text: Imena v jednom spisku ne činęt citovane rezultaty zaměnjivymi.
comparisons.english: Names in one list do not make their cited results interchangeable.

passages.quote: Za uravnenja 3-go i 4-go stepena odtud osoblivo dobyvaje se redukcija na funkcionalne polja od jednogo odnosno dvoh argumentov. Za ty jednako vsegda obstojit minimalna baza po teoremah Lurota i Kastelnuova.\footnote{J. Lurot: \emph{\foreign{Beweis eines Satzes über rationale Kurven}}, \emph{Math. Ann. 9 (1875)}; G. Kastelnuovo: \emph{\foreign{Sulla razionalità delle involuzioni piane}}, \emph{Math. Ann. 44 (1893)}. Že za polja od bolje než dvoh neizvěstnyh minimalna baza ne mora obstojati, pokazal F. Enrikes protivnym priměrom, \emph{Rend. Acc. Linc., Vol. 21, 21 Jan. 1912}.} V slučaju jednoj neizvěstnoj minimalnu bazu možno izvesti racionalnymi operacijami, zato ona osoblivo za $\mathfrak L_\Gamma$ sodrživaje samo racionalno-čislove koeficienty. Pri dvoh neizvěstnyh po Kastelnuovu mogla by ješče byti baza s koeficientami iz algebraičnogo čislovogo polja $\Omega$; stvarno izslědovanje (srav. F. Seidelmann, navedeno město) pokazuje, že i tuto za vsako $\mathfrak L_\Gamma$ dobyvaje se baza s racionalno-čislovymi koeficientami. To možno viděti skoro bez računa už iz toga, že za četvernu grupu možno izbrati taku racionalno-čislovu bazu, imenně

original_reasons.text: Proper names are normalized to Slavic-readable stems; Lurot/Lurota avoids a Cyrillic "тх" artifact and is logged as an editorial spelling decision.

title_en: Adapted names and exact author identification

title: adjungovane formy/funkcije/krive
isv: Adjungovane zachovuje historijno algebraično-geometrično nazvanje form, funkcij i krivyh. Presudna jest veza s geometričnoju teorijeju, s ktoroju tekst sravnjaje konstrukciju. Izvor ne rěšaje vsih drugyh smyslov německogo adjungiert tym samym slovom.
en: Adjungovane preserves the older algebraic-geometric designation of forms, functions, and curves. The reason is its role in the comparison with geometric theory. The record does not resolve every other sense of German adjungiert with the same word.

original_reasons.text: The term is central to the comparison with the geometric theory. Borrowed adjoint/adjungovan wording preserves the older algebraic-geometric register while staying recognizably modern.

title: adjungovano kako modul
isv: Adjungovano kako modul izrično zachovuje kako modul pri formuli 11 v oddělu 10. Izraz pripada familiji adjungovati, upotrěbjanoj v oddělah 7 i 9. Rusky i ukrajinsky prěvody imajut obične tehnične slovesne odgovaranja; medžuslovjansky zapis izbira medžunarodnu osnovu. Ta leksična odluka byla označena za daljše jezyčno razmotrenje, ne za dokazanu normu.
en: Adjungovano kako modul retains the explicit qualification as a module beside formula 11 in section 10. It belongs to the adjungovati family used in sections 7 and 9. The Russian and Ukrainian versions use ordinary technical verbs, whereas the Interslavic candidate uses an international stem. The lexical choice was left for further linguistic examination, not established as a norm.

original_reasons.text: Unabbreviated in §10 formula (11) because space allows it. Interslavic keeps the adjungovati family already flagged in §7/§9, but it remains authority-review material.

title: adjungovany modul
isv: Kratka oznaka pri formule jest razvinuta v adjungovany modul i vezana s terminologijeju adjunkcije v oddělu 7. Sam izvor označaje familiju adjungovati kako predmet daljnjej jezyčnoj prověrky; kratkost ne zaměnjaje tę prověrku.
en: The short formula annotation is expanded as adjungovany modul and linked to the adjoining terminology of Section 7. The record treats the adjungovati family as needing further linguistic assessment; brevity is not a substitute for that assessment.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the formula annotation short while tying it to §7's adjoining terminology; Interslavic uses the adjungovati family already flagged in §7.

title: adjungovati funkciju log x k oblasti racionalnosti
source: adjungieren von log x zum Rationalitaetsbereich
isv: V četvrtom priměru dodavanje log x menja oblast koeficientov oziroma racionalnosti. Medžuslovjansky i ukrajinsky izrazy zachovujut korenj adjunkcije. V zachovanom razlogu rusko slovo ima samo znaky ?; njegov točny zapis ne može byti citovany iz tutogo dokaza.
en: In Example 4, adjoining log x changes the coefficient or rationality domain. The Interslavic and Ukrainian wording retains the adjunction root. The preserved rationale renders the Russian word only as question marks; its exact spelling cannot be quoted from this evidence.

original_reasons.text: Example 4 changes the coefficient/rationality domain by adjoining log x. Ukrainian and Interslavic keep adjunction vocabulary; Russian uses the standard ???????????? register already used for field/domain extensions.

title: adjungujemo
isv: Adjungujemo zachovuje odborny korenj za dodavanje neopreděljenyh elementov k polju. Ukrajinsky i medžuslovjansky kandidaty upotrěbjajut adjunkcijnu terminologiju, rusky sravniteljny izraz jest присоединять. Zapis zachovuje tu razliku vměsto pretvarjanja vseh sravnjenij v jedan korenj.
en: Adjungujemo preserves the technical root for adjoining indeterminates to a field. The Ukrainian and Interslavic proposals use adjunction vocabulary, while the Russian comparandum is присоединять. The comparison retains this difference rather than pretending that all witnesses share one root.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian and Interslavic preserve the algebraic adjunction term; Russian uses the standard присоединять register for adjoining indeterminates to a field.

title: adjungujut se kako moduly
isv: Adjungujut se kako moduly zachovuje slovesnu konstrukciju i množinu modulov. Zapis dava prednost adjungovati radi tehničnoj točnosti, zatymčas rusky prisojedinjat i ukrajinsky pryjednuvaty pokazuju možnost običnogo slovjanskogo slovesa. To jest stvarno sravnjenje alternativnyh načinov imenovanja; zapis ne zaključaje, že medžunarodna osnova jest jedina pravilna možnost.
en: Adjungujut se kako moduly preserves a verbal construction and plural modules. The record prefers adjungovati for technical precision, while the Russian and Ukrainian equivalents illustrate the alternative of an ordinary Slavic verb meaning to adjoin. This is a comparison between ways of naming the operation, not a finding that the international stem is the only correct choice.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use ordinary mathematical verbs; Interslavic uses the international adjungovati family for precision but should be reviewed.

title: adjunkcija
isv: Adjunkcija jest internacionalny termin za algebraično dodavanje, doslědno upotrěbljany v dělu 9. Zapisy go sravnjajut s ruskim i ukrajinskim odbornym vyraženjem i smatrajut polno slovjansku skovanicu mene stabilnoju. Odděl 4 takože dava objasnjenje pojma. Jezyčna prověrka ostavaje izrično otvorjena.
en: Adjunkcija is the international candidate for algebraic adjoining, used consistently in Paper 9. The records compare Russian and Ukrainian mathematical phrasing and regard a fully Slavic calque as less stable. Section 4 also explains the concept. Linguistic assessment remains expressly open.

original_reasons.text: Adjoining is standard field-theory language; Interslavic uses transparent internationalism pending review.
Field-theoretic adjoining term already used in Section 1.
Ukrainian/Russian use ordinary algebraic adjoining language; Interslavic keeps the internationalism because a fully Slavic calque is less stable and the source flags the term for explanation in § 4.
Continues the Paper 09 field-extension vocabulary; Interslavic uses international adjunkcija already established.

title: adjunkcija / adjungovati
isv: Para adjunkcija/adjungovati zachovuje jedan korenj za imenik i glagol v teoriji razširenij polja. Izvorny razlog preferuje tu kratku internacionalnu familiju prěd dolžšim opisnym kalkom; ne dava čislene ocěny razumljivosti.
en: The noun–verb pair retains one root in field-extension discourse. The recorded reason prefers the compact international family to a longer descriptive calque. It provides no numerical estimate of intelligibility.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian and Russian use normal field-extension prose. Interslavic deliberately keeps the international adjunction root from earlier Paper 09 sections, because a transparent calque would be longer and less stable across Slavic readers.

title: adjunkcija sqrt(x) / modulna baza
isv: Adjunkcija prodolžuje terminologiju razširenij; internacionalny korenj byl izbrany radi kratkosti i radi izběganja nejasnosti nove skovanice. Modulna baza ostavaje svazana s konkretnym priměrom dodavanja sqrt(x).
en: Adjunkcija continues the extension terminology. The international root was preferred for compactness and to avoid the ambiguity of a new calque. Modulna baza remains tied to the specific example adjoining sqrt(x).

original_reasons.text: Uses the already established extension terminology. Interslavic deliberately keeps international `adjunkcija` because it is compact and less ambiguous than a fresh Slavic calque.

title: afekt / bez afekta
isv: Afekt jest zachovany kak historijno algebraično nazvanje iz literatury o kubičnyh i kvartičnyh jednačenjah. Zapis ostavjaje njegovu točnu interpretaciju za odbornu prověrku i ne zaměnjaje go nepodkrepljenym sučasnym ekvivalentom.
en: Afekt preserves a historical algebraic term from work on cubic and quartic equations. The record leaves its precise interpretation for subject review rather than substituting an unsupported modern equivalent.

original_reasons.text: Historical algebraic term from the cubic/quartic equation literature. Kept transliterated and reviewer-flagged rather than silently replacing with a speculative modern equivalent.

title: afinna grupa
isv: Afinna grupa jest internacionalno nazvanje grupe v završnoj redukciji nehomogennyh funkcij pomoču homogenizacije. Rusky i ukrajinsky izrazy dajut neposrědne odborné sravnjenja; izvorny zapis ne prědlaga novy slovjansky korenj.
en: Afinna grupa supplies the international group-theoretic term in the concluding reduction of nonhomogeneous functions by homogenization. Russian and Ukrainian provide direct technical comparanda. The record proposes no new Slavic root.

original_reasons.text: Standard modern group-theoretic term, appearing in Noether’s closing reduction of nonhomogeneous functions by homogenization.

title: Ako … to: uslovje i posledica
isv: Ako … to označaje uslovnu konstrukciju: kogda jest izpolnjeno predpoloženje, slěduje posledica. Devet zabilěženih tedy/teda imajut ulogu to v apodozi, ne samostojnogo therefore. Togda može sugerovati vrěme, ktore tu ne jest trěbno. Zato može pridati silu samostojnogo vyvoda vměsto vtoroj časti uslovja. Konsultovana tablica sojuzov izrično dava ako kako if; ona sama ne dava polno sravnenje svih možnyh apodoz. Izbor to jest kontekstna interpretacija zabilěženogo německogo wenn/ist … so. Čitatelj mora razlikovati logično uslovje od vrěmennogo when, osoblivo kogda matematičny tekst upotrěbljaje dynamičny glagol.
en: Ako … to marks a conditional: the consequence holds under the hypothesis. Nine recorded tedy/teda occurrences function as the apodotic to, rather than an independent therefore. Togda may suggest time where none is needed; zato can give the force of a separate inference instead of the second half of the conditional. The consulted conjunction list explicitly gives ako as if, but does not itself compare every possible apodosis. Selecting to is a contextual interpretation of the recorded German wenn/ist … so constructions. Logical condition and temporal when must remain distinct, especially when mathematical prose uses a dynamic verb.
sources_isv: Gramatika, Sojuzy, ako; slovnik, zaglavje 17076; zabilěžene uslovne frazy.
sources_en: Grammar, Conjunctions, ako; dictionary entry 17076; the recorded conditional sentences.

evidence.finding: Ako … to marks a conditional: the consequence holds under the hypothesis. Nine recorded tedy/teda occurrences function as the apodotic to, rather than an independent therefore. Togda may suggest time where none is needed; zato can give the force of a separate inference instead of the second half of the conditional. The consulted conjunction list explicitly gives ako as if, but does not itself compare every possible apodosis. Selecting to is a contextual interpretation of the recorded German wenn/ist … so constructions. Logical condition and temporal when must remain distinct, especially when mathematical prose uses a dynamic verb.

title: algebrai?na baza
isv: Baza H jest fiksovana osnova, vzhledem na ktoru se izslěduje familija M(G). Razlog takože trěbuje doslědnu vezu s ranějšimi svojstvami bazy. Grafija algebrai?na i sravniteljne formy sut poškođene; točny znak prěd 5 v razlogu ne jest zachovany.
en: H is the fixed basis relative to which the family M(G) is studied, with continuity to earlier basis-property terminology. The candidate and comparanda are damaged, and the sign before 5 in the rationale has not survived. These losses must not be silently reconstructed.

original_reasons.text: Kept as a transparent current mathematical noun phrase. It is the fixed basis H relative to which the ?5 family M(G) is studied; it must remain visibly parallel to earlier basis-property terminology.

title: algebrai?no-drobno ?islo
isv: Zachovany razlog govori, že drobny status jest nužno dopolnitelno uslovje i ne směje byti oslaben do neodređenoj necělosti. Ale medžuslovjanska forma i obe sravniteljne formy sodržet znaky ?. Poškođeny zapis ne jest pouzdan obrazec pravopisa.
en: The preserved reason treats fractional status as an essential side condition, not an unspecified lack of integrality. The Interslavic candidate and both comparanda contain question marks replacing characters. They are not reliable spelling witnesses.

original_reasons.text: The fractional status is the side condition; it must stay visible in every language and not collapse into ordinary non-integrality.

title: algebraična baza
isv: Algebraična baza zachovuje imenovanje iz děla 9. Odděl potrěbuje zaměnu jednoj bazy drugoju i zachovanje svojstva bazy pri izomorfizmu; upotrěba istogo termina čini tu vezu jasnoju.
en: The phrase continues Paper 9's terminology. The section replaces one algebraic basis by another and uses preservation of basis status under isomorphism; consistent naming makes that connection explicit.

original_reasons.text: The section relies on replacing one algebraic basis by another and on the preservation of basis status under isomorphism. The established Paper 09 basis vocabulary is preserved.

title: algebraična baza / racionalna baza
isv: Baza jest preferovana prěd osnova, ibo tekst opreděljaje osobne generujuče sistemy čisel. Pridavniki algebraična i racionalna razlikujut dva nazvane objekty. Razlog jest točnost definovanogo pojma, ne opča zabrana slova osnova.
en: Baza is preferred to osnova because the text defines particular generating systems of numbers. Algebraična and racionalna distinguish the named objects. This is a reason concerning a defined concept, not a general prohibition on osnova.

original_reasons.text: Basis is kept as база/baza because the paper defines special generating systems of numbers; “основа” would blur the named object.

title: algebraična baza H iz Theta
isv: H jest izbrana iz veličin racionalnoj bazy Theta. Izraz zachovuje taj odnos, ibo dokaz prěvodi racionalnu zavisimost na konečno mnogo primitivnyh elementov. H i Theta ostavajut točne oznaky različnyh objektov.
en: H is chosen from the quantities of the rational basis Theta. The wording preserves that relation because the proof reduces rational dependence to finitely many primitive elements. H and Theta remain exact identifiers of different objects.

original_reasons.text: H is chosen from the rational-basis quantities Theta so that the proof can reduce rational dependence to finitely many primitive elements.

title: algebraične čislove polja
isv: Polja jest izbrano vměsto těla, ibo tute čislove polja sut komutativne. Pridavniki algebraične i čislove zachovujut obě kvalifikacije. Razlog se odnosi na konkretny algebraičny objekt.
en: Polja is preferred to těla because these number fields are commutative. Both algebraic and number qualifications remain explicit. The reason concerns the particular algebraic object.

original_reasons.text: These are commutative number fields, so the field term remains поле/polje rather than тіло/tělo.

title: algebraične elementy / cěle elementy
isv: Elementy jest izbrano vměsto veličiny, ibo dělo 14 razmatraje polja i idealy, ne skalarny račun. Cěle zachovuje integralnost. Tuto jest kontekstno osuvrěmenjenje historijnogo Größe, ne pravilo za vsako pojavjenje německogo slova.
en: Elementy is preferred to veličiny because Paper 14 concerns fields and ideals rather than scalar calculus. Cěle preserves integrality. This is a contextual modernization of historical Größe, not a rule for every occurrence of that German word.

original_reasons.text: German Größe is historical. For modern algebraic prose the translation uses “element” while preserving integrality with “цілий/целый/cěly”. “Величина/величина/veličina” is avoided here because Paper 14 is a field-and-ideal survey, not a scalar-calculus passage.

title: algebraične i diferencialne invarianty
isv: Internacionalny korenj invariant- i pridavniki algebraične/diferencialne zachovujut poznatu odbornu terminologiju. Zapis ne tvori slovjansku zaměnu samo radi jezyčnoj čistoty; para pridavnikov ostavjaje obe vrsty invariantov vidime.
en: The international invariant- root and the algebraic/differential adjective pair retain familiar technical terminology. The record proposes no Slavic replacement merely for linguistic purity and keeps both classes of invariants explicit.

original_reasons.text: Use the modern international invariant-theory stem in all three language lanes; Interslavic keeps a transparent adjectival pair rather than coining a Slavic replacement.

title: algebraično cěla i celočislena vzhodno k
source: algebraisch-ganz und ganzzahlig in Bezug auf
isv: Dva uslovja ostavajut izrično odvojene: integralna zavisimost i uslovje cělosti v prstenu koeficientov. Jedna opča zaměna slovom cěly by skryla razliku, na ktorej počivaje formulacija.
en: Two conditions are kept explicit: integral dependence and the integrality condition in the coefficient ring. Replacing both by an undifferentiated integral would conceal the distinction on which the formulation depends.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the two tests separate: integral dependence plus coefficient-ring integrality.

title: algebraično cěla vzhodno k G
isv: Forma cěla soglasuje se s ženskym imenikom veličina v opreděljenju V. Odnos k G označaje osnovu algebraičnoj cělosti. Izvorny razlog podpira tu gramatičnu i semantičnu strukturu, ne avtomatično vse upotrěby vzhodno k.
en: Cěla agrees with the feminine noun veličina in Definition V. The relation to G specifies the base of algebraic integrality. The reason supports that grammatical and semantic structure, not automatically every use of vzhodno k.

original_reasons.text: Modern mathematical phrase for algebraically integral with respect to the domain; feminine agreement follows `величина` / `veličina` in Definition V.

title: algebraično cěle čisla iz Omega / cěle čisla
source: algebraisch-ganze Zahlen aus Omega / ganze Zahlen
russian: алгебраически целые числа из Omega / целые числа
ukrainian: алгебраїчно цілі числа з Omega / цілі числа
isv: Prěvod zachovuje avtorsku lokalnu konvenciju: algebraično cěle čisla iz Omega mogut v tom oddělu byti nazvane kratko cěle čisla. Kratko nazvanje ne ustanavjaje totožnost vseh različnyh pojmov cělosti izvan tutogo konteksta.
en: The translation preserves the author's local convention: algebraic integers in Omega may be called simply integers within the section. This abbreviation does not identify every different notion of integrality outside that context.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether's convention that algebraic integers in Omega are called whole/integers inside this section.

title: algebraično cělo čislo
isv: Algebraično cělo čislo imenuje algebraičny integer i ostavaje odvojeno od uslovja, že funkcija ima cěločislene koeficienty. Zapis podpira to razděljenje pomoču ruskogo i ukrajinskogo odbornogo izraza.
en: The expression names an algebraic integer and remains distinct from the condition that a function have integer coefficients. Russian and Ukrainian technical expressions support this distinction in the record.

original_reasons.text: Modern Slavic algebraic-integer wording; distinct from the section's integer-coefficient function restriction.

title: algebraično cěly nad R
isv: R jest izrično nazvana osnova integralnosti. Vyraženje nad R izběgaje čitanje německogo abhängt kako obyčnu algebraičnu zavisimost. Izbor zachovuje odnos k konkretnomu R, ne samo pridavnik cěly.
en: R is explicitly named as the base of integrality. Nad R avoids reading abhängt as ordinary algebraic dependence. The wording preserves the relation to this particular R, not merely the adjective integral.

original_reasons.text: The German dependence phrasing is modernized to the integral-over relation. This prevents confusion with ordinary algebraic dependence.

title: algebraično čislovo polje
isv: Čislovo polje zachovuje razliku medžu opčim poljem i algebraičnym čislovym poljem v zaglavji i tekstu. Četyre zapisy se opirajut na sučasny vzhodnoslovjansky registar i doslědnost s dělom 14 i uvodom děla 24; Körper ne jest doslovno prěvedeno kak tělo.
en: The phrase preserves the distinction between a field generally and an algebraic number field in both title and body. Four records invoke modern East Slavic usage and continuity with Paper 14 and Paper 24's introduction. Körper is not translated literally as body.

original_reasons.text: Continues the Paper 14 decision to render Körper as field rather than body. This keeps number-field terminology modern and consistent.
Matches the established absolute-prime-ideal terminology in Paper24's introduction and earlier Noether paper translations.
Uses modern Eastern Slavic mathematical idiom while preserving the field/number-field morphology in Interslavic.
Uses the modern field term while preserving the explicit number-field wording in the title and body.

title: algebraično nezavisne
isv: Nezavisne imenuje algebraičnu nezavisimost, ktora v opreděljenju IV slijedi iz minimalnosti. Izbor zachovuje tu logičnu rolu pojma; ne govori o obyčnoj nezavisimosti ili o nezavisimosti slučajnyh veličin.
en: Nezavisne denotes the algebraic independence that Definition IV derives from minimality. The wording preserves that logical role; it is not ordinary independence or probabilistic independence.

original_reasons.text: Standard algebraic independence vocabulary; needed because Definition IV uses it as a consequence of minimality.

title: algebraično nezavisne / transcendentne
isv: Nezavisne i transcendentne zachovujut sučasny matematičny registar. Internacionalny korenj transcend- byl smatrany dostatočno prepoznajemy, zato zapis ne tvori novu slovjansku zaměnu. Taka ocěna jest terminologičny sud, ne rezultat opyta s čitateljami.
en: The expressions retain modern mathematical usage. The international transcend- root was considered recognizable enough that no new Slavic replacement was proposed. This is a terminological judgment, not a reader-study result.

original_reasons.text: Direct modern mathematical register in all lanes; no constructed-language coinage is needed because the international root is broadly pan-Slavic.

title: algebraično nezavisne / zavisne
isv: Izvorny razlog upučuje na obyčnu algebraičnu terminologiju zavisimosti i nezavisimosti. Ruske i ukrajinske formy sut zabilěžene za sravnjenje. Posebna odklonjena alternativa ili čislena vaga ne jest navedena.
en: The surviving reason invokes ordinary algebraic dependence/independence terminology, with Russian and Ukrainian forms for comparison. No particular rejected alternative or numerical weighting is recorded.

original_reasons.text: Standard algebraic dependence terminology.

title: algebraično nezavisne funkcije
isv: Algebraično nezavisne funkcije prodolžujut terminologiju ranga iz prvogo odděla děla 6. Razlog jest zachovanje istogo pojma v svazanyh čestjah dokaza, ne zavedenje novogo termina.
en: The phrase continues the rank terminology of Paper 6, Section 1. The reason is to retain the same concept across connected parts of the proof, not to introduce a new term.

original_reasons.text: Core rank vocabulary from Paper 06 Section 1; unchanged here.

title: algebraično obrazovanje
isv: Obrazovanje jest doslovny kandidat za opče strukturno Gebilde. Izvorny zapis izrično dopuščaje, že sučasny matematičny kontekst može trěbovati točnjeje nazvanje raznovidnosti. Kandidat zato ne ustanavjaje univerzalny prěvod slova Gebilde.
en: Obrazovanje is a literal candidate for the broad structural word Gebilde. The record expressly leaves open whether the mathematical context requires terminology specific to a variety. It does not establish a universal translation of Gebilde.

original_reasons.text: Literal structural rendering; flagged because modern mathematical prose may prefer variety-specific terminology.

title: algebraično razširenje
isv: Razširenje jest odborny izraz za razširenje osnovnogo polja v oddělu 6. Konečnost i algebraičnost morajut byti čitane kako osobne kvalifikacije iztočnogo argumenta, ne izmysljene iz samogo imenika.
en: Razširenje denotes a base-field extension in Section 6. Finiteness and algebraicity must be read as the argument's particular qualifications, not inferred from the noun extension alone.

original_reasons.text: Standard extension vocabulary; Section 6 stresses finite/algebraic base-field extension.

title: algebraično razširjenje polja / podpolje
isv: Razširjenje polja izjasnjaje konstrukciju i izběgaje směšenje konečnogo polja s konečnym razširenjem polja. Podpolje odvojeno imenuje podobjekt. Medžuslovjansky izraz slijedi tu istu strukturu kak rusky i ukrajinsky prěvod.
en: Extension of a field makes the construction explicit and avoids confusing a finite field with a finite extension. Podpolje separately names the subfield. The Interslavic expression follows the same structure as the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda.

original_reasons.text: For Ukrainian/Russian, the construction is phrased as an extension of a field to avoid confusing `finite field` with a finite extension. Interslavic follows the same structure and keeps `podpolje`.

title: algebraično zamknjeno podkolco P
isv: Zamknjeno bylo preferovano prěd zatvorjeno radi predpolaganoj jasnoće matematičnoj zatvorjenosti v vzhodnyh i zapadnyh jezykah. Tuto jest razlog konkretnogo historijnogo izbora. Podkolco jest takože historijna forma i ne směje bez prověrky stati aktualnym rekomendovanym slovom.
en: Zamknjeno was preferred to zatvorjeno for its proposed fit with East and West Slavic mathematical closure terminology. This explains a historical choice. Podkolco is also historical and must not be promoted to a current recommendation without checking its subsequent status.

original_reasons.text: Uses the standard modern 'algebraically closed' wording in Ukrainian and Russian. Interslavic continues the live preference `zamknjeno` over older `zatvorjeno`, because the former tracks mathematical closure more cleanly across West/East Slavic usage.

title: algebraično zamknjeno polje
isv: Zamknjeno polje slijedi rusku i ukrajinsku konstrukciju za algebraičnu zatvorjenost. Termin jest važny v podčrtnoj primětce o razširenjah polja Steinitza; razlog izbora jest i jasno sravnjenje istogo pojma medžu prěvodami.
en: Zamknjeno polje follows the Russian and Ukrainian construction for algebraic closedness. The term anchors the Steinitz field-extension footnote, so cross-language identification of the same concept is part of the reason.

comparisons.text: Prěvod upotrěbjaje i algebraično zamknjeno polje, i algebraično zatvorjeno polje v pasažah o algebraičnoj zamknjenosti. Kontekst s razloženjem na linearne faktory podpiraje isti matematičny smysl, ale samo prisutnost oběh form ne izbira jednu iz njih kako normu. Historijne zapisy trěba zato čitati kako dokumentovane alternativy. Te tri pasaže ne dokazyvajut, že vsako pojavjenje zamknjen- ili zatvorjen- v korpusu ima isti smysl.
comparisons.english: The translation uses both algebraično zamknjeno polje and algebraično zatvorjeno polje in passages concerning algebraic closedness. Context involving factorization into linear factors supports the same mathematical sense, but the coexistence of the forms does not select either as the norm. The historical records must therefore be read as documented alternatives. These three passages do not establish that every occurrence of zamknjen- or zatvorjen- in the corpus has the same sense.

original_reasons.text: Direct standard term in Ukrainian/Russian; Interslavic keeps the same transparent construction. This term anchors Steinitz's field-extension footnote and must remain visibly close across lanes.

title: algebraično zamknjeno polje
isv: Zamknjeno jest izbrano radi predpolaganoj medžuslovjanskoj razumljivosti i podobnosti s ruskim i ukrajinskim odbornym pridavnikom. Zatvorjeno jest zabilěženo kako stvarna alternativa. Razlog ne dava empiricku ocěnu razumljivosti ni konačno opče razrěšenje medžu oběma formami.
en: Zamknjeno is preferred for proposed pan-Slavic transparency and similarity to the Russian and Ukrainian technical adjective. Zatvorjeno is a documented alternative. The reason supplies neither an empirical comprehension estimate nor a universal resolution between them.

Kontekst s razloženjem na linearne faktory podpiraje isti matematičny smysl, ale samo prisutnost oběh form ne izbira jednu iz njih kako normu. Historijne zapisy trěba zato čitati kako dokumentovane alternativy. Te tri pasaže ne dokazyvajut, že vsako pojavjenje zamknjen- ili zatvorjen- v korpusu ima isti smysl.

original_reasons.text: Uses the conventional closed-field adjective in Ukrainian/Russian. Interslavic keeps `zamknjeno` for pan-Slavic transparency; the `zatvorjeno` alternative remains a cumulative review note, not a Section 7 change.

title: algebraično zatvorjeno polje
isv: Zatvorjeno jest kandidat v konstrukciji algebraično zatvorjeno polje. Izvorny razlog govori o poznatoj slovjanskoj algebraičnoj terminologiji, ale ne sravnjaje podrobno alternativu zamknjeno. To ograničenje trěba zachovati pri čitanju tutogo zapisa.
en: Zatvorjeno is the candidate in the algebraically-closed-field construction. The original reason appeals to familiar Slavic algebraic terminology but does not compare zamknjeno in detail. That evidentiary limit remains relevant.

comparisons.text: Prěvod upotrěbjaje i algebraično zamknjeno polje, i algebraično zatvorjeno polje v pasažah o algebraičnoj zamknjenosti. Kontekst s razloženjem na linearne faktory podpiraje isti matematičny smysl, ale samo prisutnost oběh form ne izbira jednu iz njih kako normu. Historijne zapisy trěba zato čitati kako dokumentovane alternativy. Te tri pasaže ne dokazyvajut, že vsako pojavjenje zamknjen- ili zatvorjen- v korpusu ima isti smysl.
