title: algebraično zatvorjeno polje / algebraično razširiteljno polje
russian: алгебраически замкнутое поле / алгебраическое расширение поля
ukrainian: алгебраїчно замкнене поле / алгебраїчне розширення поля
isv: Obě nazvanja izrično govoret o polju: jedno o algebraičnoj zatvorjenosti, drugo o razširenju. Ta razlika jest potrěbna, ibo dokaz dodava proměnne i izdvaja linearne faktory. Zapis ne opravdava zamenjanje tųh dvuh svojstv jednym opčim pridavnikom.
en: Both designations explicitly concern fields, distinguishing algebraic closedness from an extension. This matters because the proof adjoins variables and extracts linear factors. The record does not justify collapsing the two properties into one general adjective.

original_reasons.text: Field-extension language is kept explicit because the proof repeatedly adjoins variables and then extracts linear factors.

title: algebraično zatvorjeno polje izvedeno iz P
source: der aus P abgeleitete algebraisch-abgeschlossene Körper
russian: алгебраически замкнутое поле, выведенное из P
ukrainian: алгебраїчно замкнене поле, виведене з P
isv: Izvedeno iz $P$ zachovuje avtorske izrično odnosenje polja k $P$. Zaměna cěloj konstrukcije samo simbolom algebraičnogo zamknjenja odstranila by to slovno objasnjenje. Algebraično zatvorjeno ostavaje kvalifikacijeju polja, a ne zaměnoju za odnos, ktory vyražaje izvedeno.
en: Izvedeno iz $P$ retains the author's explicit relation between the field and $P$. Replacing the whole construction by algebraic-closure notation alone would remove that verbal explanation. Algebraično zatvorjeno qualifies the field but does not replace the relation expressed by derived from.

original_reasons.text: Noether's 'derived from P' is kept as a visible relation rather than silently normalizing to an algebraic closure notation only.

title: algebraično zavisimy / nezavisimy
isv: Algebraična zavisimost jest izrično odlišena od racionalnoj zavisimosti iz odděla 6. Zapis objasnjaje smyslovu razliku, ale ne dava osobno sravnjenje morfologičnyh kandidatov zavisimy i zavisny.
en: The expression explicitly distinguishes algebraic from the rational dependence discussed in Section 6. The record explains that semantic contrast, but supplies no separate morphological comparison of zavisimy and zavisny.

original_reasons.text: Modern dependence language is used; the contrast with rational dependence from Section 06 remains explicit.

title: algebraično zavisne funkcije
isv: Algebraično zavisne funkcije sut vezane s opreděljenjem algebraičnogo ranga v prvom oddělu. Izbor upotrěbjaje sravniteljne ruske i ukrajinske nazvanja zavisimosti i zachovuje funkcionovanje termina v tom opreděljenju.
en: The term is tied to the definition of algebraic rank in Section 1. Russian and Ukrainian dependence terminology provides comparanda; the wording preserves the term's role in that definition.

original_reasons.text: Standard algebraic-dependence terminology; aligned with Section 1's algebraic-rank definition.

title: algebraično zavisny / algebraično nezavisny
isv: Para zavisny/nezavisny razlikuje elementy racionalnoj bazy od algebraičnoj bazy H. Razlog jest rola tųh dvuh baz v argumentu, a ne samo suprotna značenja dvuh pridavnikov.
en: The pair distinguishes rational-basis elements from the algebraic basis H. The reason concerns the roles of those two bases in the argument, not merely the opposition between the adjectives.

original_reasons.text: Standard dependence vocabulary; needed for separating rational-basis elements from the algebraic basis H.

title: algebraično zavisny / nezavisny
isv: Zavisny/nezavisny prodolžuje terminologiju drugej česti i razlikuje dva slučaje argumenta. Zachovany razlog jest doslědnost konkretnogo izloženja; sam ne dokazuje prědnost toj morfologije nad kandidatami s -im-.
en: Zavisny/nezavisny continues the vocabulary of Part 2 and distinguishes the argument's two cases. The surviving reason is continuity within the exposition, not a demonstrated preference over the competing -im- forms.

original_reasons.text: Continues Part 2 and is central to cases 1 and 2.

title: algebraično-cěla adjunkcija
isv: Algebraično-cěla adjunkcija jest obrazovana paralelno k racionalno-cěloj adjunkciji. Spojnik čini pridavnik čitljivym kako jednu tehničnu kvalifikaciju, zachovajuči razliku medžu dvuma konstrukcijami.
en: The expression parallels rationally integral adjunction. The hyphenated adjective is intended to read as one technical qualification while preserving the distinction between the two constructions.

original_reasons.text: Parallel with rationally integral adjunction; the hyphenated Interslavic adjective keeps the construction readable as a single technical modifier.

title: algebraično-cěla zatvorenost
isv: Zatvorenost jest imenik za svojstvo zatvorjenosti; algebraično-cěla izrično ograničaje go na integralnost. Razlog jest zachovati tehničny modifikator, ne predstaviti opču zatvorjenost bez opreděljenogo smysla.
en: Zatvorenost names the closure property, while algebraično-cěla restricts it to integrality. The reason is to preserve that technical modifier rather than suggest an unspecified form of closure.

original_reasons.text: Modern closure language is used while preserving algebraic-integrality as the modifier.

title: algebraično-cěle / algebraično-drobne
isv: Cěly/drobny jest osnovna smyslova opozicija pasaže. Spojnik v algebraično-cěle i algebraično-drobne čini tehničnu pridavničnu konstrukciju vidimoju i zachovuje doslědnost s ranějšimi oddělami děla 9.
en: Integral/fractional is the passage's central contrast. Hyphenation makes the technical compound adjectives visible and maintains consistency with earlier sections of Paper 9.

original_reasons.text: The whole/fractional opposition is the conceptual hinge of the paragraph. Hyphenated Interslavic forms make the compound technical adjective visible and consistent with earlier Paper 09 sections.

title: algebraično-cěle substitucije / cěle algebraične čisla
isv: Substitucija jest kratko algebraično nazvanje transformacije. V oddělu o konečnyh grupah čisla v koeficientnyh poljah sut algebraično cěle; pridavnik cěle zato ima konkretny odborny smysl, ne opče značenje polnost.
en: Substitucija is retained as a compact algebraic transformation term. The finite-group section concerns algebraic integers in coefficient fields, so integral has a specific technical meaning rather than general completeness.

original_reasons.text: The finite-group section is about algebraic integers in coefficient fields. Interslavic keeps substitucija as a compact algebraic transformation term and uses cěle algebraične čisla for algebraic integers.

title: algebraično-cělo zatvorjena
isv: Algebraično-cělo ograničaje smysl zatvorjenosti i odliča go od topologičnoj zatvorjenosti. V dokazu protivrěčjem jest potrěbna imenno integralna zatvorjenost T. Ruske i ukrajinske zapisy dajut i doslovne i sučasne integralne vyraženja.
en: Algebraično-cělo specifies integral closedness rather than topological closure. The contradiction argument requires precisely this property of T. The Russian and Ukrainian records include both more literal and modern integral terminology.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use standard modern “integrally closed” terminology. Interslavic uses a transparent closed/затворјена calque and keeps algebraično-cělo to avoid ambiguity with topological closure.
The contradiction uses integral closedness of T, so closure under algebraic integrality stays explicit in every lane.

title: algebraično-cělo zavisi od [H,xi_i]
isv: Vyraženje zachovuje avtorsku leksiku algebraičnoj cělosti, ale označaje integralnu zavisimost nad pokazanoju oblastju [H,xi_i]. Oznaka oblasti jest čestju odnosa i ne može byti izostavjena.
en: The phrase retains the paper's algebraically-whole vocabulary while denoting integral dependence over the displayed domain [H,xi_i]. The domain identifier is part of the relation and cannot be omitted.

original_reasons.text: Rendered as integral dependence over the displayed domain, while preserving the algebraically-whole vocabulary of the paper.

title: algebraično-celočislene polinomy
isv: Tehničny pridavnik se odnosi na integralnost polinomialnyh koeficientov vzhledem na algebraično cěle čisla. Zapis izrično odliča to od obyčnoj racionalnoj cělosti; prěvod ne směje ztratiti osnovu tųh koeficientov.
en: The technical adjective concerns polynomial coefficient integrality over algebraic integers. The record explicitly distinguishes this from ordinary rational integrality; the coefficient setting must remain identifiable.

original_reasons.text: Marks polynomial coefficient integrality over algebraic integers, not ordinary rational integrality.

title: algebraično-cěly / racionalno-cěly
isv: Algebraično-cěly i racionalno-cěly ostavajut odvojene, ibo iztočnik razlikuje dva pojma. Spojnik pokazuje, že cěly jest čestju tehničnogo termina, ne obyčnym stilističnym usiljenjem.
en: The compounds remain distinct because the source distinguishes two concepts. Hyphenation indicates that cěly belongs to a technical designation rather than serving as an ordinary intensifier.

original_reasons.text: Hyphenated compounds preserve the source distinction and avoid reading “whole” as merely stylistic.

title: algebraično-drobno čislo
isv: Algebraično-drobno ostavjaje vidimu avtorsku razliku medžu algebraično cělymi i drobnymi čislami v uslovju dopustimosti. Spojnik veže obě česti v tehnično označenje; slovo drobno ne jest izostavjeno kako nepotrěbna stilistična čest.
en: The compound preserves Noether's contrast between algebraic integers and fractional algebraic numbers in the admissibility condition. Its fractional qualification is substantive, not a stylistic element that can be dropped.

original_reasons.text: Keeps Noether’s contrast between algebraic integers and fractional algebraic numbers visible in the admissibility condition.

title: algebraično-drobno čislo
isv: Iztočno uslovje izključaje imenno algebraično-drobne čisla. Prěvod zato zachovuje tu kvalifikaciju, vměsto opčej negacije integralnosti bez pojmovogo konteksta.
en: The condition excludes specifically algebraically fractional numbers. The wording retains this qualification rather than giving a context-free negation of integrality.

original_reasons.text: The side condition is exactly exclusion of such numbers, so fractional status remains visible in every lane.

title: algebraičny rang
isv: Rang jest karakteristično čislo iz opreděljenja II. Tri zapisy podpirajut doslědnost termina v dělu 6, osoblivo v oddělah 1 i 4. Zapis ne prědlaga zaměnu togo imenovanja novym opisnym slovom.
en: Rank is the characteristic number introduced by Definition II. Three records support consistent use across Paper 6, particularly Sections 1 and 4. They propose no new descriptive replacement for the designation.

original_reasons.text: Direct term; rank is the characteristic number introduced by Definition II.
Maintains the algebraic-rank lane fixed in Section 1.
Stable rank lane from Paper 06 Sections 1 and 4.

title: algebraičny rang (stepen transcendencije)
isv: Zaglavje zachovuje avtorsko objasnjenje v skobkah: algebraičny rang odpovědaje stepenju transcendencije. Internacionalna familija transcendencija jest izbrana vměsto novogo domorodnogo abstraktnogo imenika.
en: The wording retains the author's parenthetical equivalence between algebraic rank and transcendence degree. It uses the international transcendencija family rather than coining a new native abstract noun.

original_reasons.text: Keeps Noether's parenthetical equivalence explicit. Interslavic uses the international `transcendencija` family rather than attempting a new native abstraction.

title: algebraičny rang / polje ostatkovyh klasov
isv: Polje ostatkovyh klasov prodolžuje terminologiju odděla 3. Svaz s algebraičnym rangom jest potrěbny za aritmetično opreděljenje dimenzije v teoremu V. Oba termina ostavajut razpoznajeme v toj konstrukciji.
en: The residue-class-field expression continues Section 3's terminology. Its connection with algebraic rank is required for Theorem V's arithmetic definition of dimension. Both terms remain identifiable within that construction.

original_reasons.text: Carries forward Section 3's residue-class-field terminology and makes Theorem V's arithmetic definition of dimension explicit.

title: algebraičny rang ostavaje sohranjen
isv: Ostavaje sohranjen izrično govori, že dozvoljene substitucije ne menjajut algebraičny rang. Izvorny razlog podpira doslědnost s drugymi vyraženjami zachovanja, ale ne dava osobnu jezyčnu argumentaciju za sohranjen nasuprot drugym sinonimam.
en: The expression states explicitly that the permitted substitutions preserve algebraic rank. The reason invokes consistency with other preservation wording but provides no separate linguistic argument for sohranjen over its alternatives.

original_reasons.text: Preservation vocabulary follows prior Interslavic lane usage; the statement is a named property of the allowed substitutions.

title: antistrofna matrica
isv: Antistrofna matrica zachovuje istorično nazvanje svezano s Frobeniusom. Medžunarodna osnova dopuščaje čitatelju povezati prěvod s terminom v originalu. Zapis ne dava osnovu tiho zaměniti termin nekym sovrěmennym imenom matrice: takvo utočnjenje trěbovalo by zasebno sravnjenje definicij.
en: Antistrofna matrica retains the historical name associated with Frobenius. The international stem helps readers connect the translation with the original term. The record does not justify silently replacing it with a modern matrix name; that identification would require a separate comparison of definitions.

original_reasons.text: This is a historical Frobenius term. The form is transliterated as an international technical adjective rather than paraphrased, preserving source recoverability.

title: Aritmetična formulacija pojma dimenzije
isv: Aritmetična formulacija pojma dimenzije prědaje Fassung kako način formulovanja pojma, ne kako doslovnu metaforu. Kontekst veže dimenziju s lancami prostyh idealov. Naslov zato zachovuje i aritmetičny pristup, i to, že predmetom jest pojem dimenzije.
en: Aritmetična formulacija pojma dimenzije renders Fassung as a formulation of a concept rather than a literal metaphor. The context relates dimension to chains of prime ideals. The title preserves both the arithmetic approach and the fact that the subject is the concept of dimension.

original_reasons.text: Uses modern formulation language rather than a literal calque of Fassung. This matches the introduction's promise of an arithmetical formulation through chains of prime ideals.

title: aritmetična teorija algebraičnyh funkcij jednoj proměnnoj
source: Die arithmetische Theorie der algebraischen Funktionen einer Veränderlichen
russian: арифметическая теория алгебраических функций одной переменной
ukrainian: арифметична теорія алгебраїчних функцій однієї змінної
isv: Naslov zachovuje aritmetičnu teoriju, algebraične funkcije i omejenje do jednoj proměnnoj. Poredok slov jest prilagodženy običnoj matematičnoj konstrukciji, ne německoj sintaksi. Medžunarodne aritmetična i algebraična so slovjanskim proměnna davajut čitatelju tri glavne informacije o opsegu děla.
en: The title retains arithmetic theory, algebraic functions, and the restriction to one variable. Its word order follows an ordinary mathematical construction rather than German syntax. International aritmetična and algebraična together with Slavic proměnna carry the three principal scope qualifications.

original_reasons.text: Title phrase kept close to the German but in current mathematical word order. “Однієї/одной змінної/переменной” avoids older “one variable” calques; Interslavic uses international aritmetična/algebraična with proměnna for readability.

title: asociovany prost ideal
isv: Asociovany prost ideal jest svesno vybran kako tehnična nazva, v otličji od obščego prinaležny ili sootvětni. Arhiv opisuje zaměnu i v ukrajinskoj terminologiji; pet zapisov sut ponovjene upotrěby i proverky istogo izbora, ne pet nezavisnyh iznašlenij. Dlja primarnogo ideala q prosty ideal p jest jedinstveny: elementi p imajut neku stepenj v q, i tekst svazuje te idealy točnymi uslovjami dělitelnosti. Ta definicija, a ne slučajna blizost v tekstě, opravdava osobny termin.
en: Asociovany prost ideal was deliberately chosen as a technical term, in contrast to general prinaležny or sootvětni. The archive describes a corresponding Ukrainian terminology change; the five records concern repeated uses and checks of the same choice, not five independent inventions. For a primary ideal q, the prime ideal p is unique: its elements have some power in q, and the text relates the ideals through precise divisibility conditions. That definition, rather than incidental proximity in the prose, justifies a dedicated term.

comparisons.title_en: The technical sense of associated ideal
comparisons.text: Definicija oddělja termin od obščego odnosa.
comparisons.english: The definition distinguishes the term from a general relationship.

passages.quote: K vsakomu primarnomu idealu $\frakq$ jest jedin i samo jedin asociovany prost ideal $\frakp$, ktory jest dělitelj od $\frakq$ i čija potega jest dělima prěz $\frakq$, $\frakp\ne\frako$, $\frakp^\rho\equiv0\pmod{\frakq}$; pri tom $\frakp$ sostoji se iz vsih elementov prstena, čija někoja potega jest dělima prěz $\frakq$. Kako pokazuje oprěděljenje, vsaky prost ideal jest jednovremenno primarny ideal; pod vlastnymi primarnymi idealami razumějut se take, ktore ne sut jednovremenno proste idealy, za ktore zato $\rho>1$.

\textbf{12. Teorem razloženja.} Prědstavjenje $\fraka=[\frakq_1,\ldots,\frakq_s]$ ideala kako najmenše obče mnogokratno nazyva se najkratše, ako ni jeden $\frakq$ ne vhodi v najmenše obče mnogokratno ostalyh --- v svoj komplement; ono nazyva se prědstavjenje prěz največše primarne komponenty, ako vsaky $\frakq$ jest primarny, ale najmenše obče mnogokratno libovoljnyh dvoh $\frakq$ ne jest primarno. Vsaky ideal dopušča najkratše prědstavjenje prěz konečno mnogo največših primarnyh komponentov; pri dvoh različnyh takyh prědstavjenjah soglašajut se čislo komponentov i asociovane proste idealy, vse medžusobno različne. Tak jednoznačno oprěděljene proste idealy budut nazyvane prostymi idealami abo asociovanymi prostymi idealami ideala (Idealtheorie, teorem IX).

\textbf{13. Izolovane komponenty razloženja.} Ideal $\frakr=[\frakq_1,\ldots,\frakq_i]$ nazyva se izolovany komponent razloženja od $\fraka$, ako $\frakq_i$ nastupajut v prinajmenje jednom najkratšem prědstavjenju $\fraka$ prěz največše primarne komponenty i izpolnjajut uslovje, že ni jeden iz jih asociovanyh prostyh idealov ne vhodi v někoj iz ostalyh prostyh idealov od $\fraka$. Izolovane komponenty razloženja sut jednoznačno oprěděljene svojimi prostymi idealami; osoblivo sut izolovane največše primarne komponenty jednoznačno oprěděljene (Idealtheorie, teorem XIII).

\textbf{Teorem V.} \emph{Dimenzija prostogo ideala dana jest algebraičnym rangom jego polja ostatkovyh klasov. Najvyšša dimenzija ideala jest ravna najvyšemu iz dimenzijnyh čisel jego asociovanyh prostyh idealov.}

Prva čest Teorema V byla dokazana v prvoj primětce k Teoremu IV, kde bylo pokazano, že algebraičny rang polja ostatkovyh klasov $(\mathcal R)$ od $\frakp$ jest ravny dimenziji $\frakp$, v soglašenju s § 1, 8. Za dokaz drugoj česti nehaj $\frakm=[\frakq_1,\ldots,\frakq_a]$ bude najkratše prědstavjenje prěz največše primarne komponenty; togda najprvo nijedno $\frakq$, kako dělitelj od $\frakm$, ne može iměti vyšej dimenzije než $\frakm$. Produkt vsih $\frakq$ jest pak dělimy prěz $\frakm$, i zato takože produkt vsih form elementarnyh děliteljev pojedinyh $\frakq$; ako zato $n-i$ jest najvyše iz dimenzijnyh čisel $\frakq$, togda $\frakm$ sodrživaje polinom $G^{(i)}\ne0$, i zato takože ne može byti vyšej dimenzije než $n-i$. Dimenzijne čisla $\frakq$ po Teoremu I soglašajut se s tymi od jih asociovanyh prostyh idealov. Ako se bez vvedenja transformovanyh idealov definira dimenzija prostogo ideala prěz algebraičny rang polja ostatkovyh klasov, togda druga čest Teorema V daje definiciju najvyššej dimenzije libovoljnogo ideala.

title: asociovany prosty ideal / naležati k p
ukrainian: асоційований простий ідеал / належати до p
isv: Asociovany prosty ideal imenuje određeny oběkt, a naležati k p izražaje odnos cěloj familije primarnyh idealov k tomu oběktu. Tekst sam daje tu glosu: primarne idealy s tym samym asociovanym prostym idealom naležet k njemu. Proto nije potrěbno zaměniti vsako obyčno naležati tehničnym asociovati. Uvod razlikuje slabe i silne primarne idealy, a njihov spoj potrěbuje uslovje cěpov; jednostajna terminologija ne směje izbrisati tu hipotezu.
en: Asociovany prosty ideal names a particular object, while naležati k p relates a whole family of primary ideals to it. The text itself supplies the gloss: primary ideals with the same associated prime belong to that prime. There is therefore no need to replace every ordinary occurrence of belong with technical associate. The passage distinguishes weak and strong primary ideals, whose identification requires a chain condition; consistent wording must not erase that hypothesis.

title: Avtorin bibliografičny odkaz
source: in der Anmerkung 6, S. 83 zitierten Arbeit
russian: в работе, цитированной в примечании 6, с. 83
ukrainian: у праці, цитованій у примітці 6, с. 83
isv: V rabotě citovanoj v primětce 6, str. 83 sohranja bibliografičny odkaz vměsto da razvije polnu citaciju vnutri věty. Primětka raboty 31 odkazyvaje na Grellovu rabotu kak iztočnik dokazov pri prěhodu k prstenu kvocientov. Čislo primětky i stranica sut avtorine lokatory, ne avtomatično čisla nynějšego čitateljskogo PDF. Jih možno objasniti i povezati s bibliografijeju, ale ne tiho prenumerovati. Zapis pripisuje odkaz pečatnomu tekstu; sravnjenje korpusnoj primětky potrvrdžaje jejno nynějšne sodržanje, ne novu prověrku pečatnoj stranicy.
en: V rabotě citovanoj v primětce 6, str. 83 retains a bibliographic cross-reference rather than expanding the complete citation inside the sentence. The Paper 31 footnote directs readers to Grell's work for the proofs concerning passage to the quotient ring. Its note number and page are Noether's locators, not automatically numbers in the present reader PDF. They can be explained and linked to the bibliography, but must not be silently renumbered. The record attributes the reference to the printed text; comparison of the corpus footnote establishes its current content, not a fresh inspection of the printed page.

comparisons.text: Točka o prěhodu k prstenu kvocientov v rabotě 31 oprědělja, ktore elementy mogut byti v imenovatelju. Primětka pri toj točkě odkazyvaje na Grella i sohranja avtorin lokator primětka 6, str. 83. Definicija i odkaz imajut različne funkcije: prva oprědělja objekt, vtory ukazuje iztočnik dokazov. Ni jedno ne trěba izpustiti pri prěvodu.
comparisons.english: Paper 31's paragraph on passage to the quotient ring specifies which elements may occur in the denominator. Its footnote refers to Grell and retains Noether's locator note 6, p. 83. Definition and reference have different functions: one determines the object, the other identifies the source of proofs. Neither should disappear in translation.

passages.quote: \noindent 3. \emph{Prěhod k prstenu kvocientov.}\footnote{Za dokazy vsih tvrdženij, navedenyh v toj točki, srav. H. Grell (v rabotě citovanoj v primětce 6, str. 83).} Nehaj $\ma$ bude libovoljny ideal iz $\mo$. Prsten kvocientov $\mT_\ma$ jest oprěděljeno kako cělost elementov polja kvocientov od $\mT$, ktore imajut v imenovatelju element iz $\mT$, prosty k $\ma$.\footnote{Zato že proste idealy iz $\mT$ ne imajut vlastnyh děliteljev različnyh od jediničnogo ideala, tu "prosty k" stava identično s "vzajemno prosty" -- v idealnom smyslu.} Prsten $\mT_\ma$ ne ima, kromě nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala, drugyh prostyh idealov než razširjene idealy prostyh idealov, ktore prinaležet k $\ma$. Obstaje jednoznačna vzajemna korespondencija i izomorfizm prstenov klasov ostatkov medžu vsimi idealami iz $\mT_\ma$, različnymi od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala, i tymi idealami iz $\mT$, čiji odgovarjajuči prosty idealy nahodet se medžu prostymi idealami prinaležečimi k $\ma$; kromě togo, nulovy i jediničny ideal odpovědajut jednoznačno vzajemno.

title: Avtorova dodatna primětka
isv: Dodatna primětka jest naslov avtorovoj primětky poslě teoremy, ne novo objasnjenje prěvoditelja. Zapis daje prědnost prirodnoj opisnoj frazě prěd doslovnym prěvodom německogo Nachbemerkung; rusky i ukrajinsky ekvivalent takože podpirajut tu funkciju naslova. V §1 raboty 2 primětka sodrživaje izključenje k teoremě I, kogda dva ukazane parametry stanut nula. Ona utočnjaje, ktore kontrakcije ostavajut, kako razuměti red form i začto teoremy o reducentah ostavajut v silě. Dodatna zato ne znači nepotrěbna: primětka ograničava obseg prědhodečego tvrđenja. Kratky naslov primětka v drugom městě ima podobnu izložiteljnu funkciju, ale ne davaje pravo izgubiti tuty uslovja ili směšati avtorov tekst s redakcijnym komentarjem.
en: Dodatna primětka labels the author's subsequent note, not an explanation added by the translator. The record favors a natural descriptive phrase over a literal rendering of German Nachbemerkung; the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support that function. In §1 of Paper 2 the note gives an exception to Theorem I when two specified parameters become zero. It explains which contractions remain, how to understand the series of forms, and why the theorems concerning reducents still hold. Additional therefore does not mean dispensable: the note qualifies the preceding assertion. The shorter label primětka elsewhere serves a similar expository function, but does not justify dropping these conditions or confusing the author's text with editorial commentary.

comparisons.english: The supplementary note qualifies Theorem I; the short note introduces further relations. An expository heading does not license omission of mathematical conditions.

title: Avtorovo popravjenje: polja s konjugatami
source: Paper16 erratum: expanded fields with conjugates
russian: расширенные поля с сопряженными y и Y
ukrainian: розширені поля з спряженими y та Y
isv: To jest redakcijna odluka o priměnjenju avtorovogo popravjenja, ne novo nazvanje za polje. Arhiv govori o razširjenju izbranyh $(H,y)$ i $(H,Y)$ vsimi konjugatami do indeksa $\lambda_0-1$. Dostupna rabota 16 v prvom popravjenju navodi točny naslov ranějšej raboty, pečatne lokatory i zaměny; rabota 9, §7, už sodrživaje razširjene polja. Črty i gornje indekse tu označajut konjugate, ne derivacije ni obične stepeni. Zaměna měni osnovu razsudženja o medžupoljah i prěsěkah. Diplomatično izdanje ranějšej raboty i izdanje s priměnjenym popravjenjem morajut byti različene. Nynešnja sravniteljna prověrka čita prěvod popravjenja; ne predstavlja novu prověrku pečatnogo německogo iztočnika.
en: This is an editorial decision to apply an authorial correction, not a new name for a field. The record says selected $(H,y)$ and $(H,Y)$ are enlarged by all conjugates through index $\lambda_0-1$. The available Paper 16’s first correction names the earlier work, printed locators and replacements; Paper 9, §7, already contains the enlarged fields. Primes and parenthesized superscripts here label conjugates, not derivatives or ordinary powers. The change affects the argument about intermediate fields and intersections. A diplomatic edition of the earlier work and an edition incorporating the correction must be distinguished. The present comparison reads the translated correction; it does not claim a new examination of the printed German witness.

comparisons.text: Prvo popravjenje raboty 16 naznačaje ranějši naslov, pečatne lokatory i proširjene polja. Te liste konjugatov sut už prisutne v rabotě 9, §7. To podpiraje redakcijnu istoriju zapisanej zaměny, ale ne novu diplomatičnu prověrku pečatnogo originala.
comparisons.english: Paper 16’s first correction specifies the earlier title, printed locators and enlarged fields. Those conjugate lists are already present in Paper 9, §7. This supports the editorial history of the recorded replacement, but is not a new diplomatic comparison with the printed original.

passages.quote: Znano jest, že med $(H)$ i $(H,y,y',\ldots,y^{(\lambda_0-1)})$ leži samo
konečno mnogo medžupolj. Nehaj $\Omega_0=(H),\Omega_1,\ldots,\Omega_\sigma$
sut one med njimi, ktore imajut
primitivny element, racionalno izrazimy prěz $\vartheta$, tako že vsak element
polja stavaje racionalna funkcija od $\vartheta$; uslovje, ktore namanje za
$\Omega_0=(H)$ vždy jest izpolnjeno. Primitivna funkcija, naležeča k
oprěděljamo nerazložimo uravnenje, ktoro $Y$ izpolnjaje po odnošenju k polju
$\mathfrak K=(H;k_0(\vartheta),\ldots,k_\nu(\vartheta))$, nastavajučemu iz
oblasti koeficientov v (5); ono jest, kako znano, dano nerazložimym uravnenjem
$Y$ po odnošenju k prěsěčnomu polju polja $\mathfrak K$ i
$(H,Y,Y',\ldots,Y^{(\lambda_0-1)})$, ktore leži med $(H)$ i
$(H,Y,Y',\ldots,Y^{(\lambda_0-1)})$. Nyně
$(H,Y,Y',\ldots,Y^{(\lambda_0-1)})$ po (3) jest identično s
$(H,y,y',\ldots,y^{(\lambda_0-1)})$; zato že dalje vsi
elementy iz $\mathfrak K$, zato i vsi elementy prěsěčnogo polja, sut racionalno
izrazime prěz konečno mnogo $\vartheta$, to poslědnje polje mora byti dano
jednym iz polj $\Omega_0,\Omega_1,\ldots,\Omega_\sigma$, recimo
$\Omega_\tau$. Iskano nerazložimo uravnenje zato po (4) imaje stepen
Kogda nyně $\gamma$ proběgaje vsa algebraična čisla prědstavime prěz $Y$ i
$[\Theta]$, togda prěsěčno polje od $(H,Y,Y',\ldots,Y^{(\lambda_0-1)})$ i
naležečego polja $\mathfrak K$
vsegda proběgaje samo polja $\Omega_0,\Omega_1,\ldots,\Omega_\sigma$, i vsi

$Y$ k $[\Theta]$ ne može byti prědstavjeno nikako algebraično-drobno čislo}.
\textbf{Popravjenja.}

1. V rabotě \emph{Die allgemeinsten Bereiche aus ganzen transzendenten Zahlen} (\emph{Math. Ann.} 77), na s. 121, red 8 od vrha, red 9 od vrha i red 11 od dola, polje \((H,Y)\) trěba zaměniti na «polje \((H,Y,Y',\ldots,Y^{(\lambda_0-1)})\), kde \(Y',\ldots,Y^{(\lambda_0-1)}\) označajut spregnute od \(Y\) po odnošenju k \(H\)». Odgovarjajuče, na s. 120, red 5 od vrha, i s. 121, red 9 od vrha, \((H,y)\) trěba zaměniti na \((H,y,y',\ldots,y^{(\lambda_0-1)})\).

original_reasons.text: Applied editorially in the Section 07 translated reader lanes: selected (H,y) and (H,Y) fields are expanded through the conjugates up to exponent lambda_0-1. The base German slice remains unchanged and the decision is logged.

historical_form: razširjene polja s konjugatami y i Y

title: Avtorske ograničenje povtorjanih redukcij
isv: Dalej ne budut spominjane čuva avtorskym glasom oznajmenje o sposobu izloženja. V §25 raboty 2 ide točno o redukcijah, ktore neposrědnje nastavajut kontrakcijeju s reducentami ili razkladnymi formami; potrěbne daljše konstrukcije slědujut dalje. Zapisany razlog jest modernizacija prozy bez proměny toj ograničenoj odluki avtorky. Fraza ne jest instrukcija prěvoditelju, da može izpustiti težke dokazy, formulne kroky ili dokumentaciju svoji izborov. Njen obseg mora ostati svezany s navedenym razredom rutinnyh redukcij. Zato ona pripada pravilam izloženja v slovniku izborov, ne spisku novyh matematičnyh imenikov.
en: Dalej ne budut spominjane preserves an announcement, in the author's voice, about the exposition. Paper 2, §25 refers specifically to reductions obtained directly by contraction with reducers or decomposable forms; further constructions still follow. The recorded reason is to modernize the prose without changing this limited authorial decision. The sentence is not an instruction permitting a translator to omit difficult proofs, formula steps or documentation of translation choices. Its scope must remain attached to the specified class of routine reductions. It therefore belongs among expository choices, not in a list of newly coined mathematical nouns.

comparisons.title_en: The author's limited statement about reductions
comparisons.text: Odluka ne ponavljati rutinne redukcije ne jest dozvoljenje izpustiti drugy tekst.
comparisons.english: The decision not to repeat routine reductions is not permission to omit other text.

passages.quote: \noindent\textit{Redukcije:} Redukcije, ktore nastavajut prěz neposrědnje kontrakciju s reducentami abo razkladnymi formami, dalej ne budut spominjane.
\mbox{B)} Razklad $((aHu)H_j,s,u)$ i $(a_\eta(aHu)H_j,s,u)$ kako transvekcija prěz funkcionalne determinanty.

original_reasons.text: Modernizes the prose while preserving Noether's instruction that routine direct reductions are no longer listed.

title_en: Authorial restriction on repeating routine reductions

title: Avtorstvo dodatka
source: mit einem Zusatz, gemeinsam mit E. Noether
russian: с добавлением, совместно с Э. Нётер
ukrainian: з додатком, спільно з Е. Нетер
isv: Zapis o dodatku k Kapfererovoj rabotě pripisyvaje sovměstnu rabotu s E. Noether dodatku, ne avtomatično cělomu članku. To jest sučstvenny razlog arhivnogo izbora: čuvati granicu avtorstva. Arhiv imaje společně s, nynějšna bibliografija spolu s; slovnik pokazuje obě formy bez prěpisyvanja bibliografičnoj zaslugy. Cěla primětka dolžna ostati vezana s dodatkom. Spisok dvoh avtorov bez toj primětki byl by kratši, ale skryl by informaciju, ktoru zapis izrično hoče čuvati.
en: The note about the supplement to Kapferer's paper attributes joint work with E. Noether to the supplement, not automatically to the whole article. Preserving that authorship boundary is the substantive reason recorded for the choice. The archive has společně s and the current bibliography spolu s; the dictionary shows both forms without reallocating bibliographical credit. The whole note must remain attached to the supplement. A bare list of two authors would be shorter but would suppress the information the record expressly seeks to preserve.

comparisons.text: Bibliografija pripisyvaje glavnu rabotu H. Kapfereru i dodava primětku o dodatku spolu s E. Noether. Spolu jest nynějšna forma; arhivny zapis společně ne měnjaje obseg sovměstnogo avtorstva.
comparisons.english: The bibliography attributes the main paper to H. Kapferer and adds a note about a supplement jointly with E. Noether. Spolu is the current wording; the archived společně does not change the scope of joint authorship.

passages.quote: \noindent\textbf{Potrěbne i dostatočne uslovja mnogokratnosti k Neterovomu}\\
\textbf{fundamentalnomu teoremu algebraičnyh funkcij: H.\ Kapferer}\\
\textbf{(s dodatkom, spolu s E.\ Noether).}\\
\foreign{Math.\ Ann.} \textbf{97} (1927), S.~559--567

original_reasons.text: The authorship note is source-sensitive. It marks a supplement jointly with Noether and should not be flattened into ordinary coauthorship of the whole Kapferer item.

historical_form: s dodatkom, společně s E. Noether

title: baza direktnoj sumy / blokovo-diagonalna diskriminantna matrica
source: Basis der direkten Summe / blockdiagonale Diskriminantenmatrix
russian: база прямой суммы / блочно-диагональная дискриминантная матрица
ukrainian: база прямої суми / блоково-діагональна дискримінантна матриця
isv: Baza direktnoj sumy i blokovo-diagonalna diskriminantna matrica imenujut svezane, ale različne objekty dokaza. Matrica opiraje se na izbranu bazu; početno oznaka $S_{(a)}$ nastupaje v obojih blokah, poslě čego slědy komponentov sut identifikovane. Prěvod ne trěbuje prědčasno zaměniti avtorske oznaky gotovym zaključkom o komponentah.
en: Baza direktnoj sumy and blokovo-diagonalna diskriminantna matrica name related but distinct objects in the proof. The matrix depends on the chosen basis. The notation initially uses $S_{(a)}$ in both blocks before identifying the component traces. The translation should not replace the author's notation prematurely with the conclusion about the components.

original_reasons.text: Records the scan-restored determinant display as a proof object. The display starts with S_(a) on both blocks and then identifies the component traces.

title: baza diskriminantnogo ideala
isv: Baza diskriminantnogo ideala sohranja bazu kak avtorino nazvanje i genitivom točno ukazuje objekt. V §8 raboty 31 konečno mnogo determinantov tvoret taku bazu, zato že ostale potrebne determinanty izražajut se jih kombinacijami. Tekst dopušča modulnu bazu s količstvom elementov $m\ge n$ i posebno razgleduje slučaj linearno nezavisnoj bazy iz $n$ elementov. To razlikovanje pokazyvaje, začto obča baza ideala ne mora byti linearno nezavisna. Vybor ne jest samo doslovny kalk: on sohranja termin i istočasno potrěbuje objašnjenja jegovogo istoričnogo smysla.
en: Baza diskriminantnogo ideala retains basis as Noether's designation and identifies its object precisely through the genitive. In Paper 31, §8, finitely many determinants form such a basis because the other required determinants can be expressed as their combinations. The text allows a module basis with $m\ge n$ elements and separately treats the case of a linearly independent basis of $n$ elements. That distinction shows why an ideal basis need not generally be linearly independent. The choice is not merely a literal calque: it preserves the term while requiring an explanation of its historical sense.

comparisons.title_isv: Baza ne vsegda znači linearno nezavisnu bazu
comparisons.title_en: Basis does not always mean a linearly independent basis
comparisons.text: §8 raboty 31 dopušča modulnu bazu s $m\ge n$ elementami. Potrěbne determinanty linearno izražajut se prěz konečno mnogo determinantov iz te bazy; ony tvorjat bazu diskriminantnogo ideala. Slučaj linearno nezavisnoj modulnoj bazy iz $n$ elementov jest razgledany odvojeno. Ta izrična razlika daje čitatelju možlivosť razuměti istoričnu polisemičnost bazy bez izměnjenja avtorinogo nazvanja.
comparisons.english: Paper 31, §8, allows a module basis of $m\ge n$ elements. The required determinants are linear combinations of finitely many determinants drawn from that basis, which generate the discriminant ideal. A linearly independent module basis of $n$ elements is considered separately. This explicit distinction lets readers understand the historical polysemy of basis without replacing Noether's designation.

passages.quote: Nehaj dalje $\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_m$ pri $m\ge n$ bude (vsegda obstojna)\footnote{\emph{Idealtheorie}, §9 i §3, 1.} $\mo$-modulna baza od $\mT$. Togda konečno mnogo determinantov, ktore odgovarjajut izboru libovoljnyh $n$ elementov sredi $\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_m$, tvoret bazu togo diskriminantnogo ideala. To slěduje iz modulne homomorfnosti od $\mT$ k sistemě slědov iz $\mT$ (§4, 3). V samoj stvari determinanty, utvorjene iz produktov $\tau_i\tau_j$, sut linearno prědstavime s koeficientami iz $\mo$ prěz konečno mnogo determinantov $|S(\beta_i\beta_j)|$, ktore odgovarjajut $n$ elementam $\beta$; zato to samo imaje město za $|S(\tau_i\tau_j)|$ po odnošenju k $|S(\beta_i\beta_j)|$. Ako osoblivo poredok imaje linearno nezavisnu modulnu bazu $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$, togda determinant $|S(\alpha_i\alpha_j)|$ može byti vzety kako baza diskriminantnogo ideala; definicija se pokryva s definicijeju v §7, 1.

original_reasons.text: Uses basis language instead of silently converting to a modern generating-set paraphrase; this matches the source's Idealbasis while remaining readable.

title: baza ideala
isv: Baza ideala sohranja istorijsko upotrěbljenje bazy za konečnu tvorjaču sovkupnost ideala v rabotě 22. Tu baza ne potrěbuje linearnoj nezavisnosti kak baza vektornogo prostora. Genitiv ideala čini nositelja bazy izričnym, a rusky bazis i ukrajinska baza davajut sravnitelnu oporu. Taka prozračnost ne odstranja polisemičnosti: ekspert mora viděti definiciju, a čitatelj mora byti prěduprědženy o različnyh smyslah bazy. Izraz tvorjača sovkupnost možno upotrěbiti v objašnjenju; ne trěba tiho podměnjati im avtorino historično nazvanje.
en: Baza ideala preserves the historical use of basis for a finite generating set of an ideal in Paper 22. Here basis need not carry the linear-independence condition of a vector-space basis. The genitive ideala makes the object explicit, while Russian bazis and Ukrainian baza supply comparative support. This transparency does not remove the polysemy: an expert needs the definition, and a reader needs to see the different senses of basis. Generating set can be used in the explanation without silently replacing Noether's historical designation.

comparisons.title_isv: Baza ne vsegda znači linearno nezavisnu bazu
comparisons.title_en: Basis does not always mean a linearly independent basis
comparisons.text: §8 raboty 31 dopušča modulnu bazu s $m\ge n$ elementami. Potrěbne determinanty linearno izražajut se prěz konečno mnogo determinantov iz te bazy; ony tvorjat bazu diskriminantnogo ideala. Slučaj linearno nezavisnoj modulnoj bazy iz $n$ elementov jest razgledany odvojeno. Ta izrična razlika daje čitatelju možlivosť razuměti istoričnu polisemičnost bazy bez izměnjenja avtorinogo nazvanja.
comparisons.english: Paper 31, §8, allows a module basis of $m\ge n$ elements. The required determinants are linear combinations of finitely many determinants drawn from that basis, which generate the discriminant ideal. A linearly independent module basis of $n$ elements is considered separately. This explicit distinction lets readers understand the historical polysemy of basis without replacing Noether's designation.

passages.quote: Nehaj dalje $\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_m$ pri $m\ge n$ bude (vsegda obstojna)\footnote{\emph{Idealtheorie}, §9 i §3, 1.} $\mo$-modulna baza od $\mT$. Togda konečno mnogo determinantov, ktore odgovarjajut izboru libovoljnyh $n$ elementov sredi $\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_m$, tvoret bazu togo diskriminantnogo ideala. To slěduje iz modulne homomorfnosti od $\mT$ k sistemě slědov iz $\mT$ (§4, 3). V samoj stvari determinanty, utvorjene iz produktov $\tau_i\tau_j$, sut linearno prědstavime s koeficientami iz $\mo$ prěz konečno mnogo determinantov $|S(\beta_i\beta_j)|$, ktore odgovarjajut $n$ elementam $\beta$; zato to samo imaje město za $|S(\tau_i\tau_j)|$ po odnošenju k $|S(\beta_i\beta_j)|$. Ako osoblivo poredok imaje linearno nezavisnu modulnu bazu $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$, togda determinant $|S(\alpha_i\alpha_j)|$ može byti vzety kako baza diskriminantnogo ideala; definicija se pokryva s definicijeju v §7, 1.

original_reasons.text: Uses the normal modern noun in each language while leaving the algebraic object visible. Russian keeps bazis; Ukrainian uses baza in the text’s finite generating set sense.

title: baza razširjenogo ideala diskriminantnogo ideala
isv: Baza razširjenogo ideala diskriminantnogo ideala zachovuje vse stupeni imennikovej konstrukcije: govori se o bazě ideala dobivenogo razširjenjem diskriminantnogo ideala. V lokalnom prstenu toj ideal jest glavny, zato poraždajuči element mogl by razjasniti funkciju bazy. Izvorna odluka odnak zachovuje baza; takvo objasnjenje ne trěba predstavljati kako už priměnjenu zaměnu.
en: Baza razširjenogo ideala diskriminantnogo ideala retains the nested construction: the basis belongs to the extension of the discriminant ideal. In the local ring that ideal is principal, so generator could clarify the function of Basis. The recorded choice nevertheless retains baza; the explanatory possibility must not be represented as an already adopted replacement.

original_reasons.text: Keeps Noether's 'basis' language because the local ring is principal; later final polishing can decide whether to add a generator gloss.

title: baza za tvorjenje slěda
isv: Tvorjenje slěda govori o konstrukciji slěda s pomočju bazy. Izbor tvorjenje izběgaje avtomatično upotrěbjenje poraždati, ktore v susědnem izlaganju ima osobnu funkciju pri idealah. Dve operacije ne dobivajut isto nazvanje samo zato, že německo Erzeugung može nastupati pri obojih.
en: Tvorjenje slěda refers to constructing the trace using a basis. Tvorjenje avoids automatically reusing poraždati, which has a particular role in the nearby ideal-theoretic discussion. The two operations do not receive the same name merely because German Erzeugung can be used for both.

original_reasons.text: `Constructing/producing the trace` reads naturally in modern Ukrainian/Russian; Interslavic `tvorjenje` avoids overloading the logged ideal-generation verb `poraždati`.

title: bazis modula / konečny bazis modula
isv: Bazis modula jest imenna konstrukcija s genitivom, v sravnjenju s pridevnikovym modulna baza. Arhivny razlog ne dava čislove ocěnky dvoh oblikov; on objašnjaje, začto čuvati slovo bazis: v §6 raboty 17 konečno mnogo izbranyh elementov dozvoljaje predstaviti cěly sistem linearnymi kombinacijami. Konečny odnosi se k spisku generatorov, ne k čislu elementov v oblasti. V prověrenom tekste stojí modulny bazis. Množiteli $A_{ij}$ v zapise $F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j$ stojat s lěvoj strany; uslovja na nekomutativne koeficientne zakony ne smějut byti izgubjene. Toj konečny bazis ne jest avtomatično nezavisnym bazisom proizvoljnogo modula.
en: Bazis modula is a noun with a genitive complement, as opposed to adjectival modulna baza. The archived reason supplies no numerical ranking of these forms; it explains why basis is retained: in §6 of Paper 17 finitely many selected elements express the whole system by linear combinations. Konečny concerns the list of generators, not the number of elements in the ambient domain. The checked text has modulny bazis. The multipliers $A_{ij}$ in $F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j$ stand on the left; the hypotheses governing the noncommutative coefficient laws must not disappear. This finite basis is not automatically an independent basis of an arbitrary module.

comparisons.title_en: Finite generation with coefficients on the left
comparisons.text: V §6 raboty 17 zapis $F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j$ oprěděljaje ulogu konečnogo bazisa. Lokalni zakony za koeficienty sut častju uslovij; to ne jest bezuslovny teorem o proizvoljnom nekomutativnom prstenu.
comparisons.english: In §6 of Paper 17, $F_i=\sum A_{ij}G_j$ specifies the role of a finite basis. The local coefficient laws are part of the hypotheses; this is not an unconditional theorem about an arbitrary noncommutative ring.

passages.quote: V tom paragrafu trěba pokazati, že vsaku grupu ostatkov možno prědstaviti kako sumu konečno mnogyh ireducibilnyh sostavnyh česti. Za to najprvo prenosimo Hilbertov teorem o modulnom bazisu.
Od nyně koristimo specijalnejše prědpoloženja formulovane v \S~2: množenje \(\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_n\) medžu soboju jest komutativno, a zakon množenja polinomov ima formu
\xi_i a=a_i\xi_i+b_i,
\tag{6}

Dosta jest provesti dokaz samo za moduly. Zato že ako \(\mS\) jest kaka-koli sistema polinomov, tvorimo iz nje izvedeny modul \(\mM\), dodavajuči k \(\mS\) vse polinomy, ktore možno sostaviti iz konečno mnogyh polinomov \(G_1,\ldots,G_k\) iz \(\mS\) v formě \(A_1G_1+\cdots+A_kG_k\). Ako nyně \(F_1,\ldots,F_l\) jest modulny bazis od \(\mM\), i ako
F_i=\sum_j A_{ij}G_j\qquad(i=1,\ldots,l),
togda konečno mnoge polinomy \(G_j\), ktore nastupajut v tyh prědstavjenjah, tvoret bazis od \(\mS\).

original_reasons.text: The word basis is kept because Section 6 uses explicit linear-combination representations by finitely many chosen elements. The adjective finite/konečny is attached to the chosen generating list, not to the ambient system.

title: bazisna funkcija
isv: Bazisna funkcija imenuje funkciju, ktora nastupaje v konstrukciji determinanty $\Delta$ i kvadratnyh form v modulu $M$. Izbor zachovuje vezu s bazoju, ne zaměnjaje funkciju neoprěděljenym elementom. Konkretna upotrěba jest važnějša od samej podobnosti internacionalnyh korenj.
en: Bazisna funkcija names a function used in constructing the determinant $\Delta$ and the quadratic forms in the module $M$. The choice preserves the connection with a basis without replacing function by an unspecified element. The particular use matters more than resemblance between international roots.

original_reasons.text: Used for the determinant Delta and for quadratic forms in the module M. The direct basis-function wording keeps the construction visible.

title: bazova veličina
isv: Bazova veličina zachovuje avtorske različenje medžu veličinoju i čislom v priměru zaměny. Zapis prodolžaje upotrěbjenje iz devetoj raboty i ne modernizuje avtomatično veličina do element. Takva modernizacija mogla by skryti to, kako sam avtor organizuje svoje objekty.
en: Bazova veličina preserves the author's distinction between a quantity and a number in the substitution example. It continues the usage of the ninth paper rather than automatically modernizing quantity to element. That modernization could hide the author's own organization of the objects.

original_reasons.text: Distinguishes a basis element/quantity from the earlier phrase basis number; source uses Größe in the replacement example.
Continues the Paper 09 policy of keeping Noether's basis-quantity language instead of silently converting it to basis element.

title: bazovo svojstvo
isv: Bazovo svojstvo upučaje na svojstva 1–5, ktore sut dane v uvodu pri opisu bazy. Bazovo zato trěba čitati v svezě s bazoju, ne kako svobodno tvrđenje, že svojstvo jest fundamentalno ili posebno važno. Točna lokalna referencija razděljuje tehničny i običny smysl pridavnika.
en: Bazovo svojstvo refers to properties 1–5 used in the introduction to characterize the basis. Bazovo is therefore connected with a basis, not a free assertion that the property is fundamental or especially important. The local reference distinguishes the technical from the everyday sense of the adjective.

original_reasons.text: Continues introduction wording for properties 1)--5); avoids “fundamental property,” which would broaden the term.

title: beskonečno blizke točke / točke razvětvenja
isv: Zapis razuměje aufeinanderfolgende Punkte v tom geometriskom kontekstu kako beskonečno blizke točke, ne prosto točke, ktore slědujut jedna po drugoj. To jest kontekstualno tolkovanje svezano s razmatranjem osoblivostij v tradiciji Brilla i Noether. Točke razvětvenja zachovujut drugu čest para. Takvo tolkovanje ne može služiti kako obči slovničny ekvivalent za vsako aufeinanderfolgend.
en: The record interprets aufeinanderfolgende Punkte in this geometric context as infinitely near points, not merely points in a sequence. This is a contextual reading tied to the discussion of singularities in the Brill-Noether tradition. Točke razvětvenja retains the second term, branching points. The interpretation is not a general dictionary equivalent of aufeinanderfolgend.

original_reasons.text: For the Brill-Noether geometric term, “infinitely near points” is used rather than a literal “successive points”; it matches modern algebraic-geometry usage and makes the later singularity discussion intelligible.

title: beskonečno mnogo razkladov
isv: Beskonečno mnogo razkladov sohranjaje i čislo možnostij, i vid operacije. Ide o različne sumné prědstavjenja grupy, ne o beskonečno mnogo faktorov v jednom produktu. Dokaz upotrěbljaje prinajmenje dvě izomorfne podgrupy i beskonečno mnogo konstant koeficientnoj oblasti, ktore komutujut s operatorami. Tih uslovij ne možno opustiti. Slovo beskonečno ne vybira medžu prebrojimoju i neprebrojimoju množinoju razkladov; takova dodatna ocěna ne jest zapisana v terminologičnom izboru.
en: Beskonečno mnogo razkladov preserves both the number of possibilities and the operation involved. These are distinct sum representations of the group, not infinitely many factors in a single product. The proof uses at least two isomorphic subgroups and infinitely many constants of the coefficient domain commuting with the operators. Those conditions must remain. Infinitely many does not choose between a countable and an uncountable collection of decompositions; the terminology record makes no such additional cardinality claim.

comparisons.text: Izomorfne sumandy i beskonečno mnogo konstant ostajut čest teorema.
comparisons.english: Isomorphic summands and infinitely many constants remain part of the theorem.

original_reasons.text: Section10 promotes non-uniqueness into an existence theorem for infinitely many decompositions. The target choices keep the countability-neutral “infinitely many” wording and the established decomposition term rather than replacing it by factorization.

title: Bez povtorjenja i točno jedin raz
source: ohne Wiederholung / einmal und nur einmal
russian: без повторения / один раз и только один раз
ukrainian: без повторення / один і тільки один раз
isv: Bez povtorjenja i jedin raz i samo jedin raz čuvajut različne, povězane česti tvrdženja: nepovtorjanje i cělo objimanje. Arhiv izrično odvrgaje njih razgledanje kako pustogo stila. V rabotě 9, §8, osnovny seznam ima po jednom polju iz vsakoj izomorfnej klasy. Potom konstrukcija pro jednu klasu davaje vse različne polja v toj klasě, každo samo jedin raz. Jedin prědstavitelj klasy zato ne znači isto kako jedin pojav vsakogo polja v klasě. Izraz bez povtorjenja sam ne garantuje, že žadno polje ne jest izpuščeno; jedin raz i samo jedin raz vyražaje i postojanje i jedinstvenost pojavu. Ta razlika potrěbuje čitanje cěloj konstrukcije, ne samo zaměnu sinonimov.
en: Bez povtorjenja and jedin raz i samo jedin raz preserve related but distinct parts of the assertion: non-repetition and exhaustive coverage. The record expressly rejects treating them as mere style. In Paper 9, §8, the initial list has one field from each isomorphism class. The subsequent construction for a class gives all distinct fields in that class, each once. One representative of a class therefore does not mean the same thing as one occurrence of every field in it. Without repetition alone does not guarantee that no field is omitted; once and only once expresses both existence and uniqueness of occurrence. The distinction requires reading the whole construction, not merely substituting synonyms.

comparisons.title_isv: Prědstavitelj klasy i každo polje v klasě
comparisons.title_en: A class representative and every field within a class
comparisons.text: Rabota 9, §8, počinaje iz prědstaviteljev izomorfnyh klasov i dalje izčisljaje različne polja v každoj klasě. Nepovtorjanje i cělost izčislenja trěba prověriti na pravom urovnju. Zato objašnjenje ne sklada vse pojavy slova prědstavitelj v jeden nerazličen smysl.
comparisons.english: Paper 9, §8, starts from representatives of isomorphism classes and proceeds to enumerate distinct fields within each class. Non-repetition and completeness must be checked at the correct level. The explanation therefore does not collapse every representative-related formulation into one undifferentiated sense.

Iz vsakoj fiksovanoj oblasti $\mathfrak G_i$ iz $\mathfrak L(\mathfrak G)$

$\mathfrak R_i$ tym, že v $\mathfrak G_i$ i v jego konjugatah po odnošenju k

original_reasons.text: This is the uniqueness requirement for representatives, not mere style. All lanes preserve both the no-repetition and exactly-once formulations.

historical_form: bez povtorjenja / jedin raz i samo jedin raz

title: bezbazisna forma
isv: Bezbazisna forma označaje formulaciju, ktora ne trěbuje izričnogo opiranja na konečnu bazu ideala. Zapis veže ju s možnostju formulacije črěz teorem o konečnosti lancov. Termin ne govori, že razmatrany objekt nema bazy; govori o načinu izlaganja tvrđenja.
en: Bezbazisna forma names a formulation that does not explicitly rely on a finite ideal basis. The record relates it to a formulation through the finite-chain theorem. The term does not say that the object has no basis; it describes the way the assertion is expressed.

original_reasons.text: A compact literal term is appropriate: the closing sentence says the finite-chain theorem can replace the finite ideal-basis formulation.

title: Bibliografičny kredit za učestje
isv: S učestjem znači s prinosom ili učestjem imenovanoj osoby. Bibliografična rubrika obhvačaje knjigy drugih avtorov, v izdanju ktoryh Emmy Noether učestvovala: zapisy za Dedekinda i Cantora osobno imenujut vydavatelje. Fraza ne čini ju jedinoju avtoriceju tih knjig ni jedinym redaktorom. Izbor čuva točnu razliku medžu avtorstvom i učestjem. Takovy kredit dolžen ostati pri prěvodu zaglavij i pri preuređenju bibliografije.
en: S učestjem means with the contribution or participation of the named person. The bibliographic category includes books by other authors in whose publication Emmy Noether participated: the Dedekind and Cantor entries separately name the editors. The phrase does not make her the sole author of those books or their sole editor. The choice preserves the distinction between authorship and participation. That credit must survive translation of headings and rearrangement of the bibliography.

comparisons.text: Rubrika i konkretne kredity imenujut različne ulogy.
comparisons.english: The heading and individual credits name different roles.

passages.quote: \section*{Knjigy, sostavjene s učestjem Emmy Noether}
\item R.\ Dedekind, \textit{Sobrane matematične děla} I--III. Izdali R.\ Fricke, Emmy Noether i \foreign{Øystein Ore}. \foreign{Vieweg}, \foreign{Braunschweig} 1930--1932\\
\item G.\ Cantor, \textit{Listovanje s R.\ Dedekind.} Izdali Emmy Noether i \foreign{J.\ Cavaillès}, 60 stranic. \foreign{Actualités scient.\ et ind.} 581, Paris 1937

original_reasons.text: Participation/contribution is the correct bibliographic relation; it does not assert primary authorship or editorial sole responsibility.

title: Bibliografičny titul i lokalna oznaka stranic
source: Sitz. Ber. d. Preuß. Akad. d. Wiss. 1927, S. 221--228
russian: citation preserved with Russian page marker с.
ukrainian: citation preserved with Ukrainian page marker с.
isv: Sitz. Ber. d. Preuß. Akad. d. Wiss. jest skračeny titul periodičnogo izdanja, ne matematičny termin za prěvod. Zapisany izbor čuva titul i bibliografične čisla, ale lokalizuje S. kako str.; ruska i ukrajinska verzija imajut c. za stranicu. Nynějšny početok raboty 32 potvrđuje 1927, str. 221--228 i sovavtorstvo R. Brauera. Čitatelj tako može najdti original, a obyčna oznaka stranic ne trěbuje znanja němčiny. Redakcijne razsmotrenje jedinstvenogo bibliografičnogo stila ne dava prava odstraniti ime sovavtora ili zameniti iztočnik novym izdanjem bez objašnjenja.
en: Sitz. Ber. d. Preuß. Akad. d. Wiss. is an abbreviated periodical title, not mathematical vocabulary to translate. The recorded choice preserves the title and bibliographic numbers but localizes S. as str.; the Russian and Ukrainian versions use their page abbreviation c. The current opening of paper 32 confirms 1927, pp. 221--228 and coauthorship with R. Brauer. A reader can therefore locate the original without needing German to understand the ordinary page label. Review for a consistent bibliographic style does not authorize removing a coauthor or substituting a later edition without explanation.

comparisons.text: Lokalizovana oznaka stranic čuva identitet publikacije i sovavtorstvo.
comparisons.english: The localized page label preserves the publication's identity and coauthorship.

passages.quote: \section*{32. Sovmestno s R. Brauerom: O minimalnyh razpadnyh poljah nerazložimyh prědstavjenij}
\emph{\foreign{Sitz. Ber. d. Preuß. Akad. d. Wiss. 1927, str. 221--228.}}
\begin{center}\emph{(Predloženo g. Šurom.)}\end{center}

original_reasons.text: The periodical title is a bibliographic citation, so the German abbreviated title is preserved while the page marker is localized by lane. This remains flagged for possible bibliographic normalization review in the cumulative edition.

title_en: Bibliographic title and localized page label
historical_form: citation preserved with page marker str.

title: bibliografija
isv: Bibliografija imenuje funkciju završnogo spiska citovanyh děl. Izbor medžunarodnogo imennika odgovarja ruskoj i ukrajinskoj paralelě i ne trěbuje dolgu opisnu zaměnu. Izvorni razlog govori o izběganju dvojsmyslenosti, ne o posebnom slovotvornom novotvoru.
en: Bibliografija identifies the function of the concluding list of cited works. The international noun matches the Russian and Ukrainian parallels without a lengthy descriptive substitute. The recorded reason concerns avoiding ambiguity, not creating a novel technical word.

original_reasons.text: A direct international noun is the least ambiguous choice in all three lanes and matches the function of the terminal list.

title: bilinearne kombinacije
isv: Kombinacije jest točnějše od neoprěděljenyh svezij, ibo formuly zaměnjajut dane izrazy bilinearnymi izrazami v $u$ i $v$. Bilinearne zachovuje važnu algebraičnu kvalifikaciju. Razlog izbora zato leži v funkciji formuly, ne samo v podobnosti medžunarodnogo termina.
en: Kombinacije is more specific than vague connections because the formulas replace the given expressions by bilinear expressions in $u$ and $v$. Bilinearne retains the essential algebraic qualification. The choice is grounded in what the formulas do, not simply in the international term's familiar appearance.

original_reasons.text: Rendered as combinations rather than vague connections to match the formula-level role of replacing (u_{mu u}) by bilinear expressions in (u) and (v).

title: bimodul
isv: Bimodul jest medžunarodno nazvanje, izbrano vměsto doslovnogo dvojny modul radi kratkosti i tehničnoj prepoznavajemosti. Dva razloga izrično sravnjavajut ty dve formy. Ih izbor razlikuje se od ranějšego dvomodul i od definicijnogo dvojny modul; ne možno pripisati vsim zapisam jednu prednost bez dalšego sravnjenja.
en: Bimodul is the international name chosen over literal dvojny modul for brevity and technical recognizability. Two rationales explicitly compare those alternatives. Their choice differs from earlier dvomodul and from dvojny modul in the defining passage; the records cannot all be assigned one preference without further comparison.

original_reasons.text: Uses the modern algebraic loan in Ukrainian/Russian and a controlled internationalism in Interslavic; the older literal double-module sense is documented in logbooks but not used in running prose.

Modern mathematical usage favors bimodule in Ukrainian and Russian. Interslavic takes the same international technical term because it is short, transparent to Slavic mathematical readers, and avoids an artificial periphrasis such as 'double module'.

title: binarna forma / binarna linearna forma
isv: Binarna forma i binarna linearna forma imajut istu strukturu nazvanja; linearna izrično odliča užši slučaj. Izvorni razlog daje prednost kratkoj medžunarodnoj terminologiji i sravnjaje ju s ruskoju i ukrajinskoju matematičnoju formoju. On ne dava novy lokalny sinonim, ktory by trěboval dodatno objasnjenje.
en: Binarna forma and binarna linearna forma share the same naming structure, with linearna explicitly identifying the narrower case. The recorded reason favours compact international terminology, compared with the Russian and Ukrainian mathematical forms, rather than introducing a new local synonym requiring explanation.

original_reasons.text: International binary/linear terminology is stable in modern Slavic mathematical prose and compact in Interslavic.

title: binarne rědy / rědy proměnnyh
isv: Rědy proměnnyh trěba čitati v simboličnom jazyku teorije invariantov. Izbor rědy zachovuje avtorske grupovanje proměnnyh i ne vnosi avtomatično analitičny smysl beskonečnogo sumovanja. Binarne ostavaje konkretnoju kvalifikacijeju teh redov, ne občim imenovanjem vsakoj poslědovatelnosti.
en: Rědy proměnnyh must be read in the symbolic language of invariant theory. Rědy preserves the author's grouping of variables without automatically importing the analytic sense of infinite summation. Binarne remains the particular qualification of those rows, not a generic name for every sequence.

original_reasons.text: Noether's Reihen are rows or series of variables in the symbolic invariant-theory sense. Using row/series rather than generic sequence avoids importing an analytic meaning.

title: biracionalna transformacija
isv: Biracionalna transformacija zachovuje obostrannu racionalnu obnovimost baz: jedna racionalna baza može byti vyražena črěz drugu i obratno. Izbor medžunarodnogo termina drži tu obostrannost v kratkom nazvanju. Prosto racionalna transformacija ne by izrično zachovala istu informaciju.
en: Biracionalna transformacija preserves mutual rational recoverability of the bases: one rational basis can be expressed through the other and conversely. The international term retains that two-way condition in a short name. Merely rational transformation would not express the same information.

original_reasons.text: Standard birational-transformation vocabulary; it expresses mutual rational recoverability of rational bases.

title: blokova matrica / blokovo-diagonalna matrica
isv: Blokova matrica i blokovo-diagonalna matrica razděljujut obče grupovanje elementov v bloky od osobnogo diagonalnogo raspoloženja. Kratke nazvanja služe dokazě o konečnom podpolju bez ponovjenogo dolgogo opisa. Slične ruske i ukrajinske formy podpirajut izbor medžunarodnoj familije blok- i matric-.
en: Blokova matrica and blokovo-diagonalna matrica distinguish a general partition into blocks from the particular diagonal arrangement. The compact names serve the finite-subfield proof without repeated lengthy descriptions. The corresponding Russian and Ukrainian forms support the international block/matrix family.

original_reasons.text: Modern mathematical phrasing; clear across Slavic languages and avoids verbose paraphrase in the finite-subfield proof.

title: blokovo-trikutna forma / matrično predstavjenje
isv: Blokovo-trikutna prodolžaje familiju blokovo-diagonalna, ale zachovuje drugy tip matričnoj formy. Medžu trikutna i treugolna zapis daje prednost prozračnomu složenju tri i kut, da by ne zavisel samo od ruskoj formy. To jest slovotvorny i sravniteljny razlog; posebna izměrena vseslovjanska razumělivost ne jest dana.
en: Blokovo-trikutna continues the blokovo-diagonalna family while naming a different matrix shape. Between trikutna and treugolna, the record prefers the transparent tri-plus-kut formation to avoid reliance on the Russian form alone. This is a word-formation and comparative argument, not a reported measurement of pan-Slavic comprehension.

original_reasons.text: Extends the already logged `blokovo-diagonalna matrica` family from §5 entry 2. Interslavic `trikutna` is a transparent pan-Slavic geometric compound and avoids a Russian-only `treugolna` coloring.

title: Bolje ne jest bolši
isv: Bolje jest prislovnik stepena, bolši jest pridavnik. Pet bolj i jedno boljše v zapisě modifikujut stepenj ili sravnenje, zato izbrano bolje. Formy bolšim, bolšego i bolšej ostajut pridavnikove padežne formy; globalna proměna korenja by porušila soglasje. Gramatika izrično dopuščaje bolje i vyše pri analitičnom sravnenju. Slovničny profil bolje imaje pozitivne vostočne i slověnske, ale mnogo negativnyh ocenok drugde. Zato morfologična opravdanost ne mora byti opisana kako universalna leksična prěvaga. Izbor jest doslědny oblik v konkretnom prislovničnom upotrěbjenju.
en: Bolje is a degree adverb; bolši is an adjective. Five bolj occurrences and one boljše modify degree or comparison and were rendered as bolje. Bolšim, bolšego and bolšej remain adjectival case forms; a root-wide replacement would damage agreement. The grammar explicitly permits both bolje and vyše in analytic comparison. Bolje's dictionary profile has eastern and Slovene positives but numerous negatives elsewhere. Morphological justification must therefore not be presented as universal lexical superiority. The decision establishes the appropriate form in these adverbial contexts.
sources_isv: Slovnik, zaglavje 16915; Gramatika, Pridavniky, analitično i nepravilno stepenovanje.
sources_en: Dictionary entry 16915; Grammar, Adjectives, analytic and irregular comparison.

evidence.finding: Bolje is a degree adverb; bolši is an adjective. Five bolj occurrences and one boljše modify degree or comparison and were rendered as bolje. Bolšim, bolšego and bolšej remain adjectival case forms; a root-wide replacement would damage agreement. The grammar explicitly permits both bolje and vyše in analytic comparison. Bolje's dictionary profile has eastern and Slovene positives but numerous negatives elsewhere. Morphological justification must therefore not be presented as universal lexical superiority. The decision establishes the appropriate form in these adverbial contexts.

title: Brauerova grupa
isv: Brauerova grupa jest prisvojna konstrukcija iz imena Brauer i imenice grupa. Arhiv nazyvaje ju sovrěmennym nazvanjem za klasy centralnyh prostyh algebr; to ne jest tvrđenje, že AI izumila tuty termin. Rabota 38 sama utočnjaje, že elementy grupy sut klasy podobnyh algebr, ne vse algebry kako različne pojedične objekty. V tej rabotě algebra znači normalnu prostu algebru nad algebraičnym čislovym poljem, s tym poljem kako centrom. Pridavno ime Brauerova zadržuje identifikaciju matematika, ale ne zaměnjaje definiciju klasa ni osnovnogo polja. Kratka glava slovnika ne směje razširiti lokalnu teoremu na sve vozmožne algebry.
en: Brauerova grupa is a possessive construction from Brauer and grupa. The archive describes it as the modern name for classes of central simple algebras, not as a term invented by the AI. Paper 38 itself specifies that the group's elements are similarity classes of algebras, not all individual algebras counted separately. There algebra means a normal simple algebra over an algebraic number field, with that field as its centre. Brauerova retains the mathematician's identity but does not replace the class definition or base-field specification. A short dictionary heading must not extend the local theorem to every possible algebra.

comparisons.title_en: The Brauer group consists of algebra classes
comparisons.text: Normalna prosta algebra i osnovno polje sut izrično oprěděljene; grupa ne sobira algebry bez ekvivalencije.
comparisons.english: Normal simple algebra and the base field are specified; the group is not a collection of algebras without equivalence.

passages.quote: Radi kratkosti izraz ``algebra \(A\) nad \(\Omega\)'' tu i dalje vsegda znači ``normalna prosta algebra \(A\) nad algebraičnym čislovym poljem \(\Omega\)'', to jest prosty hiperkompleksny sistem s centrom \(\Omega\). Dalej, \(A\sim\Omega\) znači, že \(A\) jest polna matrična algebra nad \(\Omega\), to jest prinaleži specialnoj klasi podobnosti, oprěděljenoj samym \(\Omega\) kako dělitvenoj algebra nad \(\Omega\). Nakonec, pod povsudu razloženoju algebra nad \(\Omega\) rozuměje se taka, pri ktoroj za kažno primno město \(\mathfrak p\) polja \(\Omega\) \( \mathfrak p\)-adično razširjenje, to jest algebra nastajuča razširjenjem koeficientnogo polja \(\Omega\) do prinaležnogo \( \mathfrak p\)-adičnogo polja \(\Omega_{\mathfrak p}\), razlaga se:

Do značečih rezultatov dohodimo, ako pytanje v teoremě 3 o vsih poljah razloženja \(K\) fiksnoj algebry \(A\) obratimo: pri fiksnom algebraičnom polju \(K\) nad \(\Omega\) razgledamo vsotu algebr \(A\) nad \(\Omega\), ktore \(K\) razlaga. Te algebry \(A\) tvoret podgrupu \(\mathfrak K\), oprěděljenu \(K\), R. Brauerovoj grupy \(\mathfrak A\) vsih algebr, točnije vsih klas podobnyh algebr, nad \(\Omega\).\footnote{\foreign{R. Brauer, Über Systeme hyperkomplexer Größen, Jahresber. d. D. M.-V. 38 (1929), s. 47/48.} Vidi takože H, 13.1.} Ako prědpoložimo, že \(K\) jest Galoisovo nad \(\Omega\), dohodimo do teorem, ktore trěba razgledati kako obobčenje glavnyh teorem teorije klasnyh polj, teorije relativno-abelovyh čislovyh polj, na obča relativno-Galoisova čislova polja:

original_reasons.text: Canonical modern term for classes of central simple algebras.

title: Brauerova grupa klasov algeber
isv: Brauerova grupa klasov algeber izrično imenuje grupu i objekty njezinyh klas, da by istorična opisna formulacija ne ostala nejasna. Medžuslovjanska forma i razlog sut čitateljne. Ruska i ukrajinska polja odnak imajut samo znaky ? vměsto bukv, zato ta zapis ne može byti dokazom točnoj grafije njih terminov.
en: Brauerova grupa klasov algeber explicitly names the group and the objects being classified so that the historical descriptive wording is not left opaque. The Interslavic form and its rationale are readable. The Russian and Ukrainian fields, however, contain only damaged question marks and cannot establish those languages' exact spellings.

original_reasons.text: Modern term is made explicit rather than leaving the historical descriptive phrase opaque.

title: byly poznane kako reducibilne
isv: Byly poznane kako reducibilne jest konstrukcija soglasovana s imennikom formy v ženskoj množině. Sučstveny razlog zapisa jest gramatično soglasovanje; on ne jest novym sravnjenjem korenj za reducibilnost. Zachovuje se smysl, že reducibilnost byla ustanovjena, ne že formy stali reducibilnymi v toj chvíli.
en: Byly poznane kako reducibilne agrees with feminine plural formy. The recorded point is grammatical agreement, not a new comparison of lexical roots for reducibility. The sentence says that reducibility was recognized, not that the forms became reducible at that moment.

original_reasons.text: Interslavic agreement was corrected to feminine plural byly because the subject is formy.

title: byti algebraično cěly nad \mathfrak F
isv: Nad \mathfrak F označaje osnovu integralnosti i prodolžuje čitanje iz oddělov 10–11 děla 6. Objasnjajuča věta zachovuje avtorsky kriterij prěz jednačenje; sučasny termin go ne zaměnjaje.
en: Nad \mathfrak F names the base of integrality and continues the interpretation in Paper 6, Sections 10–11. The explanatory clause retains Noether's equation criterion; the modern term does not replace it.

original_reasons.text: Uses the canonical integral-over lane established in Paper 06 Sections 10--11, while the explanatory clause keeps Noether's equation criterion explicit.

title: Byti i biti
isv: Byti jest kopula ‘be’; biti jest drugy glagol ‘hit/beat’. Četyrdeset tri infinitivy biti v zapisě imajut kopulativnu, modalnu ili pasivnu ulogu, zato davajut byti. To ne isključaje legitimno biti v drugom kontekstě. Forma byti ne menja mora, može ili drugy modalny izraz, ni pasivny particip s kotorym se povezaje. Nacionalna kopula biti ne jest dokaz, že oba medžuslovjanske zaglavja sut sinonimy. Finite jest/sut/bude i prošle formy podležat vlastnoj paradigmi; pravilo o infinitivě ne raspisuje ih nanovo.
en: Byti is the copula be; biti is the separate verb hit/beat. The forty-three recorded biti infinitives have copular, modal or passive functions and therefore become byti. This does not exclude legitimate biti elsewhere. Byti preserves the surrounding modal expression and passive participle. National-language copular biti is not evidence that the two Interslavic headwords are synonyms. Finite jest/sut/bude and past forms follow their own paradigm; an infinitive rule does not rewrite them.
sources_isv: Slovnik, zaglavja 593, 4049; Gramatika, Glagoly, byti i biti → bij-/bity.
sources_en: Dictionary entries 593, 4049; Grammar, Verbs, byti and biti → bij-/bity.

evidence.finding: Byti is the copula be; biti is the separate verb hit/beat. The forty-three recorded biti infinitives have copular, modal or passive functions and therefore become byti. This does not exclude legitimate biti elsewhere. Byti preserves the surrounding modal expression and passive participle. National-language copular biti is not evidence that the two Interslavic headwords are synonyms. Finite jest/sut/bude and past forms follow their own paradigm; an infinitive rule does not rewrite them.

title: c?la algebrai?na funkcija
isv: Zapis c?la algebrai?na funkcija ima nezachovane bukvy. Jej razlog izrično sohranjaje značenje cěloj ili integralnoj algebraičnoj funkcije i razlikuje go od racionalnoj funkcije i od uslovja cěločislenyh koeficientov. To dovoljuje objasniti naměru, ale ne vosstanoviti izgubljene bukvy kako svedočstvo. I rusko, i ukrajinsko sravnjenje ostajut čitatelju označene kako nezachovane.
en: The record c?la algebrai?na funkcija has missing lettering. Its rationale explicitly retains whole or integral algebraic-function wording, distinguishing it from rational functions and from the integer-coefficient condition. That allows the intention to be explained but not lost letters to be restored as evidence. Both the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda remain identified as unrecoverable.

original_reasons.text: Keeps whole/integral-function wording visible and distinct from rational functions and from integer-coefficient terminology used in Paper 06.

title: častne derivaty 2-go reda
isv: Častne derivaty 2-go reda jest naměrna modernizacija staršego Differentialquotienten v kontekstu častnyh derivatov. Razlog sostavja slovjansky pridavnik s medžunarodnym imennikom i zachovuje vtory red. Sam historijni zapis ostavja termin za prověrku po avtoritetnom iztočniku. Zato tuto ne jest dokaz, že modernizacija podhodit vsakoj upotrěbě istogo německogo slova.
en: Častne derivaty 2-go reda deliberately modernizes the older Differentialquotienten in a context of partial derivatives. The reason combines a Slavic adjective with an international noun and retains the second order. The historical record itself leaves the term for comparison with an authoritative source. It therefore does not establish that the modernization suits every occurrence of the German word.

original_reasons.text: Modernizes Noether's older Differentialquotienten wording into current mathematical prose. Ukrainian/Russian use standard 'second partial derivatives'; Interslavic uses a transparent Slavic adjective plus international derivative noun, flagged for authority review.

title: cěla racionalna funkcija
isv: Tri zapisy za cěla racionalna funkcija svęzujut frazu s rezultantami, invariantami i algebraičnoju cělostju. Jedin iz njih izrično odbija integralna funkcija, da ne směšati polinomny oblik s odvojenym pytanjem cělosti nad oblastju. Drugi zadržuje historijny jezyk pri razsmotrenju cělosti. To sut kontekstualne motivacije za jednaku frazu, ne dokaz, že vsako značenje slova integralny jest isto. Sravnjenje pri TERM-0653 davaje javny polinomny smysl.
en: Three records for cěla racionalna funkcija connect the phrase with resultants, invariants and algebraic integrality. One expressly rejects integralna funkcija so that polynomial form is not confused with the separate question of integrality over a domain. Another retains the historical wording in a discussion of integrality. These are contextual motivations for the same phrase, not evidence that every sense of integral is identical. TERM-0653 gives the explicit polynomial reading.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether polynomial/rational-function terminology in the resultant expansion.
This is the classical invariant-theory term for a polynomial rational function. It is not rendered as an integral function, because that would collide with the paper's separate integrality theme.
The text is about integrality over domains, so cěla/cелая/ціла is preserved even when the modern phrase feels historically loaded.

title: cěla racionalna kombinacija
isv: Cěla racionalna kombinacija znači polinomnu kombinaciju, ne prosto linearnu kombinaciju i ne libovoljny racionalny izraz. Dva razloga svęzujut odděly 7 i 8 raboty 6 i podkrepljajut, že polinomny smysl stavaje izričny v daljšem odděle. Kombinacija zadržuje tu svez v dokazě. Izbor ne znači, že odstranjenje imenovateljev možno izpustiti v konkretnoj formuli.
en: Cěla racionalna kombinacija means a polynomial combination, not merely a linear combination or an arbitrary rational expression. Two rationales link sections 7 and 8 of Paper 6, emphasizing the explicit polynomial reading in the later section. Kombinacija maintains that connection through the proof. The choice does not license omitting the question of denominators in an actual formula.
