Keeping both constructions explicit preserves the criterion for genuinely different decompositions.

original_reasons.text: Section10 distinguishes parameter choices that do not form a diagonal matrix and cannot be transformed into one another by diagonal matrices. The translations keep literal diagonal-matrix language because it is the criterion separating genuinely different decompositions.

title: diagonalna shema
isv: Diagonalna shema opisuje raspoloženje nenulovyh produktov po diagonali. Medžunarodna osnova diagonal- daje kratko nazvanje matrično podobnomu obrazcu. Ruska i ukrajinska grafija v zachovanom zapisu ne sut čitateljne: ostali sut samo znaky ?. Razlog izbora jest zachovany, ale točne sravniteljne formy ne mogut byti citovane iz tih poljev.
en: Diagonalna shema describes a pattern in which the nonzero products lie on the diagonal. The international stem gives the matrix-like pattern a compact name. The preserved Russian and Ukrainian spellings are unreadable: only question marks remain. The rationale survives, but those fields cannot supply exact comparison forms.

original_reasons.text: The condition is literally that nonzero products occupy a diagonal pattern. The international diagonal stem is transparent across the target lanes and avoids overexplaining the matrix-like product pattern.

title: diagonalne matrice / nulova matrica
isv: Diagonalne matrice i nulova matrica zachovujut dva točne matrične nazvanja. Medžunarodna familija matric- i diagonal- odgovarja paralelnym ruskim i ukrajinskim izrazam. Nulova takože ostavaje izrična kvalifikacija; skupny zapis ne izravnjava dva pojmy.
en: Diagonalne matrice and nulova matrica retain two exact matrix names. The international matrix/diagonal family corresponds to the Russian and Ukrainian parallels. Nulova remains an explicit qualification; grouping the expressions in one entry does not equate the concepts.

original_reasons.text: Uses stable international matrix vocabulary in all lanes; Interslavic keeps diagonalne as a widely recognizable technical adjective.

title: diagonalny člen
isv: Diagonalny člen svezaje medžunarodny pridavnik so slovjanskim imenovanjem člena. Dva zapisy opirajut se na diagonalno raspoloženje v izpisanoj tablici. Zato izraz ostavaje kratky: sama formula pokazuje odnos, ktory pridavnik imenuje.
en: Diagonalny člen combines an international adjective with a Slavic noun for a member or term. Both records refer to the diagonal arrangement in the displayed array. The phrase can remain short because the formula shows the relation named by the adjective.

original_reasons.text: Matches the displayed diagonal array.
Shared international diagonal plus Slavic member/term noun. Fits formula-table context without overexplaining.

title: diedralne grupy
isv: Diedralne grupy zachovuje medžunarodno ime togo tipa grup s pridavnikovym zakončenjem, soglasovanym s grupy. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela imajut istu terminologičnu osnovu. Kratky izvorni zapis ne sodržuje zasebno sravnjenje slovotvornyh alternativ.
en: Diedralne grupy retains the international name for this type of group with an adjectival ending agreeing with grupy. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels share the terminological stem. The brief original record contains no separate comparison of alternative formations.

original_reasons.text: Modern standard term for dihedral groups.

title: diferencialne invarianty
isv: Diferencialne invarianty zachovuje medžunarodnu familiju invariant-, ktora čitatelju povezuje termin s teorijeju invariantov. Izvorni razlog ne daje prednost novoj domorodnoj parafraze, ibo ona mogla by učiniti tu vezu menje poznavajemoju. To jest razlog terminologičnoj prepoznavajemosti, ne izměreno testovanje publike.
en: Diferencialne invarianty retains the international invariant family, making the connection with invariant theory recognizable. The recorded reason rejects introducing a native paraphrase that could obscure that connection. This is an argument about terminological recognizability, not a reported audience test.

original_reasons.text: All lanes use the modern international invariant family; changing it to a native paraphrase would reduce recognizability in invariant theory.

title: diferencialne izrazy
isv: Diferencialne izrazy upotrěbjaje medžunarodnu osnovu diferencial- i običny imennik izraz, paralelno s ruskim i ukrajinskim imenovanjami. To jest množinna formulacija o vyraženjah. Izvorni napis Differentialausdruecke s ue jest zachovan kako osobna dokumentovana forma německogo zaglavja, ne kako drugy matematičny pojem.
en: Diferencialne izrazy combines international diferencial- with the ordinary noun izraz, parallel to Russian and Ukrainian. It is the plural expression wording. Historical Differentialausdruecke with ue remains a separately recorded German headword form, not a different mathematical concept.

original_reasons.text: Modern mathematical wording in Ukrainian and Russian is direct. Interslavic uses the international stem diferencial- because it stays transparent across Slavic mathematical registers.

title: diferencialne izrazy
isv: Diferencialne izrazy zachovuje širši opseg pregleda, ktory ne omejaje se diferencialnymi jednačenjami. Zaměna izrazy slovom jednačenja by nepravilno suzila imenovane objekty. Ista medžuslovjanska forma jest dokumentovana i pod německim napisom s ue; pravopisna razlika iztočnika ne stvara novu terminologičnu odluku.
en: Diferencialne izrazy preserves the survey's scope beyond differential equations. Replacing expressions with equations would wrongly narrow the named objects. The same Interslavic form is recorded under the German spelling with ue; the source-spelling difference does not create a new terminological decision.

original_reasons.text: Matches modern mathematical expression terminology while keeping the survey's broad scope beyond differential equations.

title: diferencialne simboly
isv: Diferencialne simboly imenujut simbolične redy, ktore v formulě (45) zaměnjajut $S^\sigma$ i $T_{n-\tau}$. Ne imenujut derivat sam po sobě. Izraz zato zachovuje razliku medžu formalnym zapisom operacije i objektom, na ktory ona dějstvuje.
en: Diferencialne simboly names the symbolic rows replacing $S^\sigma$ and $T_{n-\tau}$ in formula (45), not a derivative object by itself. The wording preserves the distinction between the formal expression of an operation and the object on which it acts.

original_reasons.text: Describes the symbolic rows replacing $S^\sigma,T_{n-\tau}$ in formula (45), not an analytic derivative object by itself.

title: diferencialny izraz
isv: Diferencialny izraz zachovuje široky objekt: funkciju koordinatov i diferencialov ili derivacij. Izvorni razlog izrično izběgaje suženje do diferencialnoj formy v užšem sovrěmennom smyslu. Izraz zato jest sadržajno važny, ne samo stilistična zaměna slova forma.
en: Diferencialny izraz preserves a broad object: a function of coordinates and differentials or derivatives. The recorded reason explicitly avoids narrowing it to a differential form in the restricted modern sense. Expression is therefore substantive, not merely a stylistic substitute for form.

original_reasons.text: Kept literal because Noether uses a broad function of coordinates and differentials/derivatives, wider than only a differential form in the narrow modern sense.

title: diferencialny kvocient
isv: Diferencialny kvocient zachovuje německo imenovanje v argumentu, kde diferenta jest svezana s definujučim idealom. Izvorni zapis naměrno ne zaměnjaje termin avtomatično sovrěmennym derivacija. Opravdanje leži v lokalnom objasnjenju kvocienta; ono ne jest obče pravilo prěvoditi vsako Differentialquotient istim sposobom.
en: Diferencialny kvocient retains the German naming within the argument relating the different to a defining ideal. The original record deliberately avoids automatically modernizing the term as derivative. The justification lies in the local explanation of the quotient; it is not a universal rule for every occurrence of Differentialquotient.

original_reasons.text: The term is kept as quotient/частное rather than silently modernizing to derivative because Noether explicitly identifies the different as a quotient attached to a defining ideal.

title: diferencialny kvocient / razlikovy kvocient
isv: Diferencialny kvocient i razlikovy kvocient morajut ostati različne nazvanja, ibo argument sravnjava derivaciji podobny objekt s kvocientom razlik. Kvocient jest izbran vměsto častka, da by poslednje slovo ne nosilo dodatny smysl. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela imaju svoja imena kvocienta; jejich funkcija podpiraje različenje objektov, ne tvrdnju, že vsi jezyky imajut isti korenj.
en: Diferencialny kvocient and razlikovy kvocient must remain distinct because the argument compares a derivative-like object with a difference quotient. Kvocient was chosen over častka to avoid giving the latter another sense. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use their own quotient nouns; they support the distinction between the objects, not a claim of a shared lexical root.

original_reasons.text: Noether’s argument depends on the distinction between the derivative-like quotient and the difference quotient. The Ukrainian lane uses частник as a compact quotient noun; Russian uses the canonical частное; Interslavic uses kvocient to avoid overloading častka and to stay pan-Slavically recognizable.

title: diferenciranje idealov
isv: Diferenciranje idealov nazvaje operaciju, a ne samo formalnu sličnost s diferenciranjem polinomov. Izbor procesnogo imennika so korenom diferenc- i doplnjenja idealov dava kratky, razpoznavajemy izraz. Rabota 36 objavjaje vez s diferentoju; rabota 43 razviva definiciju s razlikovym idealom i idealnym kvocientom, poslě čego sledi specializacija. Zato ne trěba objašnjati termin prosto kak priměnjenje običnogo izvodnogo k svakomu tvorjačemu elementu. Tekst pokazuje, pri kakom specialnom slučaju konstrukcija sběgaje se s polinomnym diferencialnym kvocientom. Sohranjanje toj svezi i jejnyh uslovij jest važnějše než sličnost nazvanij.
en: Diferenciranje idealov names an operation, not merely a formal resemblance to differentiating polynomials. A process noun with the stem diferenc- and the complement idealov gives a short, recognizable expression. Paper 36 announces the connection with the different; Paper 43 develops the definition through a difference ideal and an ideal quotient, followed by specialization. The term should therefore not be explained simply as applying the ordinary derivative to each generator. The text identifies the special case in which the construction coincides with a polynomial differential quotient. Preserving this connection and its conditions matters more than the resemblance between the names.

comparisons.text: Kratka rabota 36 objavjaje interpretaciju diferenty kak diferencialnogo kvocienta definujučego ideala. V rabotě 43 ide o razlikovy ideal, idealny kvocient v ukazanoj polinomnoj oblasti i specializaciju. §3 izrično upotrěbja $(0):\mathfrak B$. Vez s obyčnym diferencialnym kvocientom polinoma nastupaje pri specialnom uslovju, že baza sostoji se iz stepenjev jednogo elementa. Slovnik zato ne smi zaměniti obšču konstrukciju proizvoljnym diferenciranjem tvorjačih polinomov.
comparisons.english: The short Paper 36 announces an interpretation of the different as the differential quotient of the defining ideal. Paper 43 uses a difference ideal, an ideal quotient in a specified polynomial domain and specialization. Section 3 explicitly uses $(0):\mathfrak B$. The connection with an ordinary polynomial differential quotient appears under the special condition that the basis consists of powers of one element. The dictionary must not replace the general construction with arbitrary differentiation of generating polynomials.

passages.quote: Pokazano jest, kako diferentu algebraičnogo čislovogo polja možno razuměti kako \emph{diferencialny kvocient} definujucego \emph{ideala}. Že ta definicija sběgaje se s obyčnoj, slěduje iz strukturnyh teorem, interesnyh samyh po sobě, ktore v analognom smyslu prědstavjajut obobčenje Lagrangevoj interpolacijskoj formuly.

V slědujučem pokazujem, že tu ide o něčto večše než formalna analogija. Diferentu možno razuměti kako diferencialny kvocient definujučego ideala čislovogo polja \(K\) v prirědženoj cěločislnoj polinomialnoj oblasti od \(x_1,\ldots,x_n\), pri čem diferencialny kvocient jest vzet na městu \(x=\omega\), to jest pri \(x_1=\omega_1,\ldots,x_n=\omega_n\), kde \(\omega_1,\ldots,\omega_n\) znači modulnu bazu sistema cělyh čisel iz \(K\), glavnogo poredka \(\mathfrak o\). Pri tom definujuči ideal \(\mathfrak M\) odgovarja cělosti relacij medžu \(\omega_i\), to jest sostoji se iz vsih cěločislnyh polinomov \(f(x)\), za ktore \(f(\omega)\) izčezava. Diferencialny kvocient \(\mathfrak M'[x\to\omega]\) jest definovany kako razlikovy kvocient, vzet na městu \(x=\omega\).

pri čem tvorjenje kvocienta znači običny idealny kvocient, vzet v polinomialnoj oblasti od \(x\) s cělymi čislami iz \(K\), to jest s čislami iz \(\mathfrak o\), kako koeficientami. Togda diferenta \(\mathfrak D\) definujetsja s
Razširjenje oblasti koeficientov jest potrěbno, da razlikovy ideal i razlikovy kvocient obče byli definovane. Ide zato o direktno obobčenje diferencialnogo kvocienta polinoma od jednoj neizvěstnoj,

pri čem i tu trěba razširiti polinomialnu oblast adjunkcijeju \(\xi\), da razlike byli definovane. V samoj stvari idealny diferencialny kvocient prěhodi v polinomialny diferencialny kvocient, čim baza \(\omega_i\) sostoji se iz stepenov jednogo elementa.
nazyva se razlikovy ideal. Razlikovy kvocient jest idealny kvocient nulovogo ideala po \(\mathfrak B\):
\mathfrak A=(0):\mathfrak B.

original_reasons.text: All lanes keep the operation-like nominal phrase rather than paraphrasing as derivation of ideals. Interslavic uses an international stem already transparent across Slavic mathematical registers.

A literal process noun is preferable to an abstract neologism because Noether defines it by an ideal quotient construction. Interslavic uses the transparent international root diferenc- plus ordinary idealov, keeping it readable across Slavic mathematical registers.

title: diferenta
isv: Diferenta jest osobny objekt algebraičnoj teorije čisel, ne obična razlika i ne sinonim diskriminanta. Tri zapisy zachovujut medžunarodno nazvanje i njegovu vezu s rabotami 36 i 37. Ukrajinske formy v sravnjenju imajut i diferent, i diferenta; medžuslovjansky žensky imennik jest obrazloženy kandidat, čiju morfologiju ne dokazuje samo prisutnost medžunarodnogo korenja.
en: Diferenta names a particular algebraic-number-theory object, not an ordinary difference or a synonym for discriminant. Three records retain the international name and its continuity with Papers 36 and 37. The Ukrainian comparanda include both diferent and diferenta; the Interslavic feminine noun is a reasoned candidate whose morphology is not established merely by the shared international root.

original_reasons.text: The algebraic-number-theory term is retained as the established loan in Ukrainian/Russian and as a direct transparent internationalism in Interslavic.
Continues Paper36/Paper37 number-theoretic different terminology; Interslavic uses the international noun as a stable technical term.

The different is a standard algebraic-number-theory object and should remain a named technical noun, not be paraphrased as difference/discriminant. Interslavic takes the international noun with Slavic morphology; this is intentionally review-visible.

title: dimenzija v sobstvenom smyslu
isv: Dimenzija v sobstvenom smyslu razkriva funkciju schlechthin kako ograničenja načina upotrěby termina. Konstrukcija trěbuje kontrast s najvyšša dimenzija; prosto ponovjenje imennika dimenzija skrylo by tu razliku. Izvorni razlog zato vybira objasnjujuču frazu vměsto doslovnogo pridevka k imenu.
en: Dimenzija v sobstvenom smyslu makes schlechthin's qualification of the term explicit. The expression needs its contrast with najvyšša dimenzija; simply repeating dimenzija would conceal that distinction. The recorded reason therefore favours an explanatory phrase over a literal adjective attached to the noun.

original_reasons.text: Rendered as a modern clarifying phrase rather than a literal `plain dimension`. Interslavic makes the contrast with `najvyšša dimenzija` explicit; this is a valuable constructed-language stress test because it requires a meta-mathematical qualifier, not only a term.

title: dimenzijne čisla
isv: Dimenzijne čisla zachovujut množinu čisel, ktore teorem V sravnjava za asociovane proste idealy. Samo dimenzija mogla by izgledati kako jedna veličina i skryti seznam invariantov. Imennik čisla jest zato čestju matematičnogo sodržanja, ne izpustima razširenost nazvanja.
en: Dimenzijne čisla preserves the plural numerical data that Theorem V compares for associated primes. Dimension alone could suggest one value and obscure the list of invariants. Čisla is therefore part of the mathematical content, not an expendable elaboration of the name.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether's count/invariant wording in Theorem V instead of flattening it to just dimension; the phrase is needed because the theorem compares the list of dimensions of associated primes.

title: direktna dvustranna suma
isv: Direktna dvustranna suma zachovuje obe kvalifikacije, od ktoryh zavisi blokovo-diagonalna forma diskriminantnoj matrice. Dvustranna nastavlja terminologiju stran v teoriji idealov i prstenov. Razlog ne daje pravo skratiti izraz do direktna suma, ibo strannost jest relevantna konstrukciji.
en: Direktna dvustranna suma preserves both qualifications governing the block-diagonal form of the discriminant matrix. Dvustranna continues the vocabulary for sides in ideal and ring theory. The rationale does not warrant shortening the expression to direct sum, because sidedness matters to the construction.

original_reasons.text: The phrase is kept close to the source because it controls the block-diagonal discriminant matrix. Interslavic uses dvustranna to match prior ideal/ring-side vocabulary.

title: direktna suma
isv: Direktna suma jest izbrana kako prepoznavajemo algebraično nazvanje. Dva razloga povezuju njegovo priměnjenje v rabotah 31 i 34 i razlučajut sumu kako aditivnu konstrukciju od direktnogo produkta. Tvrđenje o širokoj razumělivosti jest razlogom izbora, ne rezultatom izměrenogo čitatelskogo testa.
en: Direktna suma is selected as a recognizable algebraic name. Two rationales connect its use in Papers 31 and 34 and distinguish the additive construction from direct product. Broad intelligibility is a reason advanced for the choice, not the result of a measured reader test.

original_reasons.text: International direct-sum vocabulary is transparent across the lanes and will be central in §2 entry 2.
Standard additive counterpart to direct product across all three lanes.

title: direktna suma / direktny sumand
isv: Direktna suma imenuje cělost, direktny sumand jednu njezinu komponentu. Izvorni razlog daje prednost medžunarodnym osnovam direkt- i sumand i govori o sravnjenju s češskym, poljskym, ruskym i ukrajinskym jezykom. V zachovanyh poljah sut točne formy samo za poslednje dva; bez citatov češskogo i poljskogo iztočnika ne možno prědstaviti tu tvrdnju kako polno potvrđeno sravnjenje.
en: Direktna suma names the whole and direktny sumand a component. The recorded reason favours international direkt- and sumand and invokes Czech, Polish, Russian, and Ukrainian comparison. The preserved fields supply exact forms only for the last two; without the cited Czech and Polish sources, that assertion cannot be presented as a fully evidenced comparison.

original_reasons.text: Standard module language; Interslavic keeps international direkt-/sumand because it triangulates cleanly with Czech/Polish/Russian/Ukrainian usage and remains transparent.

title: direktna suma direktno nerazložimyh jednostavnyh idealov
source: direkte Summe direkt unzerlegbarer, einfacher Ideale
russian: прямая сумма прямо неразложимых простых идеалов
ukrainian: пряма сума прямо нерозкладних простих ідеалів
isv: Jednostavny ideal ovde znači simple ideal, a prosty ideal ostavaje nazvanjem prime ideal v sosednyh rabotah. To jest naměrno razděljenje dvuh smyslov, ktore ruska i ukrajinska paralela ne morajut razděliti različnymi osnovami. Cěly izraz takojže zachovuje direktnu sumu i direktnu nerazložimost, ne zaměnjajuči jih neprivedimostju.
en: Jednostavny ideal here means a simple ideal, while prosty ideal remains the name for a prime ideal in the neighbouring works. This deliberately separates senses that the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda need not distinguish by different stems. The full expression also preserves direct sum and direct indecomposability rather than substituting irreducibility.

original_reasons.text: Keeps `directly indecomposable` separate from `irreducible`. Interslavic deliberately uses `jednostavne idealy` for simple ideals here to avoid collision with `prosty ideal` as prime ideal in adjacent ideal-theory papers.

title: direktna suma kolc ranga jedan
source: direkte Summe von Ringen vom Rang eins
isv: Direktna suma kolc ranga jedan nastavlja terminologiju razloženja iz odděla 3. Rang jedan kvalifikuje prsteny, a ne čislo sumandov; tu razliku ne možno izgubiti pri skračenju. Kolc jest zachovana historijna forma, ne dokaz aktualnoj prednosti kolco nad prsten.
en: Direktna suma kolc ranga jedan continues the decomposition vocabulary of section 3. Rank one qualifies the rings, not the number of summands; shortening must not lose that distinction. Kolc is the preserved historical form, not evidence of a current preference for kolco over prsten.

original_reasons.text: Continues the §3 entry05 decomposition vocabulary. Interslavic keeps `direktna suma` because it is transparent across Slavic mathematical registers and already used in the cumulative Paper31 lane.

title: direktna suma konečno mnogyh polj
source: direkte Summe von endlich vielen Körpern
isv: Direktna suma konečno mnogyh polj zachovuje vtoroju harakterizaciju iz definicije. Konečnost odnašaje se k čislu polj, ne avtomatično k čislu elementov v každom polju. Obyčny slovoporedok čini tuto ograničenje čitatelnym bez skračenja matematičnogo sodržanja.
en: Direktna suma konečno mnogyh polj retains the definition's second characterization. Finiteness qualifies the number of fields, not automatically the number of elements in each field. Ordinary word order makes that restriction readable without abbreviating the mathematics.

original_reasons.text: The definition's second characterization is the reader-facing mathematical content, so the wording is kept plain and modern.

title: direktne sumy klasov
isv: Direktne sumy klasov zachovujut klasy kako objekty razmatranja v oddělu 5. Izraz nastavlja direktnu sumu iz oddělov 2 i 3, ale ne podměnjaje klas konkretnym njegovym prědstavitelem. Ta razlika jest čestju nazvanja, ne samo okolnogo objasnjenja.
en: Direktne sumy klasov keeps classes as the objects under discussion in section 5. The expression continues the direct-sum terminology of sections 2 and 3 without silently substituting a particular representative for a class. That distinction belongs to the naming itself.

original_reasons.text: Uses the established direct-sum vocabulary from Paper31 §2--§3 and keeps `class` as the governing object of §5.

title: direktno nerazložima
isv: Direktno ograničaje tip razloženja, ktory jest izključeny; nerazložimost ne jest tym samym nerazložimostju v smyslu neprivedimosti. Ženska forma nerazložima naleži k konkretnoj konstrukciji iz odděla 4. Jej gramatičny rod ne tvori novy pojem v sravnjenju s mužskym nerazložimy.
en: Direktno specifies the kind of decomposition being excluded; this is not thereby irreducibility. Feminine nerazložima belongs to the particular construction in section 4. Its grammatical gender does not create a different concept from masculine nerazložimy.

original_reasons.text: Adverbial 'directly' is preserved to distinguish direct indecomposability from ordinary irreducibility or decomposition into subgroups.

title: direktno nerazložime faktory
isv: Direktno nerazložime faktory zachovujut uslovje direktnogo produkta iz odděla 4. Faktory ne sut izrično nazvane neprivedimymi v drugom smyslu. Prilog zato mora ostati pri pridavniku i v množině; skračenje do nerazložime faktory moglo by izpustiti nužno ograničenje.
en: Direktno nerazložime faktory retains the direct-product qualification from section 4. It does not assert that the factors are irreducible in another sense. The adverb therefore remains attached to the adjective in the plural; shortening the phrase could remove the necessary restriction.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the direct-product qualifier from Section 4 and distinguishes it from ordinary irreducibility.

title: direktno nerazložimy
isv: Direktno nerazložimy označaje nemogućnost razloženja v direktnu sumu, ne neprivedimost. Zapis svezava termin s ranějšim jezykom teorije idealov. Zachovanje priloga direktno štiti upravo to matematično ograničenje; kratak prěvod nerazložimy bez konteksta mogl by jeho izgubiti.
en: Direktno nerazložimy excludes a direct-sum decomposition, not reducibility in general. The record connects the term to earlier ideal-theoretic usage. Keeping direktno protects that mathematical restriction, which a context-free nerazložimy could lose.

original_reasons.text: The term is kept parallel to the earlier ideal-theory lane and explicitly marks indecomposability with respect to direct-sum decompositions, not irreducibility.

title: direktno nerazložimy
isv: Direktno nerazložimy izključaje direktnu sumu, ne vsako možno vnutrišnje razděljenje. Německa spojka v direkt-unzerlegbar ne měnja togo smysla. Zapis zachovuje prilog kako nositelja uslovja razloženja, a ne kako stilističnu čest, ktoru možno odstraniti.
en: Direktno nerazložimy excludes a direct-sum decomposition, not every possible internal division. The German hyphen in direkt-unzerlegbar does not change that sense. The adverb carries the decomposition condition rather than serving as dispensable emphasis.

original_reasons.text: The adverbial 'directly' is retained because Noether is excluding decomposition as a direct sum, not arbitrary internal decomposition.

title: direktno nerazložimy / razložimy
isv: Para direktno nerazložimy i razložimy čini vidimym različenje dekompozicije od neprivedimosti v argumentah o predstavjenjah. Izvorni zapis veže to različenje s rabotami 28 i 34. Samo podoben opis ‘ne možno razložiti’ ne ustanavjaje, ktora matematična operacija jest izključena.
en: The pair direktno nerazložimy and razložimy keeps decomposition distinct from irreducibility in the representation-theoretic arguments. The recorded reason links the distinction to Papers 28 and 34. A general description such as cannot be broken up does not determine which mathematical operation is excluded.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the distinction between direct indecomposability and irreducibility; this distinction is central to the Paper28/Paper34 representation-theory lane.

title: direktno razloženje na prave idealy
isv: Direktno razloženje na prave idealy zachovuje konkretny tip idealov, na ktore objekt razkladaje se. Izraz nastavlja direktnu sumu iz oddělov 4–6, ne novo opče značenje direktnogo razloženja. Prave ovde odnašaje se k pravoj straně množenja, ne k ocěně pravilnosti ideala.
en: Direktno razloženje na prave idealy retains the particular kind of ideals into which the object is decomposed. It continues the direct-sum terminology of sections 4–6 rather than introducing a general sense of direct decomposition. Prave concerns the right side of multiplication, not whether an ideal is correct.

original_reasons.text: Extends the stable direct-sum vocabulary from Paper34 §§4--6 while keeping Noether's right-ideal target explicit.

title: direktno sumno razloženje
isv: Direktno sumno razloženje zachovuje i pojem razloženja, i njegovu vezu s direktnoju sumoju. Izvorni razlog daje prednost medžunarodnomu direktno prěd neimenovanoju domorodnoju alternativoju. On ne soderži točny kandidat ili čislenu ocěnu toj alternativy; ih ne trěba dodavati kako by byli historijno zapisane.
en: Direktno sumno razloženje retains decomposition and its connection with direct sum. The recorded reason favours international direktno over an unnamed native alternative. It supplies neither an exact alternative form nor a numerical rating; neither should be invented as historical evidence.

original_reasons.text: The phrase preserves Noether's decomposition language while keeping modern mathematical recognizability. Interslavic uses 'direktno' rather than a purely native alternative because direct sum is an international algebraic idiom.

title: direktny faktor
isv: Direktny faktor nastavlja terminologiju direktnogo produkta iz odděla 4. Izvorni razlog izrično ne dopuščaje zaměnu slovom dopolnjenje: Noether tvrdži strukturu direktnogo faktora, ne samo suščestvovanje nekogo dopolnjujučego objekta. Prěvod zato zachovuje imenovanu algebraičnu rolu.
en: Direktny faktor continues the direct-product vocabulary of section 4. The recorded reason explicitly rejects complement as a paraphrase: Noether states direct-factor structure, not merely the presence of some complementary object. The translation therefore retains the named algebraic role.

original_reasons.text: Directly paired with the Section 4 direct-product register; do not paraphrase as complement because Noether states direct-factor structure.

title: direktny prěsěk
isv: Direktny prěsěk zachovuje odnos k direktnoj sumě, o ktorom govori Prüferova podnožna primětka, i nastavlja terminologiju raboty 30 v rabotě 34. Vtory razlog izrično upominaje češsku, poljsku i južnoslovjansku paralelu, ale ne dava jejich točne formy ili citaty. Zapisany kiriličny oblik пресек jest dokazom izbora pisanja v tom zapisu, ne dodatnym dokazom leksičnogo značenja.
en: Direktny prěsěk preserves the relation to direct sum discussed in Prüfer's footnote and continues Paper 30 terminology in Paper 34. The second reason invokes Czech, Polish, and South Slavic parallels but supplies neither their exact forms nor citations. The recorded Cyrillic пресек is evidence of that record's spelling choice, not additional evidence for lexical meaning.

original_reasons.text: Prüfer's footnote is about the relation between direct sum and direct intersection; the translation keeps that potential later terminology visible.

Continues the Paper30/Paper34 terminology lane for intersection; Interslavic 'prěsěk' is transparent against Czech/Polish/South-Slavic intersection vocabulary and is deterministic to Cyrillic 'пресек'.

title: direktny produkt
isv: Direktny produkt zachovuje medžunarodno nazvanje algebraičnoj konstrukcije. Rusko proizvedenie i ukrajinsko dobutok upotrěbjajut druge osnovy; razlog dava prednost produkt za medžuslovjansku tehničnu prozu. To ne jest tvrdženje, že priměr ne trěbuje definicije ili že vsaky čitatelj uže znaje pojem.
en: Direktny produkt retains an international name for the algebraic construction. Russian proizvedenie and Ukrainian dobutok use different stems; the reason favours produkt for Interslavic technical prose. This does not establish that the construction needs no definition or that every reader already knows it.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use the canonical algebraic term for direct product; Interslavic keeps the international adjective 'direktny' plus broadly Slavic 'produkt'.

title: direktny produkt / tvorjenje direktnogo produkta
isv: Direktny produkt jest objekt, tvorjenje direktnogo produkta njegova konstrukcija. Oba morajut ostati vidime, ibo pasaža ne govori samo o gotovom rezultatu. Produkt nastavlja imennik iz terminologije skrěščenogo produkta; direktny označaje drugy tip konstrukcije bez novogo nazvanja samogo produkta.
en: Direktny produkt names the object; tvorjenje direktnogo produkta names its construction. Both remain explicit because the passage concerns more than the finished result. Produkt continues the noun used for crossed product, while direktny specifies a different construction without renaming product itself.

original_reasons.text: The paper uses direct product formation as a structural construction, not only a finished object. Interslavic keeps produkt, the same noun used in the crossed-product lane, while the adjective direktny avoids an unnecessary calque.

title: direktny sumand
isv: Direktny sumand zachovuje vezu s direktna suma. Dva zapisy iz oddělov 13 i 24 davajut prednost kratkomu medžunarodnomu nazvanju komponenta, dokolě ruska i ukrajinska paralela imajut svoje obične algebraične imena. To jest kontinuitet terminologičnoj familije, ne novy pojem pri každom pojavjenju.
en: Direktny sumand keeps its connection with direktna suma. Records from sections 13 and 24 favour a compact international name for the component, while the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use their own algebraic nouns. This is continuity within a terminology family, not a new concept at each occurrence.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use the standard local algebra phrases; Interslavic keeps the international/direct-sum family already fixed earlier in the project.
Ukrainian/Russian use standard module-theoretic terminology. Interslavic uses international direktny/sumand for a compact technical register.

title: direktny summand
isv: Direktny summand vyražaje isti izbor medžunarodnogo imennika vměsto novogo domorodnogo tvorjenja. Izvorni razlog govori o prepoznavajemosti v algebraičnom kontekstu, ale ne objašnjaje dvojno m. Proto summand s dvojnym m i sumand s jednym m trěba razmatrjati kako pravopisny problem, ne kako dva matematične termina.
en: Direktny summand expresses the same preference for an international noun over a new native formation. The recorded reason invokes recognizability in algebraic contexts but does not justify the doubled m. Summand and sumand therefore present an orthographic question, not two mathematical concepts.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian and Russian use the standard algebraic terms. Interslavic uses the transparent international summand rather than a newly coined Slavic-only form, because it has good cross-Slavic recognizability in algebraic contexts.

title: diskontinuirny / ekstremno diskontinuirny / totalno diskontinuirny
isv: Diskontinuirny jest vybrano vměsto neprěryvny, zato že poslědnja forma sugeruje kontinuitet, tedy protivny smysl. Ta motivacija jest izrično sohranjena; ona ne jest statističny rezultat čitatelskogo testa. Ekstremno diskontinuirny ima v rabotě silnu definiciju: bliz vsakogo $z_0$ možno dostignuti vrědnosti libovoljno blizke k vsakomu zadannomu $Z_0$. Avtorska primětka upozornjaje, že Hamelovo totalno diskontinuirny indže znači něčto drugo. Te nazvy zato ne treba proglasiti bezuslovnymi sinonimami.
en: Diskontinuirny was chosen over neprěryvny because the latter suggests continuity, the opposite meaning. That motivation is explicitly preserved; it is not a statistical result from reader testing. Ekstremno diskontinuirny has a strong definition in the work: near any $z_0$ one can attain values arbitrarily close to any prescribed $Z_0$. The author's note warns that Hamel's totalno diskontinuirny has another meaning elsewhere. These labels should therefore not be declared unconditional synonyms.

comparisons.title_isv: Tri nazvy, ne tri bezuslovne sinonimy
comparisons.title_en: Three labels, not three unconditional synonyms
comparisons.text: Avtorska ograda o Hamelovoj nazvě ostavaje sučstvena.
comparisons.english: The author's qualification concerning Hamel's label remains essential.

passages.quote: Najobčejše rěšenja funkcionalnogo uravnenja (1) G. Hamel\footnote{G. Hamel: \emph{\foreign{Eine Basis aller Zahlen und die unstetigen Lösungen der Funktionalgleichung: \(f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y)\)}}, Math. Ann. 60, s. 459 (1905).} skonstruoval s pomoču {\itshape linearnoj} bazy vsih čisel. Tu dana konstrukcija rěšenij od (1) do (4) --- znači funkcije odobraženja, po odnošenju k ktoroj racionalne i algebraične operacije sut invariantne, --- upotrěbljaje {\itshape racionalnu} i {\itshape algebraičnu} bazu vsih čisel. Poslě togo, kako v č. 1 izomorfno odobraženje bude razmotreno točnjeje, v č. 2 budut dane potrěbne uslovja za \(f(z)\), ktore v č. 3, priznane dostatočnymi, vedut k samoj konstrukciji.\footnote{Sravni paralelne razgledanja v mojej rabotě: \emph{Die allgemeinsten Bereiche aus ganzen transzendenten Zahlen}. Math. Ann. 77, s. 103 (1915), osoblivo \S\ 8 i \S\ 10.} --- Rěšenja (1)--(4), kako znano, s izključenjem \(f(z)=z\) ili \(\overline z\), sut diskontinuirne; v č. 4 bude dalje pokazano, že ony sut «ekstremno diskontinuirne», --- fakt, ktory G. Hamel dokazal za realne rěšenja (1), ale ktory tam v kompleksnoj oblasti ne mora byti izpolnjen.\footnote{Hamelovo nazvanje «totalno diskontinuirny» v ostaloj literaturi upotrěbljaje se v drugom smyslu.}

\noindent\textbf{4.}\quad Nyně trěba ješče pokazati, že funkcije \(f(z)\), definirane za polje \(\Cfield\) vsih realnyh i kompleksnyh čisel, --- ktore, kako znano, s izključenjem \(f(z)=z\) ili \(\overline z\), sut diskontinuirne, --- sut {\itshape ekstremno diskontinuirne}. To znači, že v okolině vsakogo realnogo ili kompleksnogo čisla \(z_0\) sut cěnnosti \(z\), pri ktoryh \(f(z)\) stavaje libovoljno blizka k libovoljno naprijed zadanoj cěnnosti \(Z_0\). Ta ekstremna diskontinuirnost, kako G. Hamel dokazal na navedenom městu, prinaleži {\itshape realnym} rěšenjam \(\varphi(x)\), definiranym za vse {\itshape realne} čisla, funkcionalnogo uravnenja (1). Ale, kako pokazujut priměry dane niže, ona ne mora prinaležati rěšenjam definiranym nad kompleksnymi čislami. Hamel zaključaje slědujučim sposobom. Ako \(\varphi(x)\) jest različna od \(C\cdot x\), togda obstojat prinajmenje dvě cěnnosti linearnoj bazy\footnote{Linearna baza vsih (realnyh) čisel jest dana sistemom (realnyh) čisel, ktory dozvoljaje linearno, s racionalnymi koeficientami, izraziti vse (realne) čisla, dokolě medžu libovoljno konečno mnogimi bazovymi čislami ne jest nikakoj linearnoj relacije s racionalnymi koeficientami.}, napr. \(x_1\) i \(x_2\), take, že \(\varphi(x_1):x_1\ne\varphi(x_2):x_2\). Togda dvě uravnenja

original_reasons.text: Interslavic deliberately uses international diskontinuirny to avoid the false friend neprěryvny, which would read as continuous in several Slavic contexts.

title: diskontinuirny / kontinuirny / ekstremno diskontinuirny
isv: Para kontinuirny i diskontinuirny tvori prozračny opozitny par; ekstremno dodaje točno silnějše svojstvo, ne retorično pojačanje. V §4 sut kompleksne rěšenja aditivnogo ravnanja, ktore sut diskontinuirne, ale ne ekstremno diskontinuirne. Nakonečny teorem kasaje se rěšenij cěloj sistemy (1)–(4), s izključenjem z i jeho kompleksnogo konjugata. Razlika medžu jednim ravnjanjem i cěloju sistemoju jest neophodima, aby terminologija ne sugerovala ložnu teoremu.
en: Kontinuirny and diskontinuirny form a transparent opposed pair; ekstremno adds a precisely stronger property, not rhetorical emphasis. Section 4 gives complex solutions of the additive equation which are discontinuous but not extremely discontinuous. The concluding theorem concerns solutions of the full system (1)–(4), except z and its complex conjugate. Distinguishing one equation from the whole system is essential if the terminology is not to suggest a false theorem.

comparisons.title_en: One equation versus the full system
comparisons.text: Kontrapriměry i zaključny teorem imajut različne hipotezy.
comparisons.english: The counterexamples and the concluding theorem have different hypotheses.

passages.quote: imajut rěšenje v realnyh čislah \(\alpha,\beta\); zato \(a\) i \(b\) možno libovoljno dobro aproksimovati racionalnymi čislami \(\alpha,\beta\). A zato že \(\alpha,\beta\) sut racionalne, \(\alpha\varphi(x_1)+\beta\varphi(x_2)\) stvarno prědstavja \(\varphi(\alpha x_1+\beta x_2)\). To zaključanje odpada pri kompleksnyh sistemah cěnnostij. Zaisto, i v kompleksnoj oblasti možno dati rěšenja (1), ktore sut diskontinuirne, ale ne ekstremno diskontinuirne, napr.:

kde \(\varphi(x)\) znači realno rěšenje, ekstremno diskontinuirno v realnoj oblasti; ili ješče prostěje \(\varphi(z)=\varphi(x)\). V oběh slučajah realna čest \(\varphi(z)\) jest ekstremno diskontinuirna, dokolě imaginarna čest jest oprěděljena realnoju.

s realnymi \(\sigma\) i \(\tau\), nezavisnymi od \(x\) i \(\Xreal\). Osoblivo k \(x=1\) prinaleži takože někoje realno \(X_0\), i uslovje \(1=X_0(\sigma+i\tau)\) pokazuje, že mora byti \(\tau=0\), tako že \(f(x)=\sigma\cdot\Xreal\). Zato vsakomu realnomu \(z\) odpovědaje takože realno \(f(z)\); ili iz \(y=0\) slěduje \(Y=0\). Tym linearna relacija za realne \(z\) prěhodi v \(X-x=0\);\footnote{Tu upotrěblja se fakt, že \(c\ne0\), znači že ni \(c_3\), ni \(c_4\) ne izčezaje, dokolě prědtym bylo upotrěbljeno samo \(c_4\ne0\); zato slučaj, v ktorom jedno iz tyh dvoh izčezaje, trěba bylo razmotriti vnaprijed.} vsaka realna cěnnost odpovědaje samoj sobě. Ponovno imajemo samo \(f(z)=z\) ili \(\overline z\), znači stvarno rang dva. Tym rang tri jest izključen vo vsih slučajah. Ale, kako pokazujut izslědovanja prvyh čestij, diskontinuirne rěšenja stvarno obstojat, i one zato morajut iměti rang četyri; zato po č.~1 imaje město teorem: {\itshape «Vse rěšenja \(f(z)\) funkcionalnyh uravnenij (1)--(4), s izključenjem kontinuirnyh rěšenij \(f(z)=z\) ili \(\overline z\), sut v realnoj i v kompleksnoj oblasti ekstremno diskontinuirne».}\footnote{Lebesgue pokazuje na navedenom městu, že realna i imaginarna česti \(f(z)\) obě sut «neměrime» funkcije od \(x\) i \(y\); kako pokazuje priměr na početku č.~4, \(\varphi(z)=\varphi(x)+i(y+\varphi(x))\), iz togo ješče ne slěduje ekstremna diskontinuirnost v kompleksnoj oblasti.}

original_reasons.text: Continues Paper 10 intro. Ukrainian/Russian use standard continuity vocabulary; Interslavic pairs diskontinuirny with kontinuirny to avoid the false-friend risk logged for neprěryvny.

title: diskriminant
isv: Diskriminant zachovuje medžunarodnu osnovu i mužsky rod, už upotrěbjeny v rabotě 31. Vtory razlog izrično odbacaje vvedenje konkurentnoj ženske formy; prvi odbacaje novy opisny prěvod invariantnogo nazvanja. Oba razloge zato podpirajut i leksičny kontinuitet, i konkretnu imennikovu formu.
en: Diskriminant retains the international stem and the masculine form already used in Paper 31. The second rationale explicitly rejects introducing a competing feminine form; the first rejects a new descriptive paraphrase for the invariant. Together they support lexical continuity and a particular noun form.

original_reasons.text: Continues the Paper31 title and theorem vocabulary; no Slavic paraphrase is introduced for this established algebraic invariant.
All lanes keep the standard international algebraic noun. Interslavic keeps the masculine form diskriminant, already used in the project, rather than introducing a competing feminine calque.

title: diskriminant D_T / kvadrat determinanta konjugovanyh baznyh elementov
russian: дискриминант D_T / квадрат определителя сопряженных базисных элементов
ukrainian: дискримінант D_T / квадрат визначника спряжених базисних елементів
isv: Diskriminant $D_T$ jest svezany s kvadratom determinanta konjugovanyh baznyh elementov. Zapis prěnosi terminologiju iz odděla 6, punkta 4 do odděla 7 pri prěhodu od prstenov konečnogo ranga k poredkam. Kvadrat zato ostavaje izričny: determinanta bez kvadrata ne jest taj sam objekt.
en: Diskriminant $D_T$ is connected with the square of the determinant of conjugate basis elements. The record carries the vocabulary from section 6, point 4 into section 7 as the discussion passes from finite-rank rings to orders. Square remains explicit because the unsquared determinant is not the same object.

original_reasons.text: Connects §7 back to §6 no. 4; the determinant-square terminology remains stable across the transition from finite-rank rings to orders.

title: diskriminant D_{T_P}
isv: Diskriminant $D_{T_P}$ imenuje skalarny diskriminant, ne diskriminantny ideal. Indeks identifikuje odgovarjajuči objekt i ne može byti izgubjen pri skračenju nazvanja. Isti korenj diskriminant- v oběh terminah ne svodi skalar i ideal na jednu věšč.
en: Diskriminant $D_{T_P}$ names the scalar discriminant, not the discriminant ideal. Its index identifies the relevant object and cannot be lost in shortening the name. The shared diskriminant- stem does not collapse scalar and ideal into one entity.

original_reasons.text: Continues the scalar discriminant term and distinguishes it from the discriminant ideal.

title: diskriminant ideala vzhodno k klasu
source: Diskriminante eines Ideals bezüglich einer Klasse
isv: Diskriminant ideala ... k klasu zachovuje klas kako izričny parametr, paralelno konstrukcijam slěda i normy. Historijni kandidat ima vzhodno k; zapis objašnjaje potrěbu vyraziti odnos, ale ne dava jezyčnogo dokaza za tuto predložnu konstrukciju. Razlog za matematičnu funkciju proto trěba razlučiti od opravdanja konkretnyh slov.
en: Diskriminant ideala ... k klasu retains the class as an explicit parameter, parallel to the trace and norm constructions. The historical candidate has vzhodno k. Its rationale explains why the relation must be expressed but supplies no linguistic evidence for that prepositional phrase. The mathematical function and the justification of the wording are distinct questions.

comparisons.title_isv: Vyraženje odnosa: oficialny oblik i domova prednost
comparisons.title_en: Expressing a relation: dictionary support and house preference
comparisons.text: Aktualny tekst v dělu 31 ima po odnošenju k klasu i po odnošenju k osnovnomu prstenu. Kopija slovnika citovana v rěšenju o toj konstrukciji davaje oba zaglavja po odnošeńju k (18227) i v odnošeńju k (19113), s dativom i smyslom ‘po odnošenju k’. Zato argument, že samo prva forma jest oficialna, ne podpiraje izbora; konsistentna prednost jednoj formě može byti redakcijnoju konvencijeju. Osobny prilog vȯzhodno (4185) znači ‘na vȯzhod’, ne ‘po odnošenju k’. To ne opravdaje ranějše vzhodno k. Kratke odnosno (4107) ima rodni padež i zato ne jest mehanična zaměna frazy s dativom. Čitatelsko po odnošenju k slěduje osnovnomu pravopisu, kde ń prěhodi v n. Sravnjenje podpira značenje i padežno upravjanje, ne dokaz izměrenoj prednosti v razumělivosti.
comparisons.english: The current Paper 31 text has po odnošenju k klasu and po odnošenju k with the base ring. The dictionary copy cited by the decision supplies both po odnošeńju k (18227) and v odnošeńju k (19113), each with the dative and the meaning with regard to. The claim that only the former is official therefore cannot justify the choice; consistently preferring one remains a possible editorial convention. The separate adverb vȯzhodno (4185) means eastwards, not with respect to, and does not justify historical vzhodno k. Shorter odnosno (4107) governs the genitive, so it is not a mechanical replacement for a dative construction. Reader spelling po odnošenju k follows the basic-orthography treatment of ń as n. The comparison supports meaning and government, not measured superiority in intelligibility.

passages.quote: Diskriminant ideala po odnošenju k klasu.
diskriminantny ideal poredka $\mT$ po odnošenju k $\mo$

references.title: Medžuslovjansky slovnik / Interslavic Dictionary
references.locator: 18227, 19113, 4107, 4185; točne kopije / exact snapshots in supporting data

original_reasons.text: Carries forward the established Paper31 discriminant term and makes the class parameter explicit, matching the trace/norm phrasing from entries 6--7.

title: Diskriminant kako kvadrat determinanta
russian: дискриминант как квадрат определителя сопряженных базисных элементов
ukrainian: дискримінант як квадрат визначника спряжених базисних елементів
isv: Opis diskriminant kako kvadrat determinanta razjasnjaje formulu, a ne vvodit nezavisny termin. $S$ tut jest slěd, a alfa-elementy tvorjat bazu. Kvadrat odnaša se k cělomu determinantu matricy konjugovanyh baznyh elementov, ne k oddělnym elementam matricy. Vertikalne črty označajut determinant, ne apsolutnu veličinu ni kvadrat kompleksnogo modula. Arhiv spominaje ranějšu prověrku izvornogo obraza; nynějšno objašnjenje opiraje se na zachovanu formulu i kontekst, ne tvrdi novu prověrku obraza.
en: The description discriminant as the square of a determinant explains the formula rather than introducing an independent term. Here $S$ is the trace and the alpha elements form a basis. The square applies to the entire determinant of the matrix of conjugate basis elements, not to its individual entries. The vertical bars denote a determinant, not absolute value or squared complex modulus. The archive mentions an earlier image comparison; this explanation relies on the preserved formula and context and does not claim a new image check.

comparisons.text: Črty označajut determinant, ne kompleksny modul.
comparisons.english: The bars denote a determinant, not complex modulus.

passages.quote: kde pod $S(\gamma)$ razuměje se slěd, a pod $N(\gamma)$ norma po odnošenju k glavnomu klasu. Nehaj dalje $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$ jest modulna baza od $\mathfrak R$, sostoječa se iz elementov od $\mathfrak R$; togda diskriminant $|S(\alpha_i\alpha_j)|$ trěba izraziti prěz elementy iz vsih $K_k$. Ako
\alpha_j=\alpha_j^{(1)}e_1+\cdots+\alpha_j^{(n)}e_n,
|S(\alpha_i\alpha_j)|
\left|\sum_{k=1}^n \alpha_i^{(k)}\alpha_j^{(k)}\right|
\left|\alpha_i^{(k)}\right|^2.

To jest, diskriminant prědstavja se kako kvadrat determinanta konjugovanyh baznyh elementov. Osoblivo, ako $\mathfrak R$ samo jest polje, znači razširjeno polje prvogo roda svojego podpolja $P$, togda homomorfizmy od $\mathfrak R$ k $K_i$ prěhodet v izomorfizmy; pri tom elementy iz $P$ odpovědajut samym sobě, zato že komponenta od $P$ jest dana kako $P e_i$. Zato $K_i$, zato že vse oni ležet v občem obhvatnom polju $Q$, sut konjugovane polja po odnošenju k $P$; i imenno tyh $n$ izomorfizmov sut medžu soboju različne, kako pokazuje gornje determinantno prědstavjenje nenulovogo diskriminanta. Ako $\mathfrak R$ jest polje, togda prědstavjenje kako direktna suma v $K_1,\ldots,K_n$ dava $n$ konjugovanyh razširjenyh polj $n$-togo stepena nad $P$, ležečih v Galoisovom razširjenom polju i izomorfnyh k $\mathfrak R$. Prědstavjenje slěda, normy i diskriminanta togda prěhodi v znano prědstavjenje prěz konjugovane elementy. Trěba ješče raz podčrknuti, že $\mathfrak R$ prědpoklada se samo kako polje ekvivalentno k $K_i$, a ne kako polje samo už ležeče v Galoisovom razširjenom polju $Q$.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the determinant-square content and the scan-expanded Gram-determinant explanation. Interslavic uses international `determinant` and `diskriminant`, with transparent `bazny elementy`.

historical_form: diskriminant kako kvadrat determinanta konjugovanyh baznyh elementov

title: diskriminant R izčezaje
isv: Diskriminant $R$ izčezaje zachovuje uslovje nulovosti diskriminanta. Izvorni razlog naměrno ne měnja to na vyraženje o nenulovoj determinantě. Prěvod mora zachovati i imenovany invariant, i směr kriterija; podobnost algebraičnyh objektov ne opravdaje zaměnu.
en: Diskriminant $R$ izčezaje preserves vanishing of the discriminant. The recorded reason deliberately avoids changing it to a statement about a nonzero determinant. The translation must retain both the named invariant and the direction of the criterion; related algebraic objects are not interchangeable.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the discriminant-vanishing criterion explicit and avoids paraphrasing it as nonzero determinant language.

title: diskriminant, opreděljeny do kvadrata jedinicy, jest različny od nuly
source: bis auf das Quadrat einer Einheit bestimmte Diskriminante von Null verschieden
russian: дискриминант, определенный с точностью до квадрата единицы, отличен от нуля
ukrainian: дискримінант, визначений з точністю до квадрата одиниці, відмінний від нуля
isv: Opreděljeny do kvadrata jedinicy vyražaje nejednoznačnost izbora skalarnogo diskriminanta, zatymčas različny od nuly zachovuje tvrđenje o njegovoj nenulovosti. Tuto ne jest istovětna formulacija kriteriju črěz diskriminantny ideal. Kratka konstrukcija opreděljeny do jest zabilěženy jezyčny izbor, čiju priměnu trěba sravnjati v istom smyslu pri drugyh pojavjenjah.
en: Opreděljeny do kvadrata jedinicy expresses the ambiguity in choosing a scalar discriminant, while različny od nuly preserves its nonvanishing. This is not identical in formulation to a criterion stated through the discriminant ideal. The compact construction opreděljeny do is a recorded linguistic choice whose other occurrences require comparison in the same sense.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the determinant/discriminant scalar formulation distinct from the discriminant ideal criterion. Interslavic uses `opreděljeny do` as a compact 'determined up to' construction and logs it for future consistency checks.

title: diskriminantna matrica
isv: Diskriminantna matrica jest pridavnikova konstrukcija, paralelna ruskoj i ukrajinskoj. Matrica ostavaje imenovanjem objekta, ne zaměnjaje se slovom tablica; diskriminantna ukazyvaje na njegovu matematičnu funkciju. Izvorni razlog podpiraje kratko tehnično nazvanje bez novogo slovotvorstva.
en: Diskriminantna matrica is an adjective–noun construction parallel to the Russian and Ukrainian forms. Matrica remains the object name rather than being replaced by table; diskriminantna identifies its mathematical role. The recorded reason supports a short technical name without a new coinage.

original_reasons.text: Transparent adjective-plus-noun construction across all lanes; Interslavic uses matrica as the established technical noun.

title: diskriminantne idealy primarnyh kolc
isv: Diskriminantne idealy primarnyh kolc zachovujut familiju diskriminantnyh idealov i kvalifikaciju primarnyh prstenov. Razlog daje prednost medžunarodnomu diskriminantny prěd opisnym prěvodom radi tehničnoj prepoznavajemosti. On ne objašnjaje novu etimologiju i ne dostavjaje izměrenogo sravnjenja razumělivosti.
en: Diskriminantne idealy primarnyh kolc retains the discriminant-ideal family and the qualification of the rings as primary. The rationale favours international diskriminantny over a paraphrase for technical recognizability. It neither establishes a new etymology nor supplies a measured intelligibility comparison.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the established discriminant-ideal vocabulary from Paper31 §5 and the stable primary-ring family (`первинне/первичное кільце/кольцо`, `primarno kolco`). Interslavic uses the international `diskriminantny` stem because it is more recognizable in technical algebra than a calque.

title: diskriminantny ideal
isv: Diskriminantny ideal tvori se pridavnikom i imennikom, ne zaměnnoju frazoju o generovanji. Definicija opreděljaje ideal generovany diskriminantnymi determinantami, ale vsako daljše imenovanje ne mora ponoviti cělu definiciju. Dva zapisy povezuju isto kratko nazvanje s formalnym tvorjenjem ideala.
en: Diskriminantny ideal uses an adjective and a noun rather than replacing the name with a generating description. The definition specifies the ideal generated by discriminant determinants, but later references need not repeat the entire definition. Two records connect the same short name with that formal construction.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the adjective+noun structure instead of paraphrasing, matching the subsequent definition of the ideal generated by discriminant determinants.
Keeps the already-established discriminant-ideal term and now gives its formal ideal-generation definition.

title: diskriminantny ideal ... nulovy ideal
isv: Diskriminantny ideal i nulovy ideal zachovujut dve nazvanja nužne za konkretno tvrdženje. Jednina jest naměrna: paragraf govori o jednom diskriminantnom idealu, iako naslov razmatra familiju idealov. Čislo imennika mora slědovati objektu pasaže, ne mehanično formě naslova.
en: Diskriminantny ideal and nulovy ideal retain the two names needed by the statement. The singular is deliberate: the paragraph concerns one discriminant ideal even though the heading treats a family. Grammatical number follows the passage's object, not mechanically the heading's form.

original_reasons.text: Continues the §5 and §6 discriminant-ideal vocabulary and pairs it explicitly with the zero ideal. The singular form is used because the paragraph concerns one discriminant ideal, not the heading's family of ideals.

title: diskriminantny ideal jest jediničny ideal v P
source: Diskriminantenideal ist das Einheitsideal in P
russian: дискриминантный идеал является единичным идеалом в P
ukrainian: дискримінантний ідеал є одиничним ідеалом у P
isv: Diskriminantny ideal jest jediničny ideal v $P$ stavja jednakost idealov na prvo město. Tek potom slěduje ekvivalentna formulacija s skalarnym diskriminantom. Prěvod zachovuje toj poredok i ne podměnjaje ideal čislom; jediničny ideal jest tehnično nazvanje, ne prosto jedinica v proze.
en: Diskriminantny ideal jest jediničny ideal v $P$ puts equality of ideals first, before the equivalent scalar-discriminant formulation. The translation preserves that order and does not substitute a number for an ideal. Jediničny ideal is a technical name, not simply the number one in prose.

original_reasons.text: Continues the unit-ideal vocabulary from §6 no. 2 and keeps the ideal equality as the primary criterion, before the equivalent scalar discriminant formulation.

title: diskriminantny ideal kolca
isv: Diskriminantny ideal kolca imenuje konstrukciju na urovnju prstena, polagajuču glavny klas v osnovu. Izvorni zapis svezava nazvanje s konečnoju větoju iz odděla 5 i njegovoju upotrěboju v oddělu 6. Njegovo pozvanje na pečatny iztočnik jest čestju istorijnogo dokaza; ne predstavlja novu prověrku skana pri pisanju ovogo objasnjenja.
en: Diskriminantny ideal kolca names the ring-level construction based on the principal class. The record connects the term with the final sentence of section 5 and its use in section 6. Its appeal to the printed source belongs to the historical evidence; it is not a fresh examination of the scan for this explanation.

original_reasons.text: The printed scan's final sentence names the principal-class construction at the ring level; this term is needed immediately in §6.

title: diskriminantny ideal komponentnogo ideala
isv: Diskriminantny ideal komponentnogo ideala zachovuje dva urovnja opisa: komponent jest ideal, a od njega tvori se diskriminantny ideal. Odgovarjajuči klas ostavaje parametrom konstrukcije. Skračenje do diskriminant komponenta moglo by skryti i tip objekta, i njegov odnos k klasu.
en: Diskriminantny ideal komponentnogo ideala preserves two levels of description: the component is an ideal, and its discriminant ideal is constructed. The relevant class remains a parameter. Shortening to discriminant of the component could obscure both the type of object and its relation to the class.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the nested object: the component is an ideal, and the discriminant ideal is taken with respect to a class.

title: diskriminantny ideal od R
isv: Diskriminantny ideal od $R$ prěnosi nazvanje prstenovogo objekta iz odděla 5, punkta 3 do formulacije kriterija. Identifikator $R$ ostavaje izričny. Historijni razlog govori o oporě v pečatnom iztočniku; tuto objasnjenje zachovuje jeho argument, ne tvrdži novu nezavisnu kolaciju.
en: Diskriminantny ideal od $R$ carries the ring-level naming from section 5, point 3 into the criterion. The identifier $R$ remains explicit. The historical rationale invokes the printed source; this explanation preserves that reasoning without claiming a new independent collation.

original_reasons.text: Carries forward the scan-restored ring-level discriminant-ideal naming from §5 no. 3 into the criterion statement.

title: diskriminantny ideal porjadka T
isv: Diskriminantny ideal porjadka $T$ dodaje nazvanje tipa objekta, ktory jest už definovany prěd tym. Porjadka zato ima objasnjujuču funkciju; ne smije proměniti referent $T$ ili vnesti novo prědpoloženje. Izbor jest lokalno razkrytje informacije, ne dozvoljenje proizvoljno razširjati avtorske tvrdženja.
en: Diskriminantny ideal porjadka $T$ supplies the kind of object already defined in the preceding text. Porjadka is explanatory: it must not change the referent of $T$ or introduce a new hypothesis. The choice is local explicitation, not permission to expand the author's claims arbitrarily.

original_reasons.text: Adds `order` in the target languages for readability while preserving the mathematical object from the preceding definition.

title: diskriminantny ideal pri prěhodu k kolcu kvocientov
source: Das Diskriminantenideal beim Übergang zum Quotientenring
russian: дискриминантный идеал при переходе к кольцу частных
ukrainian: дискримінантний ідеал при переході до кільця часток
isv: Naslov zachovuje diskriminantny ideal i imenuje operaciju prěhoda k prstenu kvocientov. Izvorni razlog prodolžaje prědhodno imenovanje togo prstena i daje prednost kratkoj naslovnoj konstrukciji. Smysl kvocientov trěba ustanoviti po definiciji v dělu, ne samo po podobnosti s anglijskym quotient ring; ruska i ukrajinska paralela ovde izrično govore o častnyh ili častkah.
en: The heading retains discriminant ideal and names passage to the ring of quotients. The recorded reason continues the earlier name for that ring and favours a compact heading. The sense of quotients must be determined from the work's definition, not merely from resemblance to English quotient ring; the Russian and Ukrainian parallels here explicitly use their vocabulary for fractions or quotients.

comparisons.title_isv: Prsten kvocientov i prsten klasov ostatkov
comparisons.title_en: A ring of fractions and a residue-class ring
comparisons.text: V dělu 31, oddělu 8, punktu 3, prsten kvocientov jest definovany črěz elementy polja kvocientov s dopuščenyh imenovateljev. V tom samom punktu sravnjavajut se prsteny klasov ostatkov pri korespondenciji idealov. To sut različne konstrukcije. Nazvanje v punktu 4, Diskriminantny ideal pri prěhodu k prstenu kvocientov, odkazuje na prvu konstrukciju, ne na faktor-prsten po idealu. Anglijsky izraz quotient ring v ranom objasnjenju sam ne razlučaje tute smysly; definicija jest odlučajuča. Tekst takojže ima prsten, kde historijni kandidat ima kolco. Tuto sravnjenje ustanavjaje lokalny smysl i aktualnu formu, ne dokazuje věrnost vsih pasaž izdanja.
comparisons.english: In Paper 31, section 8, point 3, the ring is defined through elements of a fraction field with specified admissible denominators. The same point discusses residue-class rings in a correspondence between ideals. These are different constructions. The heading in point 4, Diskriminantny ideal pri prěhodu k prstenu kvocientov, refers to the first construction, not to a quotient by an ideal. The early explanation's English label quotient ring cannot by itself disambiguate the senses; the definition is decisive. The text also has prsten where the historical candidate has kolco. This comparison establishes a local sense and current wording, not the fidelity of every passage in the edition.

passages.quote: Prsten kvocientov $\mT_\ma$ jest oprěděljeno kako cělost elementov polja kvocientov
Diskriminantny ideal pri prěhodu k prstenu kvocientov.

original_reasons.text: Continues Entry05 quotient-ring vocabulary and the established `diskriminantny ideal` lane; the phrase is section-heading material, so it is kept compact and title-like.

title: diskriminantny ideal T vzhodno k o
source: Diskriminantenideal von T in bezug auf o
isv: Diskriminantny ideal $T$ ... k $o$ zachovuje oba parametry konstrukcije i pridavnik diskriminantny. Zapis nazyvaje vzhodno k ustaljenym sposobom vyraziti ‘po odnošenju k’, ale opakovana upotrěba sama ne jest jezyčnym dokazom. Tuto tvrdženje o ranějšej praksě mora ostati odvojeno od prověrky, čto konstrukcija pravilno znači.
en: Diskriminantny ideal $T$ ... k $o$ retains both parameters and the adjective diskriminantny. The record calls vzhodno k an established way to express with respect to, but repeated use is not linguistic evidence by itself. That account of earlier practice must remain separate from checking what the expression actually means.

comparisons.title_isv: Vyraženje odnosa: oficialny oblik i domova prednost
comparisons.title_en: Expressing a relation: dictionary support and house preference
comparisons.text: Aktualny tekst v dělu 31 ima po odnošenju k klasu i po odnošenju k osnovnomu prstenu. Kopija slovnika citovana v rěšenju o toj konstrukciji davaje oba zaglavja po odnošeńju k (18227) i v odnošeńju k (19113), s dativom i smyslom ‘po odnošenju k’. Zato argument, že samo prva forma jest oficialna, ne podpiraje izbora; konsistentna prednost jednoj formě može byti redakcijnoju konvencijeju. Osobny prilog vȯzhodno (4185) znači ‘na vȯzhod’, ne ‘po odnošenju k’. To ne opravdaje ranějše vzhodno k. Kratke odnosno (4107) ima rodni padež i zato ne jest mehanična zaměna frazy s dativom. Čitatelsko po odnošenju k slěduje osnovnomu pravopisu, kde ń prěhodi v n. Sravnjenje podpira značenje i padežno upravjanje, ne dokaz izměrenoj prednosti v razumělivosti.
comparisons.english: The current Paper 31 text has po odnošenju k klasu and po odnošenju k with the base ring. The dictionary copy cited by the decision supplies both po odnošeńju k (18227) and v odnošeńju k (19113), each with the dative and the meaning with regard to. The claim that only the former is official therefore cannot justify the choice; consistently preferring one remains a possible editorial convention. The separate adverb vȯzhodno (4185) means eastwards, not with respect to, and does not justify historical vzhodno k. Shorter odnosno (4107) governs the genitive, so it is not a mechanical replacement for a dative construction. Reader spelling po odnošenju k follows the basic-orthography treatment of ń as n. The comparison supports meaning and government, not measured superiority in intelligibility.

passages.quote: Diskriminant ideala po odnošenju k klasu.
diskriminantny ideal poredka $\mT$ po odnošenju k $\mo$

references.title: Medžuslovjansky slovnik / Interslavic Dictionary
references.locator: 18227, 19113, 4107, 4185; točne kopije / exact snapshots in supporting data

original_reasons.text: Uses the adjectival discriminant-ideal form consistently with earlier discriminant terminology. Interslavic `vzhodno k` is logged because it is the standing choice for `with respect to` in this algebraic register.

title: diskriminantny kriterij polnoj razložimosti prvogo roda
source: Diskriminantenkriterium der vollständigen Reduzibilität erster Art
russian: дискриминантный критерий полной приводимости первого рода
ukrainian: дискримінантний критерій цілковитої звідності першого роду
isv: Diskriminantny kriterij polnoj razložimosti prvogo roda zachovuje cělost kvalifikacij. Razložimost nastavlja termin iz odděla 3; ukrajinska paralela naměrno izbira zvìdnìstʹ vměsto zajma reducibelʹnistʹ, dokolě ruska ima privodimostʹ. To sravnjenje podpiraje značenje redukcije, ne dozvoljaje izpustiti polna ili prvogo roda.
en: Diskriminantny kriterij polnoj razložimosti prvogo roda preserves the full set of qualifications. Razložimost continues section 3 terminology; the Ukrainian choice deliberately prefers звідність over borrowed редуцибельність, while Russian has приводимость. The comparison concerns the reduction sense, not permission to omit complete or of the first kind.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the stable §3 reducibility family: Ukrainian uses native звідність rather than a borrowed редуцибельність, Russian keeps приводимость, and Interslavic keeps razložimost as the transparent constructed-language choice.

title: divergencija / divergencijne relacije
isv: Divergencija i divergencijne relacije zachovujut organizaciju dokaza okolo divergencijnyh identičnostij. Relacija imenuje odnos na urovnju formuly; divergencija ostavaje medžunarodno ime operacije. Izbor ne pretvarjaje každu relaciju v odvojenu novu definiciju divergencije.
en: Divergencija and divergencijne relacije preserve the proof's organization around divergence identities. Relacija names a formula-level relation, while divergencija remains the international operation name. The choice does not turn each relation into a separate new definition of divergence.

original_reasons.text: The proof is organized around divergence identities. Ukrainian/Russian use compact modern divergence wording; Interslavic keeps international divergencija plus relacija for formula-level relations.

title: dlžina i
isv: Dlžina $i$ v §2 raboty 30 jest položaj elementa v postupnom sistemu porodžajučih elementov $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_k$. Element možno izraziti prěz prve $i$ elementov, ale ne prěz prve $i-1$. To ne jest geometrična dlžina niti bez dodatnogo dokaza dlžina kompozicijnogo reda modula. Arhivny razlog izbira prěmy naziv za to postupno razširjanje. Poredok porodžajučih elementov jest čest definicije; oni ne muset tvoriti nezavisnu bazu. Zato tu ne dostatočno govoriti samo o čislu koeficientov v jednom izbranom zapisu.
en: In §2 of Paper 30, dlžina $i$ gives an element's position in the successive spans of the ordered generators $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_k$. It can be expressed using the first $i$ generators, but not the first $i-1$. This is neither geometric length nor, without further argument, the composition length of a module. The recorded reason chooses a direct name for this successive construction. The ordering belongs to the definition, and the generators need not form an independent basis. Counting the coefficients in one chosen expression would therefore be insufficient.

comparisons.text: §2 raboty 30 definira dlžinu prěz najmanjši početkovy spisok $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_i$, dostatočny dlja izraženja elementa. Definicija ne požada nezavisnost generatorov i ne jest definicija kompozicijnoj dlžiny.
comparisons.english: Section 2 of Paper 30 defines length through the shortest initial list $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_i$ sufficient to express the element. The definition does not require independent generators and is not the definition of composition length.

passages.quote: Za modulnu oblast očitno ostavajut validne vse definicije modulov dane v §1, 1, ktore ne odnoset se k množenju. Osoblivo $M$ nazyvaje se konečna modulna oblast, ako obstaja konečno mnogo elementov $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_k$ iz $M$ tako, že $M$ jest ravno modulu vyvedenomu iz $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_k$, znači sistemu vsih linearnyh form $r_1\xi_1+\cdots+r_k\xi_k$, ako v $R$ egzistuje jediničny element, dokole inače prihodet ješče dodatne členy $n_i\xi_i$.

\noindent\textbf{Modulny teorem.} Naj $M$ bude konečna modulna oblast po odnošenju k komutativnomu prstenu $R$ s jediničnym elementom, i naj v $R$ imaje město uslovje cěpov děliteljev odnosno uslovje cěpov kratnyh za idealy. Togda v $M$ imaje město uslovje cěpov děliteljev odnosno uslovje cěpov kratnyh za moduly.

Dokaz opiraje se na to, že vsakomu modulu iz $M$ jednoznačno prirědžuje se sistem konečno mnogyh idealov iz $R$ tako, že vlastnomu dělitelju odnosno vlastnomu kratnomu modula vsegda odgovarja prinajmenje jeden vlastny dělitelj odnosno vlastno kratno medžu idealami.

Element iz $M$ nazyvaje se elementom dlžiny $i$, ako može byti prědstavjen prinajmenje jednym načinom kako linearna forma v $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_i$, ale ne dopušča prědstavjenja kako linearna forma v $\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_{i-1}$. Libovoljnomu modulu $W$ iz $M$ nyně prirědimo $k$ idealov $\mathfrak a_1,\ldots,\mathfrak a_k$ iz $R$: pod $W_i$ razuměje se modul vsih elementov iz $W$ dlžiny $\le i$, a $\mathfrak a_i$ označa sistem vsih koeficientov pri $\xi_i$ v $W_i$. Ako $B$ jest vlastny dělitelj od $W$, a $\mathfrak b_1,\ldots,\mathfrak b_k$ sut idealy prirědžene $B$, togda medžu $\mathfrak b_i$ jest prinajmenje jeden vlastny dělitelj odgovarjajučego $\mathfrak a_i$. Zato že iz $B\equiv0\pmod W$ slěduje $B_i\equiv0\pmod {W_i}$ i zato $\mathfrak b_i\equiv0\pmod{\mathfrak a_i}$ za $i=1,2,\ldots,k$. Po prědpoloženju v $B$ morajut byti elementy, ktore ne sut vsebovane v $W$, znači takože take najmanjše dlžiny $\ell$. Togda $\mathfrak b_\ell$ stava vlastny dělitelj od $\mathfrak a_\ell$; zato že $b_\ell\equiv0\pmod{\mathfrak b_\ell}$, $b_\ell\not\equiv0\pmod{\mathfrak a_\ell}$, ako

original_reasons.text: Direct term for the triangular filtration by generators xi_1,...,xi_i.

title: dobro uporjadkovana množina / dobro uporjadkovanje
isv: Dobro uporjadkovana množina i dobro uporjadkovanje nazyvajut tehničny poredok, ne prosto uredny spis. Primětka upotrěbjaje dobry poredok funkcij dlja poslědovateljnogo postrojenja dopustimogo sistema: funkcije prijmajut se ili izključajut se po zadanoj algebraičnoj prověrke. Procedura može byti prěkinjena na libovoljnom městu, a razgledanje vseh poredkov i měst prěkinjenja dava vse dopustime sistemy. Zato smysl ne možno skratiti do prosto izbrati funkcije; redoslednost jest čest konstrukcije.
en: Dobro uporjadkovana množina and dobro uporjadkovanje name a technical ordering, not merely a tidy list. The footnote uses a well-order of functions to construct an admissible system successively: functions are admitted or excluded by a specified algebraic test. The procedure may stop at any point, and considering every ordering and stopping point gives all admissible systems. The meaning cannot therefore be reduced simply to choose functions; the order is part of the construction.

comparisons.text: Redoslednost i město prěkinjenja sut česti postupka.
comparisons.english: The order and stopping point are parts of the procedure.

passages.quote: prěz algebraično-cělu adjunkciju dopustimogo sistema $\mathfrak S$ k
$\mathfrak G_\eta$. Kogda $H$ proběgaje vsaku možnu algebraičnu bazu,
$\mathfrak M(H)$ proběgaje sovkupnost vsih oblastij $\mathfrak H$.}\footnote{Dopustime
sistemy $\mathfrak S$ možno najti tako. Vse algebraično-drobne funkcije od
$\eta$ podčiniti někojemu dobromu uporjadkovanju $\Omega$, i vzeti v
$\mathfrak S$ vse funkcije, kromě tyh, ktore, algebraično-cělo adjungovane k
$\mathfrak G_\eta$ i raněje prijetym funkcijam, rodijut algebraično-drobno
čislo. Tu proceduru možno prěkiniti na kojom-koli městu. Kogda $\Omega$
proběgaje vsako dobro uporjadkovanje, i pri vsakom fiksovanom $\Omega$ procedura
prěkinaje se na kojom-koli městu, tym sut izčerpane vse dopustime sistemy
$\mathfrak S$.}

original_reasons.text: The footnote uses well-ordering as a construction procedure for admissible systems; the wording is kept explicit rather than folded into a choice/selection phrase.

title: dobro uporjadkovanje
isv: Dobro uporjadkovanje prodolžaje termin iz uvoda i shranjaje tehničny smysl dobrogo poredka. V sekciji 8 ono služi izboru predstaviteljev: oblast prijmaje se, ako ne jest izomorfna nijednoj prědhodnoj oblasti. Prva vozmožna iznimka potom vodi k proturěčenju. V ranějšem priměru, naprotiv, nijedno dobro uporjadkovanje ne dava želanyh svojstv. Jedna nazva mora dopuščati oba logična konteksta; ona ne sugeruje, že libovoljny izbor daje tu samu bazu. Arhiv ostavlja jezyčnu formu dlja ocěny, bez čitateljske prověrky razumljivosti.
en: Dobro uporjadkovanje continues the introductory term and retains the technical sense of a well-order. In section 8 it selects representatives: a domain is admitted if it is not isomorphic to any preceding domain. A first possible exception then yields a contradiction. In an earlier example, by contrast, no well-order gives the desired properties. One name must support both logical contexts; it does not suggest that arbitrary choices produce the same basis. The archive leaves the linguistic form open to assessment, without a reader test of intelligibility.

comparisons.text: Ista nazva služi raznym kvantifikacijam.
comparisons.english: The same name occurs under different quantifiers.

passages.quote: {\itshape Naprotiv, pri nijednom dobrom uporjadkovanju nemožno iz $\mathfrak G$ izbrati bazu tako, že by $\mathfrak G$ izključala vse racionalno- i algebraično-drobne funkcije od bazovyh veličin.} Za dokaz nehaj $z(\eta)$ bude koja-koli funkcija oblasti, ktoru trěba izbrati kako bazovu veličinu, to jest funkcija oprěděljena uravnenjem:
