The recorded rationale connects that choice to a dense technical passage and its rank statement; the current text uses faktor-prsten. Over the algebraically closed base field, the quotient of a properly primary ring by its associated ideal has rank one, while the primary ring itself has at least two basis elements. Rank one therefore does not mean that the quotient has only one element. The discriminant argument depends on basis products and vanishing traces. The historical note also says that the quotient explanation was restored from the printed text. That claim is preserved as an archival claim, not presented as a new independent comparison with the printed original.

comparisons.title_isv: Rang jedan ne znači jeden element
comparisons.title_en: Rank one does not mean one element
comparisons.text: Kvocient imaje rang jedan, medžutym vlastno primarny prsten imaje veću bazu.
comparisons.english: The quotient has rank one while the properly primary ring has a larger basis.

passages.quote: Dalje možno pokazati, že diskriminantny ideal vlastno primarnogo prstena s algebraično zamknjenym podprstenom $P$ jest ravny nulovomu idealu. Ako za $\mathfrak R$ vzeti kako osnovu specialnu modulnu bazu, danu v punktu 1, ili samo dopolniti libovoljnu bazu od $\mathfrak p$ do bazy od $\mathfrak R$, togda $i_0$ jest ravno jednomu, zato že faktor-prsten $\mathfrak R/\mathfrak p$ stavaje prstenom ranga jedan; kako $\pi_{0,1}$ možno napr. vzeti jediničny element $e$. Tym vse bazne produkty različne od $e^2$ sut děljive prěz $\mathfrak p$, i ih slěd, vzety po odnošenju k glavnomu klasu, izčezaje. Tym izčezaje takože diskriminanta kako determinanta reda prinajmenje dva, zato že $\mathfrak R$ bylo prědpoloženo kako vlastno primarno i zato mora iměti prinajmenje jeden bazny element različny od $e$; v toj determinantě vse elementy različne od $S_{(\mathfrak R)}(e^2)$ izčezajut.

original_reasons.text: Restores the printed quotient-ring explanation omitted in the clean source. Interslavic uses the international `faktor-kolco`, which is clearer for quotient rings than a native calque at this technical density.

title: faktorgrupa
isv: Faktorgrupa sohranjaje internacionalny složeny nazv, sravnjeny s ruskym i ukrajinskim faktor-grupa. Razlog jest kratky: on nazyvaje termin sovrěmennym i prozračnym, bez osobnogo sravnjenja s drugymi medžuslovjanskimi kandidatami. Pisanje jednym slovom razlikuje se od sravniteljnyh form s defisom. Zapis ne dokazuje ni obšču pravopisnu normu za vse kompozity s faktor-, ni čitateljski izměrenu razumělivost.
en: Faktorgrupa retains the international compound, compared with Russian and Ukrainian hyphenated forms. The reason is brief: it calls the term modern and transparent without separately comparing other Interslavic candidates. Writing it as one word differs from the hyphenated comparanda. The record establishes neither a general spelling rule for every faktor- compound nor reader-tested intelligibility.

original_reasons.text: Modern algebraic term; Interslavic uses the transparent international compound.

title: faktorna sistema
isv: Faktorna sistema jest pridavnik s imenem, prodolžajuči izbor iz raboty 39 v rabotě 41. Motivacija jest morfologična kontinuitet, ne novy smisyl faktora. Ruske i ukrajinske bukvy v tutom zapisě ne sut zachovane, zato sam zapis ne može potvrditi jejich točnu grafiju. Čitatelj može sravniti nepovrěđene formy v TERM-0547, bez pretvarjanja, že one sut obnovjene bukvy tutogo zapisa.
en: Faktorna sistema uses adjective plus noun, continuing the choice from Paper 39 into Paper 41. The motivation is morphological continuity, not a new meaning for factor. The Russian and Ukrainian lettering in this record is lost, so the record cannot establish those exact spellings. Readers can compare the intact forms in TERM-0547 without treating them as recovered letters from this record.

original_reasons.text: Stable modern algebraic term; Interslavic uses adjective+noun morphology already established in Paper39.

title: faktorna sistema jedinica
isv: Faktorna sistema jedinica sohranjaje historijnu formulaciju Noether. Razlog izrično odbacaje zaměnu s trivialny kocikl, zato že formuly raboty upotrěbjajut jezyk faktornyh sistem. Sravnjenje s pozdnějšej terminologijej može byti polezno v objasnjenju, ale ne smi tiho zaměniti avtorske pojmenovanje v prěvodě. Jedinica jest čest toj formulacije, ne čislo sistemov.
en: Faktorna sistema jedinica preserves Noether's historical formulation. The rationale explicitly rejects replacing it with trivial cocycle because the paper's formulas use factor-system terminology. Comparison with later terminology may help in an explanation, but must not silently replace the author's designation in the translation. Jedinica belongs to that formulation; it is not a count of systems.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether's exact factor-system formulation. The phrase is deliberately not paraphrased as trivial cocycle because the paper's formulas use the historical factor-system vocabulary.

title: faktorne sistemy
isv: Zapisy k rabotam 32 i 39 izbirajut faktorne sistemy v Brauerovoj konstrukciji. Pridavnik faktorne prěvodi složeny nazv, ne ostavjajuči faktor kako samostatno ime; historijni razlog dava tomu prednost prěd oblikom s defisom faktor-sistema. Vtoroj motiv jest kontinuitet, osoblivo v podnožnoj primětkě, kde novy sinonim byl by nepotrěbny. Opis formy s defisom kako rusko podobnoj jest stilistična ocěna zapisa, ne dokaz, že medžuslovjanska gramatika takovu formu zakazuje.
en: Records for Papers 32 and 39 choose faktorne sistemy in Brauer's construction. Adjectival faktorne renders the compound without leaving faktor as a separate noun; the historical rationale prefers this to hyphenated faktor-sistema. A second motive is continuity, especially in a footnote where a new synonym would be unnecessary. Calling the hyphenated shape Russian-looking is the record's stylistic assessment, not evidence that Interslavic grammar prohibits it.

original_reasons.text: Brauer's construction uses factor systems in the cohomological/crossed-product sense. Ukrainian/Russian have stable hyphenated loan terms; Interslavic chooses a transparent adjective+noun form to avoid overloading faktor as a standalone noun.
Maintains the established Paper32 factor-system term and avoids creating a new constructed-language synonym in a footnote.
Paper32 already stabilized Interslavic faktorne sistemy rather than a hyphenated factor-sistema; this keeps adjective+noun grammar and avoids a Russian-looking loan shape.

title: fiksovany klas
isv: Fiksovany klas ohranjaje zavisnost od izbranogo klasa. Razlog ukazuje na slědujuče sravnjenje so slědom i normoju v oblastjah, kde oni ne zavisjat od takogo izbora. Pridavnik zato nosi matematičnu informaciju, ne samo stilističny naglasok. Fiksovany v toj frazě znači izbrany i zadržany v razsmotrenju; bez drugogo konteksta ne znači invariantny pod vsem transformacijami.
en: Fiksovany klas preserves dependence on a chosen class. The rationale points to the following contrast with trace and norm in domains, where they are independent of that choice. The adjective therefore carries mathematical information, not merely emphasis. Fixed here means selected and held in the discussion; without further context it does not mean invariant under every transformation.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the fixed class parameter visible because the next sentence contrasts this with class-independent trace and norm in domains.

title: forma $\mu$-go stepena po $x$ i $\lambda$-go stepena po $u$
source: $(\mu,\lambda)$ eine Form $\mu$ten Grades in $x$, $\lambda$ten Grades in $u$
russian: форма $\mu$-й степени по $x$ и $\lambda$-й степени по $u$
ukrainian: форма $\mu$-го степеня за $x$ і $\lambda$-го степеня за $u$
isv: Forma ima dva nezavisna stepena: μ po proměnnoj x i λ po proměnnoj u. Prěvod izgovarjaje oba odnosa, aby čitatelj ne směšal bidegree s jednym ukupnym stepenem. Zapis -go pri simbolu označaje porědkovo čislo; arhivny razlog go predstavlja kako praktičnu pisemnu konvenciju, ne kako dokazanu jedinu mogućnost.
en: The form has two independent degrees: μ in x and λ in u. The wording states both relations rather than suggesting one total degree. The suffix -go after a symbol was recorded as a practical way of writing the ordinal, not as an independently established unique solution.

original_reasons.text: All lanes make the bidegree convention explicit. Interslavic ordinal suffix -go is a practical review-facing choice for formula-adjacent prose.

title: forma elementarnyh děliteljev
isv: Forma elementarnyh děliteljev imenuje cěly invariant v rabotě 24, ne jedin elementarny dělitelj. Genitivna konstrukcija zachovuje odnos formy k děliteljam i odpověda ruskomu i ukrajinskomu sravnjenju. Kratky razlog potvrđuje kontinuitet nazvanja, ale ne dava pravo zaměniti formu proizvoljnoju drugoju normalnoju formoju.
en: Forma elementarnyh děliteljev names the whole invariant in Paper 24, not one elementary divisor. The genitive construction retains the relation of the form to its divisors and parallels the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda. The brief rationale establishes continuity of naming, not permission to substitute an arbitrary different normal form.

original_reasons.text: Retains the elementary-divisor form phrase as the central Paper24 invariant.

title: forma elementarnyh děliteljev / eksponenta
isv: Forma elementarnyh děliteljev i eksponenta sut dva povezane termina iz raboty 24. Razlog ostavjaje eksponenta za osobny Steinitzov smysl v karakteristikě $p$, a za obyčne stepeni upominaje potęga. To jest zabilěžena smyslova razlika, ne obče pravilo zaměny vsake pojavy Exponent. Etimologični zapis potęga jest zachovany v sravnjenju; sam po sobě ne ustanavjaje aktualny osnovny pravopis v cělom prěvodu.
en: Forma elementarnyh děliteljev and eksponenta are two associated terms from Paper 24. The rationale reserves eksponenta for the particular Steinitz sense in characteristic $p$ and mentions potęga for ordinary powers. This is a recorded semantic distinction, not a universal replacement rule for every occurrence of Exponent. The etymological spelling potęga is retained in the comparison; it does not by itself establish the current basic spelling throughout the translation.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the cumulative invariant-theory vocabulary. `Exponent` is retained as `експонента/экспонента/eksponenta` for the characteristic-p Steinitz term; ordinary powers remain `степінь/степень/potęga`.

title: forma elementarnyh děliteljev / norma
isv: Forma elementarnyh děliteljev i norma ostavajut dva različne invarianty. Dva razloga povezuju osnovu dělitelj s prozračnostju slovotvorjenja, a norma s medžunarodnoju terminologijeju. Odděl sravnjava, kogda tute invarianty sut proste, primarne, ravne ili povezane stepenju. Zapis ih v jednom zaglavju ne smije zatriti te razlike ni predstaviti ih kako sinonimy.
en: Forma elementarnyh děliteljev and norma remain two different invariants. The two rationales associate dělitelj with transparent word formation and norma with international terminology. The section compares when these invariants are simple, primary, equal, or related by a power. Grouping them under one heading must not erase those distinctions or present them as synonyms.

original_reasons.text: These are the main Paper24 invariants and remain unchanged from Section 1. Interslavic keeps the transparent `dělitelj` family and the international `norma`.
The section is organized around the two invariants and repeatedly compares when they are simple functions, primary functions, equal, or power-related.

title: forma kriviny
isv: Forma kriviny razviva německy kompozit v jasnu konstrukciju s genitivom. Razlog svęzuje termin s konstrukcijeju Riemanna i Lipschitza i naměrno ne zaměnjaje jego nazvom konkretnogo pozdnějšego tenzora. Takovo zadržanje historijnoj širiny pojma ne jest zabranoju sovrěmennogo objasnjenja, ale ono mora ostati odvojeno od avtorskogo nazva. Sama fraza ne dovoljuje avtomatično pripisati vse definicije današnjej diferencialnoj geometrije.
en: Forma kriviny expands the German compound into a clear genitive construction. The rationale connects the term with the Riemann-Lipschitz construction and deliberately avoids replacing it with the name of a particular later tensor. Retaining that historical breadth does not preclude modern explanation, but such explanation must remain distinct from the author's designation. The phrase alone does not license importing all present-day differential-geometric definitions.

original_reasons.text: The curvature form is central to the Riemann/Lipschitz construction. All lanes use transparent curvature-form wording instead of over-modernizing to a specific later tensor label.

title: forma kriviny
isv: Forma kriviny jest izbrana vměsto modernizujučej tensornoj parafrazy zato, že termin izvornika govori o formě. V rabotě 12 forma Riemanna ima specialno město pri kvadratičnyh formah v teoremu redukcije; tekst raboty 23 ponovno veže ju s istim slučajem. Ruskij izraz s kriviznoju i ukrajinskij s krivinoju podpirajut geometričny smysl kriviny, ale ne izjednačajut vsaku formu s tensorom. Izbor čuvaje istoriju matematičnogo izloženja, ne zastarělu pravopisnu osoblivost.
en: Forma kriviny was preferred to a modernizing tensor paraphrase because the source names a form. In Paper 12, Riemann’s form has a special role for quadratic forms in the reduction theorem; Paper 23 connects it with the same case. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the meaning curvature, not an unrestricted equivalence between form and tensor. The choice preserves the mathematical exposition’s historical vocabulary, rather than merely an old spelling.

comparisons.title_en: Curvature form in the reduction theorem
comparisons.text: Raboty 12 i 23 vežut formu Riemanna s kvadratičnym slučajem. Moderna tensorna parafraza ne jest čisto jezykova zaměna bez nužnosti objašnjenja.
comparisons.english: Papers 12 and 23 connect Riemann’s form with the quadratic case. A modern tensor paraphrase is not a purely linguistic substitution needing no explanation.

passages.quote: Iz teorema redukcije dobyvaje se specialny slučaj kvadratičnyh form, občeje form \(p\)-go razměra: tuto sistema funkcij završava se pri \([\Omega_2]\), občeje pri \([\Omega_p]\) i jego kovariantnyh derivacijah, zato že vse pozdějšne osnovne funkcije stavajut projektivnymi invariantami tyh. Odtud objasnjaje se izključno město Rimanovoj formy kriviny \([\Omega_2]\) pri kvadratičnyh formah. Pytanje o ekvivalentnosti kvadratičnyh form, odnosno form \(p\)-go razměra, svodi se imenně k ekvivalentnosti \([\Omega_2]\), odnosno \([\Omega_2]\ldots[\Omega_p]\), i jih kovariantnyh derivacij v odnosu k linearnoj transformaciji; i identično izčezanje \([\Omega_2]\), odnosno \([\Omega_2]\ldots[\Omega_p]\), jest potrěbno i dostatočno za transformaciju v formy s konstantnymi koeficientami; tym jest za kvadratične formy izrečeny jedin iz najpoznanych rezultatov.

Red $[\Omega_i]$ prěryvaje se s $[\Omega_\alpha]$, ako $f(x,\dd x)$ jest homogena forma $\alpha$-togo stepenja v $\dd x$. Za kvadratične formy $[\Omega_2]$ stavaje identična s Rimanovoju formoju kriviny, i tu ukazany proces tvorjenja jest točno toj, ktory Riemann dal v latinskoj konkursnoj rabotě i ktory nezavisno od togo, v vezi s Riemannovym habilitacijskim prědavanjem, takože razvil Lipschitz.\footnote{Sr. takože moje izloženje o Riemann i Lipschitz v nr. 28 drugoj česti encyklopedijnogo članka \foreign{Weitzenböck}, spomenutogo pod 7).} Dokaz teorema redukcije, ktory Christoffel i Ricci računsko provedli za kvadratične diferencialne formy, opiraje se na uvedenje "Rimanovyh normalnyh koordinat", ktore ekstremale, ktore počinajut se v jednoj točkě transformujut v prave linije; zato že tym libovoljnomu prěobraženju od $x$ odpovědaje linearno prěobraženje normalnyh koordinat, one uslovljajut prěhod k občej linearnoj grupě.

original_reasons.text: Direct curvature-form term; chosen instead of a more modern tensor paraphrase because Noether explicitly says “Form” in the invariant-theory reduction.

title: forma reducibilnosti
isv: Forma reducibilnosti imenuje konkretnu pomočnu polinomnu konstrukciju raboty 20. Arhiv izbira internacionalny korenj radi jasnogo tehničnogo nazvanja, pri čem ruska i ukrajinska forma upotrěbljajut svoje slovne familije. Matematična uslovja sut suščestvena: za polinom od najmenje dvoh prěměnnyh, pri specializaciji bez poniženja stepena, neizčezanje toj formy identično v pomočnih neoprěděljenyh jest kriterij absolutnoj nerazložimosti. Ne ide o neizčezanje pri jednom libovoljnom izboru pomočnih čisel. Identično izčezanje odgovarjaje razložimosti. Nazvanje zato ne znači ni reducent iz teorije invariantov, ni prostě opisanije možnosti uproščenja. Izvorne matematične uslovja, ne samo zajedničny korenj, upravjajut priměnoju termina.
en: Forma reducibilnosti names a specific auxiliary polynomial construction in Paper 20. The archive chooses the international stem to make the technical object recognizable, while its Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use their own word families. The mathematical qualifications are essential: for a polynomial in at least two variables, under specialization without degree loss, being nonzero as a polynomial in the auxiliary indeterminates characterizes absolute irreducibility. This does not mean nonvanishing at one arbitrary numerical choice of the auxiliary variables. Identical vanishing corresponds to reducibility. The term therefore means neither the reducer of invariant theory nor a general possibility of simplification. Its mathematical conditions, not merely a shared stem, govern its use.

comparisons.text: Kriterij svezuje absolutnu nerazložimost s neizčezanjem polinoma v pomočnih neoprěděljenyh. Uslovje o stepenju i směr kriterija sut neodstranime.
comparisons.english: The criterion relates absolute irreducibility to a nonzero polynomial in the auxiliary indeterminates. Its degree qualification and direction are essential.

passages.quote: Polinom -- s koeficientami iz libovoljnogo, abstraktno oprěděljenogo polja -- nazyvaje se \emph{absolutno nerazložimy}, ako ostavaje nerazložimy v algebraično zamknjenom polju, do ktorogo oblast koeficientov možno razširiti.\footnote{Že vsako polje, i to v suščnosti jednoznačno, možno razširiti do algebraično zamknjenogo polja, t. j. do takogo, v ktorom vsaky polinom jednoj prěměnnoj razpadaje se na linearne faktory, pokazal E. Steinitz v svojej \emph{\foreign{Algebraischen Theorie der Körper}} (J. f. M. 137 (1910), str.~167); tym on dal racionalny ekvivalent fundamentalnogo teorema algebry.} V slědujučem pokažem, že absolutnu nerazložimost, v protivnosti k nerazložimosti po odnošenju k zadannomu polju, možno algebraično pojmati; točnejše imaje město teorem:

\emph{Vsakomu polinomu od $n\ge2$ prěměnnyh s neoprěděljenymi koeficientami možno prirěditi cělu racionalnu funkciju s cěločislenymi koeficientami od tyh koeficientov i daljših neoprěděljenyh, formu reducibilnosti; tako, že za vsaky specialny polinom jednogo stepena potrěbno i dostatočno uslovje absolutnoj nerazložimosti jest dano neizčezanjem formy reducibilnosti. Drugymi slovami: za vsaku specialnu sistemu cěnnostij koeficientov, za ktoru forma reducibilnosti identično v neoprěděljenyh izčezaje i ktora ne uslovjuje poniženje stepena, specialny polinom stavaje razložimy, i obratno.}
Ako vměsto polinomov razgledajut se homogene formy v jednoj prěměnnoj vyše, togda vměsto stepenovogo uslovja vystupaje prostějše uslovje, že koeficientna sistema ne izčezaje identično.

6. \emph{Uslovje absolutnoj nerazložimosti} možno nyně neposrědnje formulovati. Zato trěba samo stepen od $E(x)$ v (3) razložiti na vse možne načiny v dva pozitivne členy $l+m$, i k vsakomu razloženju obrazovati formu $S(Z,u)$. Produkt po tyh formah
R(Z,u)=\prod S(Z,u)

tvori togda formu reducibilnosti od $E(x)$; zato že po gornjemu vsakomu razpadanju od $E(x)$ odgovarjajuče $E(x,y)$ odpovědaje izčezanje jednogo faktora od (16), i obratno. Tym jest dokazany glavny teorem postavjeny v uvodu i skupaj pokazano, kako forma reducibilnosti može se v samoj stvari postaviti v konečno mnogyh krokah.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use native mathematical reducibility families. Interslavic intentionally keeps the international reducibilnost stem for the named auxiliary form so that the object reads as a technical artifact rather than a general sentence about decomposability.

title: formalne linearne formy
isv: Formalne linearne formy ohranjaje i formalnost, i linearnost objektov. Zapis objašnjava doslovnu blizkost potreboju razlikovati linearne transformacije od matric v primětkě pripisanoj van der Waerdenu. To ne jest razlog za zanemarenje rozdela medžu objektom i jego predstavjenjem v izbranoj bazě. Aktualna konstrukcija formalnyh form i proměna bazy sut sravnjene niže; to novo čitanje ne dokazuje samo po sobě historiju navedenej korekcijnoj primětky.
en: Formalne linearne formy preserves both formality and linearity. The record explains its close wording by the need to distinguish linear transformations from matrices in a correction note attributed to van der Waerden. This is no reason to ignore the distinction between an object and its representation in a chosen basis. The current construction of formal forms and change of basis are compared below; that fresh reading does not by itself establish the history of the reported correction note.

comparisons.title_isv: Formalne linearne formy i matrica v izbranoj bazě
comparisons.title_en: Formal linear forms and a matrix in a chosen basis
comparisons.text: Aktualna konstrukcija modula predstavjenja bere formalne linearne formy $y=\sum_i x_i\alpha_i$ i izrično svęzuje matricu s izbranoju bazoju. Pri drugoj bazě, $y=xP$, matrica $B$ prěhodi v $P^{-1}BP$. To čini vidimym rozděl medžu formalnymi objektami, linearnoju akcijeju i jej matričnym predstavjenjem. Tute četyri pasaže podkrepljajut terminologično razlikovanje; one same ne sut novym sravnjenjem redakcijnoj primětky pripisanoj van der Waerdenu s pečatnym iztočnikom.
comparisons.english: The current representation-module construction takes formal linear forms $y=\sum_i x_i\alpha_i$ and expressly ties a matrix to a chosen basis. With another basis, $y=xP$, matrix $B$ becomes $P^{-1}BP$. This makes visible the distinction between the formal objects, the linear action and its matrix representation. These four passages support the terminological distinction; they are not themselves a fresh collation of the editorial note attributed to van der Waerden against the printed source.

passages.quote: Obratno: vsako prědstavjenje $\mathfrak D$ od $\mo$ prinaleži modulu prědstavjenja, i to oprěděljenoj bazi tog modula. Imenno, pod $\mM$ razumějemo cělost formalnyh linearnyh form v $x_1,\ldots,x_n$,
y=\sum_i x_i\alpha_i.
(y_1,\ldots,y_n)=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)P,
=(y_1,\ldots,y_n)P^{-1}BP.

original_reasons.text: The phrase must remain literal because it supports van der Waerden's correction note separating linear transformations from matrices.

title: formalny variacionny račun
isv: Formalny variacionny račun izbira račun prěd internacionalnym kalkulus. Razlog jest svez s ranějšej upotrěboj imenja račun za matematične postupy i s ruskym i ukrajinskim nazvami variacijnogo računa. Formalny ostavaje sučstvenny kvalifikator v toj frazě, ne sinonim neformalnogo ili netočnogo razsuždenja. Zapis dava kvalitativnu prednost domašnjemu korenju, ne čislenu uspěšnost v sravnjenju s kalkulus.
en: Formalny variacionny račun chooses račun over international kalkulus. The rationale connects it with earlier use of račun for mathematical operations and with the Russian and Ukrainian names for variational calculus. Formal remains a substantive qualifier here, not a synonym for informal or imprecise reasoning. The record gives a qualitative preference for the Slavic-root term, not a numerical performance comparison with kalkulus.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use standard variational-calculus terminology. Interslavic keeps transparent `račun` rather than pure international `kalkulus`, aligning with earlier project use of calculation/calculus as a mathematical operation family.

title: Formula v nazvanju statje
title_en: A formula within an article title
isv: Hassevo nazvanje Über p-adische Schiefkörper sodržuje matematičny symbol p, izvorno v gotičnom obliku. Citat mora čuvati i tekst i symbol. Drugy priměr, Schurovo nazvanje, završaje se prěd Satz VII: to jest odvolanje na teoremu, ne čest nazvanja. Osm cělyh citacij vključaje takože odvojenje treh Fraenkelovyh rabot; ih ne treba sjediniti samo zato, že imajut jednogo avtora.
en: Hasse's title Über p-adische Schiefkörper contains the mathematical symbol p, originally in fraktur. Both title text and symbol must be preserved. A Schur title ends before Satz VII: that is a theorem reference, not part of the title. The eight complete citations also keep three Fraenkel works distinct; common authorship does not make them one citation.
sources_isv: Polny spisok citatov, odděl 167; matematičny zapis v citatah ostavaje netknjeny.
sources_en: Complete citation inventory, group 167; literal mathematical payload retained

evidence.finding: Hasse's title Über p-adische Schiefkörper contains the mathematical symbol p, originally in fraktur. Both title text and symbol must be preserved. A Schur title ends before Satz VII: that is a theorem reference, not part of the title. The eight complete citations also keep three Fraenkel works distinct; common authorship does not make them one citation.

title: formy 10. poręda
isv: Formy 10. poręda zadržuje kratku cifrovu konstrukciju glavy IV. Motiv jest izběgnuti novogo konkurentnogo imena za pored pri povtorjenom tipu zaglavja. Konkretny drugy nazv ne jest navedeny. Cifrovo pisanje može byti sravnjeno s desętogo poręda v TERM-0590, ale razlikovanje dvou zapisov ne ustanavjaje novy matematičny smisyl.
en: Formy 10. poręda retains Chapter IV's compact digit-based construction. The motive is to avoid introducing a competing order term into a repeated heading pattern. No particular alternative noun is named. The notation can be compared with spelled-out desętogo poręda in TERM-0590, but the difference between the records establishes no new mathematical sense.

original_reasons.text: Continues the ordinal-genitive title convention used throughout Chapter IV. Interslavic keeps the established compact `poręd` family instead of adding a competing word for order.

title: formy 11. poręda
isv: Formy 11. poręda jest kratka ordinalno-genitivna forma zaglavja, prodolžajuča konvenciju glavy IV raboty 2. Točka po čislu označaje ordinalnost: govorimo o jedinnadsetom poredu, ne o količestvě form. Zapis sohranjaje poręda dlja kontinuiteta i ješče ne predstavlja njegovu grafiju kako konečnu normativnu odluku.
en: Formy 11. poręda is the compact ordinal-genitive heading continued in Chapter IV of Paper 2. The period marks ordinal use: the heading concerns eleventh order, not eleven forms. The record retains poręda for continuity and does not yet present its spelling as a final normative decision.

original_reasons.text: Continues the Chapter IV ordinal-genitive title convention. Interslavic keeps `poręda` for internal consistency, pending authority review.

title: formy 11., 12., 13. i 15. poręda
isv: Spis 11., 12., 13. i 15. mora ostati točny: otsutnost 14 ne jest propust, ktory slovnik može avtomatično zapolniti. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje upotrěbjajut množinsky genitiv za několiko poredov. Medžuslovjanski zapis zadržuje poręda i izrično ostavjaje sintaksu čislovogo spisa k daljšej prověrkě. Kontinuitet zaglavij zato ne dokazuje, že zajedny jedinstvenny član pri vseh čislah jest jedina ili najlěpša gramatika.
en: The list 11, 12, 13 and 15 must remain exact: absence of 14 is not a gap the dictionary may automatically fill. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use a plural genitive for several orders. The Interslavic record retains poręda and expressly leaves the syntax of the numeral list for further checking. Continuity among headings therefore does not establish that a shared singular expression is the only or best grammatical treatment.

original_reasons.text: Numeric order title follows the source layout. Ukrainian/Russian use modern genitive plural wording for a list of orders. Interslavic keeps the existing poręd/poręda lane but is marked review-facing for numeric ordinal syntax.

title: formy 12., 13., 14., 15. poręda
isv: Formy 12., 13., 14., 15. poręda predstavlja drugy točny spis než TERM-0575. Razlog opet sohranjaje jedinstvennu konvenciju zaglavij pri tom, že ruske i ukrajinske formy imajut množinsky genitiv. Pytanje jednine ili množiny po spisku ordinalov ostavaje otvoreno v historijnom zapisě. Čitatelj mora viděti i spis, i tu gramatičnu nejistost, a ne samo obšče formy vysokogo poreda.
en: Formy 12., 13., 14., 15. poręda represents a different exact list from TERM-0575. Again the reason retains a uniform heading convention while the Russian and Ukrainian comparanda use a plural genitive. Singular versus plural after a list of ordinals remains unresolved in the historical record. Readers need both the list and that grammatical uncertainty, not merely forms of high order.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use plural genitive for multiple orders. Interslavic keeps the established `poręda` lane for section titles, with authority review pending.

title: formy 7. poręda (sistem $s_{III}$)
isv: Sedmy pored i oznaka sistema $s_{III}$ nosut različnu informaciju. Fraza prodolžaje konvenciju zaglavij glavy III, sohranjajuči historijno poręda kako provizornu formu. Rimsko III i indeks pri $s$ identifikujut sistem; ne sut ordinalnym slovom, ktoro trěba prěvesti ili prěpisati v kirilicu.
en: Seventh order and the system designation $s_{III}$ carry different information. The phrase continues the Chapter III heading convention while retaining historical poręda as provisional. Roman III and the subscript attached to $s$ identify the system; they are not an ordinal word to translate or transliterate into Cyrillic.

original_reasons.text: Continues the order-title lane from Chapter III and the System III enumeration. Interslavic keeps poręd/poręda review-visible.

title: formy 8. poręda
isv: Formy 8. poręda prodolžaje čislovo zaglavje iz oddělov 19-20. Ruska i ukrajinska ordinalno-genitivna konstrukcija služi sravnjenju, a medžuslovjanski izbor zadržuje ranějši nazv poreda dlja kontinuiteta. Cifra ne izměnjaje smisyl osmogo poreda i ne znači količestvo form. Zapis ne navodi posebno sravnjenje čitateljskoj prednosti cifry i polnogo ordinalnogo slova.
en: Formy 8. poręda continues the numeral-heading practice of sections 19-20. Russian and Ukrainian ordinal-genitive constructions provide comparanda, while the Interslavic choice retains the earlier order term for continuity. The digit preserves eighth order and does not count the forms. The record supplies no separate reader comparison between the digit and the spelled-out ordinal.

original_reasons.text: Continues the numbering convention used in §§19--20. Ukrainian and Russian use ordinal-genitive mathematical idiom; Interslavic keeps the established compact 'poręd' pattern for internal consistency.

title: formy 9. poręda
isv: Formy 9. poręda zadržuje cifrovu ordinalno-genitivnu konstrukciju ranějših oddělov. Razlog dava prednost kontinuitetu prěd novym konkurentnym doslovnym prěvodom, ale ne imenuje togo konkurenta. Ne možno zato dopisati konkretny odbacany termin ili čislenu ocěnu. Čislo 9 ostavaje klasifikacijeju po poredu, ne čislom navedenyh form.
en: Formy 9. poręda retains the digit-based ordinal-genitive construction of preceding sections. The reason prefers continuity over a competing calque but does not name that calque. A specific rejected term or numerical score therefore cannot be supplied. The number 9 remains a classification by order, not a count of the listed forms.

original_reasons.text: Continues the ordinal-genitive convention used in previous Paper 02 sections. Interslavic keeps the established compact 'poręd' pattern rather than introducing a competing calque.

title: formy četvrtogo poręda
isv: Četvrtogo poręda jest tvrda pridavnička genitivna konstrukcija. Zapis izrično sravnjaje četvrtogo s mekim tretjego iz prědhodnogo odděla; razlika -ogo/-ego zato jest opravdana morfologijeju, ne nekonsistentnostju prěvoda. Pored ostavaje poredom v koeficientah. Novo sravnjenje s gramatikoju i aktualnymi zaglavjami podkrepljaje tu razliku, ne pretvarjajuči novy dokaz v staru konsultaciju.
en: Četvrtogo poręda uses the hard-adjective genitive. The record explicitly contrasts četvrtogo with soft tretjego in the preceding section; the -ogo/-ego difference is therefore motivated by morphology, not inconsistency. Order remains order in the coefficients. Fresh comparison with the grammar and current headings supports that distinction without turning new evidence into an earlier consultation.

comparisons.title_isv: Pored v koeficientah i sklanjanje ordinalov
comparisons.text: Podnožna primětka v uvodě raboty 2 izrično razlikuje pored v koeficientah od stepena v proměnnyh; odděl 7 ponovno uporedkuje formy po poredu v koeficientah. Aktualne zaglavja oddělov 8–10 imajut tretjego, četvrtogo i petogo poreda. Pri novom sravnjenju gramatika čislovnikov dava meku deklinaciju za trětji, tvrdu za ostale ordinale i izrično navodi pety; gramatika pridavnikov objasnjaje alternaciju o/e po mekoj osnově. Tuto podkrepljaje morfologičny kontrast -ego/-ogo, ne ustanavjaje, že obě gramatiky byly raněje konsultovane. Ne potvrđaje takože vse grafijne detalje historijnogo poręda ili izključnost njegovej leksičnoj prednosti. Točne gramatične pasaže sut zachovane pod GRAM-01.
comparisons.english: The introductory footnote to Paper 2 expressly distinguishes order in the coefficients from degree in the variables; section 7 again orders forms by coefficient order. Current headings in sections 8–10 have tretjego, četvrtogo and petogo poreda. In a fresh comparison, the numeral grammar assigns soft declension to trětji and hard declension to the other ordinals, expressly listing pety; the adjective grammar explains o/e alternation after a soft stem. This supports the morphological -ego/-ogo contrast, not earlier consultation of either grammar. It also does not validate every spelling detail of historical poręda or an exclusive lexical preference for it. The exact grammar passages are retained under GRAM-01.

passages.quote: U Maisana za obču bikvadratičnu formu konstruovane sut vse formy do petogo reda uključiteljno,\footnote{Pod "redom" tuto razuměje se stepenj v koeficientah, a pod "stepenem" stepenj v prěměnnyh.}
Pojedine formy uporedžujemo po poredu v koeficientah. Normirujemo kontrakciju
\textbf{\S\ 8. \quad Formy tretjego poreda (Sistem III).}
\textbf{\S\ 9. \quad Formy četvrtogo poreda (Sistem III).}
\textbf{\S\ 10. \quad Formy petogo poreda (Sistem III).}

original_reasons.text: Continues the §7--§8 coefficient-order convention; Interslavic četvrtogo is the hard-adjective genitive parallel to §8 tretjego.

title: formy desętogo poręda
isv: Desętogo poręda sohranjaje ordinal slovami, genitivnu konstrukciju i nazalizovanu grafiju vidimu dlja daljšego razsmotrenja. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenje podkrepljajut gramatičny tip frazy, ne avtomatično točnu medžuslovjansku ortografiju. Tuto jest zapisana forma iz odděla 15 raboty 2; njej ne trěba ni skryti, ni predstavjati kako jedinu aktualnu rekomendaciju.
en: Desętogo poręda retains the spelled-out ordinal, genitive construction and nasalized spelling for further consideration. Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the grammatical type of phrase, not automatically the exact Interslavic orthography. This is the recorded form from section 15 of Paper 2; it must be neither concealed nor presented as the sole current recommendation.

original_reasons.text: Continues the order-title lane from sections 7--14. Ukrainian/Russian use ordinary genitive ordinal mathematical phrasing. Interslavic desętogo poręda follows the established poręd/poręda lane and keeps nasalized spelling visible for authority review.

title: formy devętogo poręda
isv: Devętogo poręda sohranjaje polno ordinalno slovo i nazalizovanu grafiju kak zapisany predmet daljšego razsmotrenja. Razlog obračaje vnimanje na ukrajinski apostrof v dev’jatogo i na rusku genitivnu formu, ale te razlike ne sut samy po sobě opravdanjem medžuslovjanskogo ę. Zapis s cifroju 9. v TERM-0583 označaje isti čislovy pored; razlika form ostavaje vidima, bez tvrdženja, že vsaka grafija už jest potvrđena.
en: Devętogo poręda preserves the spelled-out ordinal and its nasalized spelling as a recorded question for further consideration. The reason notes the Ukrainian apostrophe in dev’jatogo and the Russian genitive form, but those differences do not by themselves justify Interslavic ę. The digit form 9. in TERM-0583 expresses the same order number; the variants remain visible without claiming that every spelling has been validated.

original_reasons.text: Continues the order-title lane from sections 7--13. Ukrainian uses an apostrophe in дев'ятого; Russian uses ordinary genitive ordinal девятого. Interslavic devętogo poręda follows the established poręd/poręda lane and keeps the nasalized ordinal visible for authority review.

title: formy inercije
isv: Formy inercije jest blizky prěvod Trägheitsformen v kratkoj primětce. Članok upominaje priměnjenje formuly v disertaciji, ale ne razviva teoriju togo objekta. Arhiv zato zachovuje doslovnu nazvu i ne ustanovjaje podrobnu definiciju. Ne trěba dopolnjati zapis fizikalnym smyslom inercije ili poistovětiti njegove formy s inercijnymi poljami iz čislovoj teorije. Dodatno pojmovno utočnjenje potrěbovalo by samostojno pročitanogo primarnogo iztočnika, ne samo njemeckogo slova.
en: Formy inercije closely renders Trägheitsformen in a brief footnote. The paper mentions an application of the formula in a dissertation but does not develop the object. The archive therefore retains the literal name without supplying a detailed definition. The entry must not be filled out with physical inertia or identified with the inertia fields of number theory. A more specific conceptual explanation would require a separately consulted primary source, not merely the German word.

comparisons.text: Upoměnka ne ustanovjaje polnu teoriju objekta.
comparisons.english: The mention does not supply a full theory of the object.

passages.quote: togda specializacijeju formuly, podanoj u Fišera v uvodu III i v \S~6 II (s. 41), dobyva se
F_1=(c_1\Omega+c_2\Omega\Delta\Omega+\cdots+c_i\Omega\Delta\Omega\cdots\Delta\Omega)F\footnotemark,
\qquad \left[\Omega=\left(\frac{\p}{\p x}\frac{\p}{\p y}\frac{\p}{\p z}\right)\right],
\footnotetext{Tutu specializovanu formulu upotrěbljaje Kerim v svojej erlangenskoj disertaciji, ktora skoro bude publikovana, v priměnjenju na «formy inercije».}
kde \(c_i\) ponovno sut racionalne čisla, zaviseče samo od stepena \(F\).

original_reasons.text: The term occurs in a dissertation footnote. A literal inertia-forms rendering is kept and flagged only implicitly through the glossary because the mathematical object is not developed in this note.

title: formy osmogo poręda
isv: Osmogo poręda piše ordinal slovami i sohranjaje genitivnu konstrukciju iz ranějših oddělov raboty 2. Osmogo jest izbrano kako regularna forma od osmy; razlog takože podkrepljaje kontinuitet poręd/poręda. Cifrovany zapis v TERM-0578 i tuto polno slovo označajut isti čislovy pored, ale prinadležet različnym zachovanym pasajam, ne jednoj slučajno udvojenej slovničnej kartě.
en: Osmogo poręda spells out the ordinal and retains the genitive construction from earlier sections of Paper 2. Osmogo is selected as the regular form of osmy, alongside continuity of poręd/poręda. The digit form in TERM-0578 and this spelled-out form designate the same order number, but belong to different preserved passages rather than an accidentally duplicated dictionary record.

original_reasons.text: Continues the order-title lane from sections 7--12. Interslavic osmogo poręda follows the regular ordinal pattern and keeps poręd/poręda for Ordnung.

title: formy petogo poręda
isv: Petogo poręda prodolžaje zaglavja o poredu v koeficientah. Zapis vybira petogo od pety i izrično odbacaje dogadanu nazalizaciju; pri tom razlikuje tuto frazu od staršego petogo reda. Razlog tvrdi, že forma pety jest podkrepljena gramatikoju čislovnikov. Novo čitanje sohranjenoj gramatiky potvrđaje, že ona navodi pety i tvrdu deklinaciju, ale ne ustanavjaje, kto i kogda ju raněje konsultoval. Izbor poreda ostavaje odvojenym leksičnym pytanjem.
en: Petogo poręda continues the headings about order in the coefficients. The record chooses petogo from pety and explicitly rejects a guessed nasalized form, while distinguishing this phrase from earlier petogo reda. The rationale claims support from numeral guidance. Fresh examination of the preserved grammar confirms that it lists pety and assigns hard declension, but does not establish who consulted it earlier or when. Selection of the order noun remains a separate lexical question.

\textbf{\S\ 9. \quad Formy četvrtogo poreda (Sistem III).}
\textbf{\S\ 10. \quad Formy petogo poreda (Sistem III).}

original_reasons.text: Continues the coefficient-order convention from §§7--9. Interslavic petogo follows the regular ordinal pety/petogo attested in Interslavic numeral guidance, avoiding a nasalized guess and superseding the older local paper01 petogo reda only in the sense that §10 keeps the current poręd/poręda lane for Ordnung.

title: formy s vyšimi simbolami
isv: S vyšimi simbolami razklada německu konstrukciju bez novogo složenogo termina. Zapis podkrepljaje komparativ i instrumental, ktore ostavajut čitateljne pri simboličnyh formulah. Vyši ne znači tu většy font ili vyše položenje na stranicě: odnos medžu simbolami trěba razuměti iz konstrukcije form. Razlog ne sohranjaje osobnu tablicu konkurentnyh pridavnikov.
en: S vyšimi simbolami renders the German construction without coining a new compound. The rationale emphasizes a comparative adjective and instrumental construction readable alongside symbolic formulas. Higher does not here mean larger type or a higher position on the page: the relation between symbols must come from the construction of forms. No separate comparison table of competing adjectives survives in the reason.

original_reasons.text: Literal but modern. Interslavic uses transparent vyšimi/simbolami, and the phrase stays readable next to symbolic form notation.

title: formy sedmogo poręda
isv: Sedmogo poręda prodolžaje konvenciju iz oddělov 7-11 raboty 2: polno ordinalno slovo s genitivnym nazvom poreda. Ruska i ukrajinska sravnjenja pokazyvajut različne nacionalne formy ordinala, zato medžuslovjanski oblik ne jest prosto kopijeju jednoj iz njih. Razlog sohranjaje obšče petogo/šestogo/sedmogo sklanjanje i stalno imenuvanje matematičnoj veličiny.
en: Sedmogo poręda continues the convention of sections 7-11 of Paper 2: a spelled-out ordinal with the genitive order noun. Russian and Ukrainian comparanda have different national ordinal forms, so the Interslavic shape is not simply a copy of either. The reason preserves the shared petogo/šestogo/sedmogo inflectional pattern and a stable name for the mathematical quantity.

original_reasons.text: Continues the order-title lane from §§7--11. Interslavic sedmogo poręda follows the regular ordinal pattern and keeps poręd/poręda for Ordnung.

title: formy šestogo poręda
isv: Šestogo poręda nosi regularny ordinalny pridavnik v genitivě i prodolžaje zaglavja o poredu v koeficientah. Zapis sravnjaje rusku i ukrajinsku konstrukciju i ostavjaje cělu semju ordinalov i registra k odbornomu razsmotrenju. Regularnost pridavnika ne rěšaje avtomatično drugogo pytanja, koji medžuslovjanski nazv za Ordnung jest najpriměrnějši.
en: Šestogo poręda uses the regular ordinal adjective in the genitive and continues the coefficient-order headings. The record compares Russian and Ukrainian constructions and leaves the wider ordinal/register family for specialist consideration. Regularity of the adjective does not automatically decide the separate question of the most suitable Interslavic noun for Ordnung.

original_reasons.text: Continues the coefficient-order title pattern from §§7--10. Ukrainian/Russian use the normal genitive ordinal phrase. Interslavic šestogo poręda follows the established poręd lane and a transparent regular ordinal; authority review remains needed for the whole ordinal/register family.

title: formy tretjego poręda
isv: Tretjego poręda sohranjaje historijni pored v koeficientah, ne stepenj v proměnnyh. Zapis takože izrično govori o proměně tretjogo na tretjego. Tuto jest konkretna gramatična alternativa, ne novy matematičny pojem. Pozdnějše sravnjenje s gramatikoju podkrepljaje meku deklinaciju ordinala za tretji, ale ne dokazuje, že ona byla konsultovana pri prvom izborě. Točna ranějša grafija i aktualna forma ostavajut razlikovane.
en: Tretjego poręda retains the historical order in the coefficients, not degree in the variables. The record also explicitly reports replacing tretjogo with tretjego. This is a concrete grammatical alternative, not a new mathematical concept. The later grammar comparison supports soft declension of the ordinal for third but does not establish that the grammar was consulted when the first choice was made. The earlier spelling and current form remain distinguished.

\textbf{\S\ 8. \quad Formy tretjego poreda (Sistem III).}
\textbf{\S\ 9. \quad Formy četvrtogo poreda (Sistem III).}
\textbf{\S\ 10. \quad Formy petogo poreda (Sistem III).}

original_reasons.text: Carries forward Ordnung as order in coefficients rather than variable degree; Interslavic uses genitive tretjego poręda after reviewer-facing correction from initial tretjogo.

title: formy v n prěměnnyh
isv: Formy v $n$ prěměnnyh prodolžaje predmetny nazv iz raboty 3 v uvodě raboty 4. Predlog v čini frazu prirodnoju v medžuslovjanskom, bez doslovnogo kopirovanja německogo von ili nacionalnyh predlogov v sravnjenjah. $n$ označaje čislo proměnnyh, ne pored ili stepenj formy. Razlog ne podkrepljaje izpuščenje nijednoj proměnnoj ili suženje k binarnomu slučaju.
en: Formy v $n$ prěměnnyh carries the subject designation from Paper 3 into Paper 4's introduction. The preposition v makes the phrase natural in Interslavic without literally copying German von or the national prepositions in the comparanda. $n$ counts variables, not the order or degree of a form. The rationale does not license omitting variables or restricting the statement to the binary case.

original_reasons.text: Carries forward the title/domain term from Paper 03 while keeping the variable phrase natural in each lane.

title: formy, koje se razkladųt na faktory
isv: Formy, koje se razkladųt na faktory jest rany opisny izbor; aktualna fraza piše formy, ktore razkladajut se na faktory. V arhivu jest pojem i ocěna prigodnosti dlja pilota, ale ne detaljny zapis sravnjenja alternativ. Możno zato objasniti funkcionovanje formy, ne izmisliti nezachovanu debatu: fraza izrično govori o faktorah i ne potrěbuje od čitatelja znanja novogo pridavnika. Kratko razložime iz pozdějše raboty mora byti povezano s jej osobno širšoju definicijeju, ne bezuslovno proglašeno istoznačnym.
en: Formy, koje se razkladųt na faktory is an early descriptive choice; the current phrase reads formy, ktore razkladajut se na faktory. The archive preserves the concept and an assessment of suitability for the pilot, but no detailed comparison of alternatives. Its function can therefore be explained without inventing a lost debate: the phrase explicitly names factors and requires no knowledge of a new adjective. The shorter razložime in the later paper must be linked to that paper's specially broadened definition, not declared unconditionally synonymous.

comparisons.title_en: A descriptive phrase and a later generalization
comparisons.text: Nedostajajuči razlog ne može byti izmislen.
comparisons.english: An absent rationale cannot be invented.

passages.quote: \item kontrakcija s formami, ktore razkladajut se na faktory; ta metoda čestično ima harakter redukcije s pomočju reducentov, a čestično harakter dvojnoj redukcije.

Pod «razložimymi formami» -- s malym obobčenjem običnogo pojma -- razumějemo formy, ktore možno izraziti prěz produkty form nižšego stepena i prěz «vyše» formy. Produkty form pri jednokratnoj kontrakciji prěhodet v produkty; takože produkty nelinearnyh form pri dvokratnoj kontrakciji pri specializacijah a') i b') (§ 2) po teoremě produkta:

title: Frobeniusova teorija grupnyh karakterov
isv: Frobeniusova jest pridavničny oblik vlastnogo imena, soglasovany s teorija. Zapis razlikuje njegovo pisanje v običnoj proze od sohranjenja vlastnogo imena v bibliografiji: kirilična versija transliteruje pridavnik, a bibliografično ime ostavaje latinično. Grupnyh karakterov sohranjaje točny predmet teorije. To razlikovanje ne znači, že vse pojavjenja imena morajut iměti jedno i to samo grafično pravilo.
en: Frobeniusova is an adjectival form of the proper name, agreeing with teorija. The rationale distinguishes its treatment in ordinary prose from preservation of a name in a bibliography: the Cyrillic version transliterates the adjective, while the bibliographical name remains Latin. Grupnyh karakterov retains the theory's precise subject. The distinction is contextual, not a rule that every occurrence of the name must receive identical graphic treatment.

original_reasons.text: The eponym is adjective-like in all lanes; Interslavic transliterates the adjectival form in the Cyrillic reader while retaining Latin proper-name protection for bibliographic names.

title: fundamentalna točka
isv: Fundamentalna točka prodolžaje geometričny nazv iz odděla 5 raboty 6. Internacionalny pridavnik jest sojedinjen s točka i soglasovan s njeju v rodě. Rusko i ukrajinsko sravnjenja podkrepljajut blizkost celej konstrukcije. Kratky razlog ne oprěděljaje sam geometričny objekt: fundamentalna točka ne može byti utožsamjena s proizvoljnoju osoblivoju točkoju bez čitanja definicije.
en: Fundamentalna točka continues the geometrical designation from section 5 of Paper 6. The international adjective is combined with točka and agrees with it in gender. Russian and Ukrainian parallels support the construction's similarity across those languages. The short rationale does not itself define the geometrical object: a fundamental point cannot be identified with an arbitrary special point without the relevant definition.

original_reasons.text: Geometric term from Section 5; transparent international form works across all lanes.

title: fundamentalne točke involucije
isv: Fundamentalne točke involucije sohranjaje množinu i genitivnu svez s konkretnoju involucijeju. Razlog objašnjava kontinuitetnost nazva od uvoda raboty 6 do daljših razsmotrenij regularnyh sistemov i sistemov bez fundamentalnyh toček. Zato dopolnjenje involucije jest čestju točnogo predmeta, ne ukrasom. Zapis ne davaje osnovy zaměniti nazv modernym terminom bez dodatnogo matematičnogo sravnjenja.
en: Fundamentalne točke involucije preserves the plural and the genitive relation to the particular involution. The rationale explains continuity from Paper 6's introduction to later discussion of regular systems and systems without fundamental points. Involucije specifies the object under discussion; it is not ornamental wording. The record does not justify substitution of a modern name without further mathematical comparison.

original_reasons.text: Continues Paper 06 introduction vocabulary and will matter for later regular/fundamental-point-free systems.

title: fundamentalno jednačenje / fundamentalna forma
isv: Dva nazva, fundamentalno jednačenje i fundamentalna forma, sohranjajut historijnu terminologiju, ktora svęzuje definiciju diferenty s običnym proizvodnym polinoma. Jednačenje jest izbrano s naměroju južno- i zapadnoslovjanskoj čitateljnosti. To jest zapisana motivacija, ale priložena sravnjenja sut samo rusko i ukrajinsko; konkretne južne i zapadne pasaže ni čitateljski test tu ne sut navedene. Forma i jednačenje ostavajut dva nazva v argumentu, ne slobodno zaměnime slova.
en: The two names, fundamentalno jednačenje and fundamentalna forma, retain historical terminology connecting the ideal-theoretic definition of the different with the usual polynomial derivative. Jednačenje is chosen with South and West Slavic recognizability in view. That is the recorded motivation, but the supplied comparanda are Russian and Ukrainian; no particular South or West Slavic passage or reader test accompanies it. Form and equation remain distinct names within the argument, not freely interchangeable words.

original_reasons.text: Noether’s historical terminology is preserved because it links the ideal-differential definition with the usual polynomial derivative definition. Interslavic uses jednačenje for equation, aligned with South/West Slavic recognizability.

title: fundamentalno uravnenje
isv: Fundamentalno uravnenje sohranjaje internacionalny pridavnik kako čest točnogo nazva. Razlog vezuje nazv k identifikaciji $P^{(i)}$ s fundamentalnym jednačenjem razširenja polja. On ne govori, že vsako važno jednačenje trěba nazvati fundamentalnym. Izbor uravnenje takože ostavaje različny od jednačenje v TERM-0605; sravnjenje tyh oblikov ne směje skryti jih različne konteksty.
en: Fundamentalno uravnenje preserves the international adjective as part of a specific designation. The rationale ties it to the identification of $P^{(i)}$ with the fundamental equation of a field extension. It does not recommend calling every important equation fundamental. Uravnenje also differs from jednačenje in TERM-0605; comparing those forms must not obscure their different contexts.

original_reasons.text: Kept as an international/formal term because the proof identifies (P^{(i)}) with a field-extension fundamental equation.

title: fundamentalno uravnenje / fundamentalna forma
isv: Fundamentalno uravnenje / fundamentalna forma sojedinjaje internacionalny korenj fundamental- so slovjanskim nazvom jednačenja. Razlog podkrepljaje historijnu kontinuitetnost i jasnost dlja sovrěmennogo čitatelja. On ne daje odvojenogo sravnjenja uravnenje s jednačenje. Obě zabilěžene formy zato sut vidime v slovniku; ne trěba iz različnyh zapisov tvoriti nezapisany konkurs s čislenym poběditeljem.
en: Fundamentalno uravnenje / fundamentalna forma combines the international stem fundamental- with a Slavic term for equation. The rationale emphasizes historical continuity and clarity for modern readers. It offers no separate comparison of uravnenje with jednačenje. Both recorded forms therefore remain visible; differing records must not be turned into an undocumented competition with a numerical winner.

original_reasons.text: Keeps Noether's historical vocabulary while remaining clear to modern readers; Interslavic uses international `fundamental-` paired with Slavic `uravnenje`.

title: fundamentalny teorem teorije eliminacije
isv: Fundamentalny teorem teorije eliminacije sohranjaje historijno ime teorema. Razlog svęzuje jedinstvenost asociovanyh prostyh idealov s razložbenym teoremom teorije eliminacije v osoblivyh polinomnyh oblastjah. Pridavnik fundamentalny zato služi identifikaciji rezultata, ne ocěně njegovej važnosti. Rusko sravnjenje upotrěbjaje osnovnaja, ukrajinsko fundamentalna; ta razlika ne jest sama po sobě razlog prěimenovati avtorsky teorem.
en: Fundamentalny teorem teorije eliminacije preserves a historical theorem name. The rationale connects uniqueness of associated prime ideals with the elimination-theoretic decomposition theorem in particular polynomial domains. Fundamentalny thus identifies the result rather than appraising its importance. The Russian comparator uses osnovnaja and the Ukrainian fundamentalna; that difference alone is not a reason to rename the author's theorem.

original_reasons.text: The theorem name is kept close to the historical source because Noether presents associated-prime uniqueness as an equivalent of the elimination-theoretic decomposition theorem in special polynomial domains.

title: funkcija prvogo roda / polje prvogo roda
source: Funktion erster Art / Körper erster Art
russian: функция первого рода / поле первого рода
ukrainian: функція першого роду / поле першого роду
isv: Funkcija prvogo roda / polje prvogo roda sohranjaje označenje iz Steinitzovej doby, a ne zaměnjaje go novym nazvom klasa polj. Točno značenje zavisi od definicije v danoj rabotě. Novo sravnjenje niže pokazuje svez s različnymi linearnymi faktorami v rabotě 24, a takože drugu definiciju prvogo roda v rabotě 6. Jednaka fraza zato ne dokazuje jednakosti dvuh matematičnyh pojmov.
en: Funkcija prvogo roda / polje prvogo roda preserves a designation from the Steinitz period instead of replacing it with a newer field classification. Its precise meaning depends on the definition in the particular paper. The fresh comparison below shows the connection with distinct linear factors in Paper 24 and a different first-kind definition in Paper 6. Identical phrasing does not establish identity of the two mathematical concepts.

comparisons.title_isv: Prvogo roda: dva različne lokalne oprěděljenja
comparisons.title_en: First kind: two different local definitions
comparisons.text: V odděle 1, punktah 14 i 15 raboty 24, prvogo roda jest svęzano s razpadom proste funkcije na različne linearne faktory i s eksponentom $f=0$; daljši punkt opisuje podpolje elementov prvogo roda. Naprotiv, definicija VII v rabotě 6 oprěděljaje relativno cělu oblast prvogo roda prěz oblast odobraženja i algebraičnu cělost polinomov nad njeju. To sut različne definicije dlja različnyh objektov. Slovnična fraza mora byti svęzana s točnym městom upotrěby; javna svez s sovrěmennoju terminologijeju može byti objasnjena odvojeno, ne tiho podstavjena v avtorsky tekst.
comparisons.english: In Paper 24 section 1, items 14 and 15, first kind is tied to splitting of a simple function into distinct linear factors and to exponent $f=0$; the next item describes the subfield of first-kind elements. In contrast, definition VII in Paper 6 defines a relatively integral domain of the first kind by means of an image domain and the algebraic integrality of polynomials over it. These are different definitions for different objects. The dictionary phrase needs an exact context of use; a relationship to modern terminology can be explained separately, not silently substituted in the author's text.

passages.quote: {\itshape Definicija VII: Relativno cěla oblast $\Gdom_{n\rho}$ zove se oblast prvogo roda, ako kako oblast odobraženja imaje relativno cělu oblast $\Gdom^*_{\rho\rho}$ taku, že vsak libovoljny polinom od $x_1,\ldots,x_\rho$ (s koeficientami iz $\Omega$) jest algebraično cěly nad $\Gdom^*_{\rho\rho}$.}

\textbf{14. Karakteristika, doskonale i nedoskonale polja, razširjenje prvogo roda.} Polje $\Omega$ nazyva se harakteristiki nul, ako prosto polje, ktoro sodrživaje se v $\Omega$ i vyvodi se iz jedinice, jest tipa polja racionalnyh čisel; harakteristiki $p$, ako to prosto polje jest tipa sistema ostatkovyh klasov po prostom čislu $p$. Polje $\Omega$ nazyva se doskonalo, ako vsaka prosta funkcija s koeficientami iz $\Omega$ v vhodnom razširiteljnem polju razpada se na različne linearne faktory; v protivnom slučaju nazyva se nedoskonalo. Vsako polje harakteristiki nul jest doskonalo; polje harakteristiki $p$ jest doskonalo togda i samo togda, kogda vměstě s vsakym elementom sodrživaje takože jego $p$-ti korenj. Prosta funkcija v nedoskonalom polju jest cěla funkcija $r$-go stepena od $x^{p^f}$ i razpada se v vhodnom razširiteljnem polju na $p^f$-te potegy $r$ različnyh linearnyh faktorov; $f$ nazyva se eksponent. Prosta funkcija nazyva se prvogo roda, ako v vhodnom razširiteljnem polju razpada se na različne linearne faktory, to jest ako eksponent $f$ jest nul; razširjenje nazyva se prvogo roda, ako vsaky element jest prvogo roda, to jest jest nulj proste funkcije prvogo roda. Vsako razširjenje, ktoro nastavaje prisojedinjenjem elementa prvogo roda, jest prvogo roda; pri doskonalyh poljah sut samo razširjenja prvogo roda (Steinitz, § 11 i § 13).

\textbf{15. Redukovany stepen i eksponent konečnogo razširjenja.} Ako $\mathcal K$ jest konečno razširjenje nedoskonalogo polja $\Omega$, togda v $\mathcal K$ sodrživaje se podpolje $\mathcal K_0$ stepena $r$, ktoro jest prvogo roda po odnošenju k $\Omega$ i ktoro sostoji se iz vsih i samo iz elementov prvogo roda v $\mathcal K$. $p^f$-ta potega vsakogo elementa iz $\mathcal K$ naleži k $\mathcal K_0$, i sut v $\mathcal K$ elementi, ktore sut točno stepena $rp^f$. $r$ nazyva se redukovany stepen, $f$ eksponent konečnogo razširjenja (Steinitz, § 14, 1 i § 14, 5).

original_reasons.text: This is Steinitz-era field terminology already introduced in § 1. The literal first-kind wording is kept because it is historical terminology, not a modern field-type replacement.

title: funkcije nultogo stepena
isv: Funkcije nultogo stepena sohranjaje točnu formulaciju nulovogo stepena. Sam historijny razlog jest velmi kratky; njegov smysl možno utočniti čitanjem lokalnogo dogovora. Rabota 6 izrično utožsamnjaje te funkcije s veličinami iz koeficientnogo polja $\Omega$. Zato ne ide o funkcije, ktore imajut nulovu cěnnost; ne treba takože bezuslovno prěnesti to značenje na vsaku drugu konvenciju o stepeni racionalnoj funkcije.
en: Funkcije nultogo stepena retains the exact degree-zero wording. The historical reason is very brief; its meaning can be clarified by reading the local convention. Paper 6 explicitly identifies these functions with quantities in the coefficient field $\Omega$. It therefore does not mean functions whose value is zero, nor should that meaning be transferred without qualification to every other convention for the degree of a rational function.

comparisons.title_isv: Funkcije, koeficientno polje i matrica proizvodnyh
comparisons.title_en: Functions, the coefficient field and the derivative matrix
comparisons.text: Odděl 1 raboty 6 razsmatrjaje racionalne funkcije v redukovanom predstavjenju nad koeficientnym poljem $\Omega$ i izrično nazyvaje veličiny iz $\Omega$ funkcijami nultogo stepena. To lokalno oprěděljenje ne govori o nulovoj funkciji. V odděle 2 rang funkcionalnoj matrice jest $\rho$, a formula (2) izdvaja nenulovy determinant čestičnyh proizvodnyh. Sravnjenje čini točnym kontekst dvuh nazvov, ne predlagaje zaměnu historijnoj terminologije ni novu univerzalnu konvenciju o stepeni racionalnyh funkcij.
comparisons.english: Section 1 of Paper 6 considers rational functions in reduced form over a coefficient field $\Omega$ and explicitly calls quantities in $\Omega$ functions of degree zero. This local convention does not mean the zero function. In section 2 the functional matrix has rank $\rho$, and equation (2) isolates a nonzero determinant of partial derivatives. The comparison specifies the context of the two names; it proposes neither replacement of the historical terminology nor a new universal convention for the degree of rational functions.

passages.quote: Pod $f(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$, $g(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$, \ldots\ ili skračeno $f(x)$, $g(x)$, \ldots\ trěba zato vsegda razuměti racionalne funkcije od $x_1,\ldots,x_n$; ony sut prědpoložene v redukovanom prědstavjenju, to jest s medžusobno prostymi čisliteljem i imenovateljem. Cěle racionalne funkcije (polinomy) budut označane velikymi bukvami $F(x)$, $G(x)$, \ldots. Koeficientna oblast $\Omega$ jest prědpoložena kako někoje čislovo polje, može zato osoblivo obhvatati i vse kompleksne čisla; $\Omega$ može takože sodrživati ješče konečno čislo parametrov.
Velikosti iz $\Omega$, to jest vse funkcije nultogo stepena, vsegda računajut se kako naležeče k sistemu.

\item {\itshape On sodrživaje pored $f(x)$ i $g(x)$ vsegda takože $f(x)+g(x)$, $f(x)\cdot g(x)$ i --- pri $g(x)\ne0$ --- kvocient $f(x):g(x)$.}\footnote{Pri tom $f(x)$ i $g(x)$ mogut byti takože nultogo stepena, to jest velikostami iz $\Omega$.}

\frac{\partial(g_1,g_2,\ldots,g_\rho)}{\partial(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_\rho)}
=\frac{\Gamma(x)}{G(x)^{\rho+1}}\ne0,

original_reasons.text: Direct degree-zero convention.

title: funkcije odobraženja
isv: Podčrtna primětka opreděljaje tę funkcije kako funkcije proměnnyh x₁, …, xρ. Prěmy termin funkcije odobraženja jest zato dopolnjen iztočnym objasnjenjem, vměsto toga da bi sam termin nesl neizrečene nove hipotezy.
en: The footnote defines these as functions of x₁, …, xρ. The direct term is therefore accompanied by the source's explanation rather than being made to carry additional unstated assumptions.

original_reasons.text: The footnote defines these as functions of x_1,...,x_rho, so the term is translated directly and then explained.

title: funkcionalna matrica
isv: Funkcionalna matrica jest blizky prěvod historijnogo nazva. Zapis priznavaje svez izloženej matrice proizvodnyh s sovrěmennym Jacobian, ale ne želi tiho zaměniti avtorsko slovo. Pri novom čitanju odděla 2 raboty 6 možno viděti, kako rang matrice i nenulovy determinant vhodet v argument o algebraičnoj zavisnosti. To podkrepljaje predmetno jasno objasnjenje v slovniku, ne samovoljno prěimenovanje v prěvodu.
en: Funkcionalna matrica closely translates the historical designation. The rationale recognizes the displayed derivative matrix's relation to a modern Jacobian but avoids silently replacing the author's word. A fresh reading of Paper 6 section 2 shows how matrix rank and a nonzero determinant enter the argument about algebraic dependence. This supports a mathematically explicit dictionary explanation, not unilateral renaming in the translation.

comparisons.title_en: Functions, the coefficient field and the derivative matrix

To lokalno oprěděljenje ne govori o nulovoj funkciji. V odděle 2 rang funkcionalnoj matrice jest $\rho$, a formula (2) izdvaja nenulovy determinant čestičnyh proizvodnyh. Sravnjenje čini točnym kontekst dvuh nazvov, ne predlagaje zaměnu historijnoj terminologije ni novu univerzalnu konvenciju o stepeni racionalnyh funkcij.
