\textbf{Teorem XIII.} \emph{Pri vsakom najkratšem prědstavjenju ideala kako najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo iz nerazložimyh odnosno največših primarnyh idealov izolovane nerazložime odnosno največše primarne idealy sut jednoznačno oprěděljene; mnogoznačnost odnosi se samo na neizolovane nerazložime odnosno največše primarne idealy.}\footnote{Toj teorem za idealy iz polinomov v slučaju razloženja na največše primarne idealy už byl podany bez dokaza u Macaulay; jego definicija izolovanyh i neizolovanyh (imbedded) primarnyh idealov može se razgledati iracionalnoju formulacijoju niže podane.} \emph{Obče izolovane idealy sut jednoznačno oprěděljene svojimi pridruženymi prostymi idealami.}

\textbf{Teorem VIII.} \emph{Osnovne idealy $i$-go nivoja $\frakg_i$ sut izolovane komponenty razloženja, jednoznačno oprěděljene cěloju sovokupnostju asociovanyh prostyh idealov dimenzij $n-1,n-2,\ldots,n-i$. Ako vsi asociovane proste idealy sut toj samej dimenzije, togda i ideal stavaje toj dimenzije; to jest nastupa samo jedin faktor $R^{(i)}$ normy. Obče norma ima toliko od jedinice različnyh faktorov $R^{(i)},R^{(i+\sigma)},R^{(i+\tau)},\ldots$, koliko različnyh dimenzijnyh čisel nastupa medžu asociovanymi prostymi idealami.}

Aby dojti do takogo prědstavjenja, trěba samo, kogda god možno, po teoremě I egzistujuče prědstavjenje prěz nerazložime, znači po teoremě II primarne idealy, zaměniti s najkratšim prědstavjenjem. Ako primarne idealy, naležeče k jednakym prostym idealam, sobirajut se skupaj, iskano prědstavjenje slěduje po \S~5, 3. Primarne komponenty možno nazvati največšimi, zato že najmenše obče mnogokratno kojihkoli medžu nimi už ne jest primarno.\footnote{Pri tom asociovane proste idealy i izolovane komponenty sut jednoznačno oprěděljene. Sr. \emph{Idealtheorie} ili \foreign{W. Krull}, Math. Ann. 90 (1923), S. 55--64.}

original_reasons.text: The addendum links Section05 uniqueness to the later uniqueness of isolated greatest primary ideals. The adjective isolated is preserved rather than replaced by a modern associated-prime category.

title: izolovany ideal / neizolovany ideal
isv: Izolovany ideal / neizolovany ideal v rabotě 19, §7, sohranja dvojicu, na kotoroj osnovana jest teorema jedinosti. Definicija VIa čini izolaciju nezavisnoju od izbranogo komplementa, pri izričnyh uslovjah na prědstavjenje i pridružene proste idealy. Teorema XIII potom ograničuje mnogoznačnost na neizolovane komponenty. Ne- zato nosi matematično značenje. Macaulayevo istorično imbedded jest citovano v svojem kontekstě; ono ne jest dovoljenjem povsudu tiho zaměniti avtorovu paru slov modernym embedded/non-embedded.
en: Izolovany ideal / neizolovany ideal in Paper 19, §7 preserves the opposition underlying the uniqueness theorem. Definition VIa makes isolation independent of the chosen complement, under explicit conditions on the representation and associated primes. Theorem XIII then confines possible nonuniqueness to the non-isolated components. The negative prefix therefore carries mathematical content. Macaulay's historical imbedded is cited in its own context; it does not license silently replacing the author's pair throughout by modern embedded/non-embedded.

comparisons.text: Prědbežne odkazy raboty 19 vodat k Definiciji VIa i Teoremě XIII. Definicija sohranja uslovja na pridružene proste idealy i prědstavjenje, ale ne zavisi od specialnogo komplementa. Jedinost ne proširjaje se avtomatično na neizolovane komponenty. V rabotě 24 osnovny ideal jest izolovana komponenta oprěděljena cěloju sovokupnostju prostyh idealov; zato komponenta ne znači vsegda jeden primarny ideal. Rabota 30 povtorjaje tvrdženje jedinosti v podnožnoj primětke.
comparisons.english: Forward references in Paper 19 lead to Definition VIa and Theorem XIII. The definition retains conditions on associated primes and the representation while becoming independent of a particular complement. Uniqueness does not automatically extend to non-isolated components. In Paper 24 a basic ideal is an isolated component determined by a whole collection of primes; component therefore does not always mean a single primary ideal. Paper 30 repeats the uniqueness assertion in a footnote.

passages.quote: \textbf{Teorem VII.} \emph{Pri dvoh različnyh najkratših prědstavjenjah ideala kako najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo iz nerazložimyh idealov pridružene proste idealy sběgajut se; medžu njimi mogut se pojavjati takože jednaki\footnote{To pokazuje napr. priměr iz podnožnoj primětky 19: \((x^2,xy,y^\lambda)=[(x^2,y),(x,y^\lambda)]\), kde \(\lambda\ge2\). Dva pridružene proste idealy sut tu: \((x,y)\).}, i to v vsakom razloženju ravnako često. Zato same idealy možno na prinajmenje jeden sposob poparno pridružiti tako, že vsaky raz nějaky stepen jednogo ideala \(\ideal B_i\) jest dělimy prěz pridruženy \(\ideal D_i\), i obratno. Jih čislo sběgaje se po teoremu IV.}\footnote{Za jedinost ``izolovanyh'' idealov sodrživanyh medžu nerazložimymi idealami sr. \S~7.}

\textbf{Teorem IX.} \emph{Pri dvoh redukovanyh prědstavjenjah ideala kako najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo iz največših primarnyh idealov sběgajut se čislo komponentov i pridružene proste idealy, ktore vse sut medžu soboju različne. Drugymi slovami: vsakomu \(\ideal Q\) možno jedno-jednoznačno pridružiti jedno \(\ideal Q'\) tako, že nějaky stepen od \(\ideal Q\) jest dělimy prěz \(\ideal Q'\), i obratno.}\footnote{Priměr različnyh prědstavjenij jest on, ktory byl dany v podnožnoj primětky 12 k teoremu II: \((x^2,xy)=[(x),(x^2,\mu x+y)]\) za libovoljno \(\mu\). Zato že pridružene proste idealy \(\ideal P_1=(x)\); \(\ideal P_2=(x,y)\) sut medžu soboju različne, ide o največše primarne idealy. -- Za jedinost ``izolovanyh'' največših primarnyh idealov sr. \S~7.} \emph{-- Idealy \(\ideal Q\) i \(\ideal Q'\) imajut svojstvo nerazložimosti v odnosu k razloženju na največše primarne idealy.}

\textbf{Definicija VIa.} \emph{\(\ideal R\) nazyvaje se izolovany ideal, ako proste idealy od \(\ideal R\), pridružene k razloženju na nerazložime idealy, ne vhodet v ostale proste idealy, pridružene k odgovarjajučemu razloženju \(\ideal M\), i ako \(\ideal R\) nastupaje prinajmenje v jednom prědstavjenju \(\ideal M=[\ideal R,\ideal L]\), redukovanom v odnosu k \(\ideal R\).}\footnote{Ako by se vvodili obyčne pridružene proste idealy (konec \S~5), togda kako osoblivo uslovje trěba bylo by dodati, že ty od \(\ideal L\) sut vse različne od tych od \(\ideal R\). Po definiciji VIa zato prědstavjenje už ne mora byti prědpoloženo redukovano v odnosu k komplementu.}

\textbf{Teorem XIII.} \emph{Pri vsakom najkratšem prědstavjenju ideala kako najmenšego občego mnogokratnogo iz nerazložimyh odnosno največših primarnyh idealov izolovane nerazložime odnosno največše primarne idealy sut jednoznačno oprěděljene; mnogoznačnost odnosi se samo na neizolovane nerazložime odnosno največše primarne idealy.}\footnote{Toj teorem za idealy iz polinomov v slučaju razloženja na največše primarne idealy už byl podany bez dokaza u Macaulay; jego definicija izolovanyh i neizolovanyh (imbedded) primarnyh idealov može se razgledati iracionalnoju formulacijoju niže podane.} \emph{Obče izolovane idealy sut jednoznačno oprěděljene svojimi pridruženymi prostymi idealami.}

\textbf{Teorem VIII.} \emph{Osnovne idealy $i$-go nivoja $\frakg_i$ sut izolovane komponenty razloženja, jednoznačno oprěděljene cěloju sovokupnostju asociovanyh prostyh idealov dimenzij $n-1,n-2,\ldots,n-i$. Ako vsi asociovane proste idealy sut toj samej dimenzije, togda i ideal stavaje toj dimenzije; to jest nastupa samo jedin faktor $R^{(i)}$ normy. Obče norma ima toliko od jedinice različnyh faktorov $R^{(i)},R^{(i+\sigma)},R^{(i+\tau)},\ldots$, koliko različnyh dimenzijnyh čisel nastupa medžu asociovanymi prostymi idealami.}

Aby dojti do takogo prědstavjenja, trěba samo, kogda god možno, po teoremě I egzistujuče prědstavjenje prěz nerazložime, znači po teoremě II primarne idealy, zaměniti s najkratšim prědstavjenjem. Ako primarne idealy, naležeče k jednakym prostym idealam, sobirajut se skupaj, iskano prědstavjenje slěduje po \S~5, 3. Primarne komponenty možno nazvati največšimi, zato že najmenše obče mnogokratno kojihkoli medžu nimi už ne jest primarno.\footnote{Pri tom asociovane proste idealy i izolovane komponenty sut jednoznačno oprěděljene. Sr. \emph{Idealtheorie} ili \foreign{W. Krull}, Math. Ann. 90 (1923), S. 55--64.}

original_reasons.text: Section07 makes isolation independent of a chosen complement by Definition VIa and then uses it in Theorem XIII for uniqueness. The translations therefore keep the isolated/non-isolated contrast literal and stable instead of paraphrasing it as embedded/non-embedded except where Macaulay's historical “imbedded” wording is cited.

title: izomorfija / izomorfno prirěditi
isv: Izomorfija / izomorfno prirěditi v rabotě 24 sohranja medžunarodny imenik i daje glagol za formalno prirědženje. Motivacija izrično razlikuje prirěditi od volnějšego sootvětstvovati. Tak tekst govori ne samo, že dva objekty kažut se sličnymi, ale že konstruirova se oprěděljena sootvětnost. Koren izomorf- jest obči vsim trema zapisanym prevodam; izbor konca -ija i glagola ostaje konkretnym medžuslovjanskim rěšenjem.
en: Izomorfija / izomorfno prirěditi in Paper 24 keeps the international noun and supplies a verb for a formal assignment. The rationale expressly distinguishes prirěditi from looser sootvětstvovati. The text thus says more than that two objects seem similar: it constructs a specified correspondence. The izomorf- stem is shared by all three recorded translations; the -ija ending and the verb remain particular Interslavic choices.

original_reasons.text: All lanes keep the international isomorphism stem. Interslavic `prirěditi` is used for the formal assignment correspondence and stays distinct from looser `sootvětstvovati` prose.

title: Izomorfija ne znači vključanje
source: R nur als zu den K_i äquivalenter und nicht selbst in Q gelegener Körper
russian: R только как поле, эквивалентное K_i, а не как поле, само лежащее в Q
ukrainian: R лише як поле, еквівалентне K_i, а не як поле, що саме лежить у Q
isv: Ograničenje samo kako ekvivalentno polje, a ne kako polje už ležeče v $Q$, čuva razliku medžu izomorfijeju i vključanjem. To jest cěly matematičny razlog zachovanogo izbora. Rabota 31, §6, davaje izomorfne obrazy $K_i$ v jednom Galoisovom polju $Q$, ale izvorno polje ne prědpokladaje už tamo směstjenym. Slova samo i a ne ne sut stilističny dodatok: ona ograđajut tvrđenje. V tutom kontekstu ekvivalentno objasnjaje se pomoču navedenyh izomorfizmov; ne trěba go čitati kako libovoljnu neoprěděljenu ekvivalenciju. Pri prěnosu v logiku razlikovanje abstraktnogo objekta i njegove realizacije mora ostati jednako eksplicitno.
en: The qualification 'only as an equivalent field, not as a field already lying in $Q$' preserves the difference between isomorphism and inclusion. That is the full mathematical reason for the recorded choice. Paper 31, §6, supplies isomorphic images $K_i$ in one Galois overfield $Q$, but does not assume the original field is already situated there. Only and not are not stylistic additions: they delimit the claim. Equivalent is explained here by the stated isomorphisms, not an unspecified equivalence relation. Transfer to logic must preserve the distinction between an abstract object and its realization just as explicitly.

comparisons.title_en: Isomorphism and the location of a realization
comparisons.text: Tekst ne prědpokladaje, že izvorno polje samo už leži v $Q$.
comparisons.english: The text does not assume the original field is already contained in $Q$.

passages.quote: To jest, diskriminant prědstavja se kako kvadrat determinanta konjugovanyh baznyh elementov. Osoblivo, ako $\mathfrak R$ samo jest polje, znači razširjeno polje prvogo roda svojego podpolja $P$, togda homomorfizmy od $\mathfrak R$ k $K_i$ prěhodet v izomorfizmy; pri tom elementy iz $P$ odpovědajut samym sobě, zato že komponenta od $P$ jest dana kako $P e_i$. Zato $K_i$, zato že vse oni ležet v občem obhvatnom polju $Q$, sut konjugovane polja po odnošenju k $P$; i imenno tyh $n$ izomorfizmov sut medžu soboju različne, kako pokazuje gornje determinantno prědstavjenje nenulovogo diskriminanta. Ako $\mathfrak R$ jest polje, togda prědstavjenje kako direktna suma v $K_1,\ldots,K_n$ dava $n$ konjugovanyh razširjenyh polj $n$-togo stepena nad $P$, ležečih v Galoisovom razširjenom polju i izomorfnyh k $\mathfrak R$. Prědstavjenje slěda, normy i diskriminanta togda prěhodi v znano prědstavjenje prěz konjugovane elementy. Trěba ješče raz podčrknuti, že $\mathfrak R$ prědpoklada se samo kako polje ekvivalentno k $K_i$, a ne kako polje samo už ležeče v Galoisovom razširjenom polju $Q$.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether's caution against over-identifying R with a subfield of the Galois overfield. This is important mathematically and is logged for later consistency in §7.

historical_form: R samo kako polje ekvivalentno k K_i, a ne kako polje samo ležeče v Q

title: Izomorfizm kako pričina zaključka
isv: Zaradi izomorfizma kolc klasov ostatkov jest pričinna svez, ne samo pomenanje srodnyh objektov. Aktualna forma zaměnjuje kolc slovom prstenov. Pasaža upotrěbjaje izomorfizm dlja prenosa svojstva multiplikacijnogo prstena na lokalizovany prsten, potom priměnjaje ranějši rezultat o glavnyh idealah. Izpustiti zaradi značilo by oslabiti vidlivu osnovu zaključka. Samo izomorfizm kvocientov ne nazyva početkovy i lokalizovany prsten bukvalno jednakymi.
en: Zaradi izomorfizma kolc klasov ostatkov is a causal link, not merely a mention of related objects. The current form replaces kolc with prstenov. The passage uses the isomorphism to transfer the multiplication-ring property to the localized ring, then applies the earlier result concerning principal ideals. Dropping zaradi would obscure the stated basis of the inference. Isomorphism of the residue rings does not call the original and localized rings literally identical.

comparisons.title_en: Quotient isomorphism and the local inference
comparisons.text: Pričinna svez ostaje čest dokaza.
comparisons.english: The causal connection remains part of the proof.

passages.quote: \noindent Te same razmysljenja sut pravdive takože za multiplikacijsko prsten $\mo$. Osoblivo, ako $\mpideal$ jest prosty ideal, togda $\mo_\mpideal$ imaje samo jedin prosty ideal, različny od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala; zaradi izomorfizma prstenov klasov ostatkov prsten $\mo_\mpideal$, kako i $\mo$, jest multiplikacijsko prsten, i po 1 togda $\mo_\mpideal$ jest prsten glavnyh idealov. Element, ktory poraždaje prosty ideal izvedeny iz $\mpideal$, stava prostym elementom $p$ iz $\mo_\mpideal$. Razširjeny ideal libovoljnogo ideala $\mc$ iz $\mo$ jest porodženy primarnoju komponentoju $\mc$, prinaležečoju k $\mpideal$; zato on jest ravny $(p)^\alpha$ abo jediničnomu idealu, soglasno tomu, vhodi li $\mpideal$ v $\mc$ -- i to v $\alpha$-toj stepeni -- abo ne vhodi v $\mc$. Iz togo ješče slěduje: ako razširjenja dvoh idealov $\mb$ i $\mc$ iz $\mo$ sběgajut se v vsih prstenah kvocientov $\mo_\mpideal$, togda $\mb$ i $\mc$ sut identične, zato že oni sut dělimy tymi samymi prostymi idealami $\mpideal$ i v tyh samyh stepenjah.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the residue-class-ring isomorphism as the reason the multiplication-ring property passes to the localization.

title_en: Isomorphism as the reason for an inference

title: izomorfizm kolc klasov ostatkov
isv: Izomorfizm kolc klasov ostatkov v rabotě 31 sohranja polnu konstrukciju Restklassenringe. Rěč jest o prstenovoj strukturě, ne samo o bijekciji množin klasov. Motivacija odklanja skračenje do samogo nazvanja faktor-prstenov, zato že ono moglo by zakryti izričny odkaz na ostatkove klasy v dokazě. To ne ustanavjaje različnost medžu prstenom klasov ostatkov i odgovarjajučim faktor-prstenom; ide o način predstavjenja. Zdes imenik jest izomorfizm, dokolě druge zapisy izbirajut izomorfija. Oba istoricky zasvědčena vybora ostajut vidimy.
en: Izomorfizm kolc klasov ostatkov in Paper 31 preserves the full Restklassenringe construction. The assertion concerns ring structure, not merely a bijection between sets of classes. The rationale rejects shortening the expression to the name quotient rings because that might conceal the proof's express reference to residue classes. This does not establish a mathematical difference between a residue-class ring and the corresponding quotient ring; it concerns presentation. Here the noun is izomorfizm, while other records select izomorfija. Both historically recorded choices remain visible.

original_reasons.text: Preserves ring-level residue-class isomorphism instead of flattening the phrase to quotient rings.

title: izomorfna prirědba / nulovy klas / dělitelji nuly
russian: изоморфное сопоставление / нулевой класс / делители нуля
ukrainian: ізоморфне співвіднесення / нульовий клас / дільники нуля
isv: Izomorfna prirědba / nulovy klas / dělitelji nuly sut sočetane termini dokaza Teoremy VI v rabotě 24. Prirědba izbrana jest za formalno prisvojenje, različeno od volnějšego sootvętstvovati v prose. Nulovy klas jest klas ostatkov, ktory predstavjaje nulu; dělitelj nuly jest element s drugim svojstvom v prstenu. Frazy ne smějut sliti te dva pojma. Motivacija ne govori, že samo porěd nazvanj už ustanavjaje izomorfiju; sootvětnost i operacije morajut byti dany argumentom.
en: Izomorfna prirědba / nulovy klas / dělitelji nuly are related terms in the proof of Theorem VI in Paper 24. Prirědba is selected for a formal assignment, distinct from looser sootvętstvovati in prose. A zero class is the residue class representing zero; a zero divisor has a different property in the ring. The wording must not merge those concepts. The rationale does not imply that the list of names establishes an isomorphism: the correspondence and operations must be supplied by the argument.

original_reasons.text: These terms carry the proof of Theorem VI. Interslavic uses `prirědba` for a formal assignment/correspondence, distinct from looser `sootvętstvovati` in prose.

title: izomorfne / izomorfna sootvětnost / izomorfno odobraženje
isv: Izomorfne / izomorfna sootvětnost / izomorfno odobraženje v rabotě 9, §8, sohranja medžunarodny koren i razlikuje sootvětnost od imenovanogo odobraženja. Ruski par соответствие i отображение daje prěmu sravnjajuču oporu; ukrajinski odnos i odobraženje pokazyvajut podobno razlikovanje, ne identičnu sintaksu. Tak prěvod može nazvati i relaciju medžu oblastjami, i konkretno odobraženje. Izomorfija ne znači, že dve oblasti sut bukvalno jedna i ta sama podmnožina.
en: Izomorfne / izomorfna sootvětnost / izomorfno odobraženje in Paper 9, §8 retains the international stem and distinguishes correspondence from a designated map. Russian соответствие and отображение provide direct comparators; Ukrainian relation and mapping show a similar distinction, not identical syntax. The translation can thus name both a relation between domains and a particular mapping. Isomorphism does not mean that the two domains are literally the same subset.

original_reasons.text: Modern mathematical isomorphism vocabulary is used directly. Russian uses соответствие where the source emphasizes relation/correspondence and отображение for mapping; Interslavic keeps international izomorf and transparent relation/mapping words.

title: izomorfne kako R-moduly
isv: Izomorfne kako R-moduly izrično imenuje strukturu, v ktorej se tvrdi izomorfizm. To ne jest samo ravnost klas idealov, ni proizvoljno odgovaranje množstv, ni nužno izomorfizm prstenov. Kako R-moduly zato nosi matematičnu informaciju i ne može byti izpuščeno radi kratkosti.
en: Izomorfne kako R-moduly explicitly names the structure in which the isomorphism holds. It is not merely equality of ideal classes, an arbitrary correspondence of sets, or necessarily a ring isomorphism. As R-modules carries mathematical information and cannot be dropped for brevity.

original_reasons.text: Makes the module structure explicit and avoids reading ideal-class equivalence as only ring-theoretic or set-theoretic equivalence.

title: izomorfno odobraženje
isv: Izomorfno odobraženje v uvodu raboty 10 prodolžuje ranějšu terminologiju odobraženij. Rusko отображение i ukrajinsko відображення podpirajut izbranu semju; pridevnik sohranja medžunarodno izomorf-. Motivacija jest i smyslova, i tekstova: odobraženje dolžno byti razpoznavajemo kak toj samy tip konstrukcije v različnyh čestjah prevoda. To ne otměnjaje potrěbu pri konkretnom odobraženju ukazati objekty i strukturu, ktora sohranjaje se.
en: Izomorfno odobraženje at the opening of Paper 10 continues the earlier mapping vocabulary. Russian отображение and Ukrainian відображення support the chosen family; the adjective retains international izomorf-. The reason is semantic and textual: readers should recognize the same type of construction across the translation. This does not remove the need to specify the objects and the preserved structure for a particular map.

original_reasons.text: Standard Ukrainian/Russian mathematical term; Interslavic keeps odobraženje to match mapping language used earlier in the lane.

title: izomorfny / izomorfija
isv: Izomorfny / izomorfija v rabotě 22, §4, sohranja medžunarodny matematičny koren. Motivacija svazuje jego s definicijeju prěz sistemy prědstaviteljev i s nazvanjem teoremy: volny opis mogl by zakryti tu vez. Pridevnik naziva svojstvo ili odnošenje, imenik izomorfija samo odnošenje ili odobraženje po kontekstu. Rusko i ukrajinsko nazvanja na -izm ne objazujut medžuslovjanski avtomatično vybrati isto zakončenje; v dokumentah jest izbrano -ija.
en: Izomorfny / izomorfija in Paper 22, §4 retains the international mathematical stem. The rationale links it to the definition through systems of representatives and to the theorem's name: a free paraphrase could obscure that connection. The adjective names a property or relation, while izomorfija names the relation or map as the context requires. The Russian and Ukrainian nouns ending in -izm do not automatically require the same Interslavic ending; the documented choice is -ija.

original_reasons.text: Keep the international mathematical stem. Section 4 defines the isomorphism by representative systems, so paraphrase would obscure the theorem label.

title: Izpolniti, izpolnjati, izpolnjenje
isv: Izpoln- jest osnovny zapis slovničnogo izpȯln-, ne ispoln-. Familija ima dokonany izpolniti, nedokonany izpolnjati i imenovnik izpolnjenje. V kontekstah uslovij ili operacij govori o izpolnjenju ili izvršenju; srodne nacionalne slova mogut iměti druge zvukove realizacije. Zapis sodrživa točno 56 popravenyh pojavjenij i 129 uže pravilnyh form. Čisla dokazujut tolko obseg zapisanogo usoglasnjenja. Alternativy izvršiti, realizovati i završiti nebyly potrěbne, kogda smysl i sintaksa uže sootvětstvovali izpoln-. Drugy kontekst, napr. završiti dokaz, ne mora upotrěbiti isto slovo samo zaradi edinogo stilja.
en: Izpoln- is the basic spelling of dictionary izpȯln-, not ispoln-. The family has perfective izpolniti, imperfective izpolnjati and noun izpolnjenje. In contexts of conditions or operations it expresses fulfilment or execution; cognate national forms may realize the sounds differently. The record contains exactly 56 changed occurrences and 129 already matching forms; those numbers describe only the recorded normalization. Alternatives izvršiti, realizovati and završiti were unnecessary where meaning and syntax already fitted izpoln-. A different context, such as finishing a proof, need not use the same word merely for stylistic uniformity.

title: Izpolnjati uslovje
isv: Formalny objekt izpolnjaje uslovje, relaciju ili aksiom. Izpolnjati/izpolniti byli izbrany dlja etogo tehničnogo smysla vměsto obširnogo satisfy/please u zadovaljati/zadovoliti. Poslědne sut stvarne slovnične slova: ih emocijno značenje samo po sobě ne dokazuje nemogućnost tehničnogo proširenja. Razlog jest jasnost v dannom matematičnom registru i soglasje s uže izbranoj familijej. Dostavati značit dostatočnost, ne izpolnjenje točno zadannogo uslovja. S novym transitivnym glagolom objekt potrěbuje akuzativ; ostavjenje starogo dativa ili relativnoj konstrukcije moglo by skvariti větu. Zato 88 predikatov uključajut 32 redove s kontekstno proměnjenym upravjanjem. Ni strokovy broj ni široka glosa ne zaměnjujut to proverjanje.
en: A formal object satisfies a condition, relation or axiom. Izpolnjati/izpolniti were chosen for that technical sense instead of the broader satisfy/please of zadovaljati/zadovoliti. The latter are genuine dictionary words: their emotional sense does not itself prove a technical extension impossible. The rationale is clarity in this mathematical register and consistency with the selected family. Dostavati denotes sufficiency, not satisfaction of a specified condition. With the new transitive verb the object requires the accusative; retaining the former dative or relative construction could damage the sentence. The 88 predicates therefore include 32 lines with contextual government changes. Neither line counts nor a broad gloss replaces that check.

title: Izpolnjati: objekt i padež
isv: Uslovje, uravnenje ili relacija jest objekt izpolnjenja; vybran element ili bazis može byti subjektom. Zato naslědžene udovletvor-/udovolja konstrukcije potrěbujut nejen novu osnovu izpoln-, ale i sootvětno upravjanje objektom. Dativ ili relativna klauza, pravilna pri drugom glagolu, ne može ostati bez razbora. V 34 zapisanyh slučajah ne ide o ludsku zadovoljenost: izbor izpolnjati/izpolniti jest obosnovany formalnym smyslom. Zadovaljati ostaje slovnično slovo s širšimi značenjami, a njegovo izključanje iz etogo registra jest kontekstna prednost. To prodolžaje razlikovanje iz članka Izpolnjati uslovje; ne dava nov dokaz pan-slovjanskoj prednosti po čislu popravok. Vse kvantifikatory i ograničenja na objekt morajut ostati v věti.
en: A condition, equation or relation is the object of satisfaction; a selected element or basis may be its subject. The inherited udovletvor-/udovolja constructions therefore need not only the izpoln- stem but corresponding object government. A dative or relative clause appropriate with a different verb cannot remain without examination. None of the 34 recorded cases concerns human contentment; the formal sense motivates izpolnjati/izpolniti. Zadovaljati remains a dictionary word with broader meanings, and its exclusion from this register is contextual. This continues the distinction under Satisfy a condition; the number of repairs supplies no additional evidence of pan-Slavic superiority. All quantifiers and restrictions on the object must remain.

title: izpolnjenje redukcij
isv: Izpolnjenje redukcij označaje izvedenje postupkov redukcije, ne novu vrstu redukcije. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela podpirajut običnu proceduralnu konstrukciju. Izbor medžuslovjanskogo izpolnjenje byl obrazloženy razumělivostju, ale sam zapis ostavjaje jego idiomatičnost i oporu v jezyčnom upotrěbjenju za daljše razmotrenje.
en: Izpolnjenje redukcij denotes carrying out the reduction procedures, not a new kind of reduction. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels support an ordinary procedural construction. The Interslavic noun was preferred on grounds of intelligibility, but the record itself leaves its idiomaticity and usage support for further examination.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use normal procedural mathematical prose. Interslavic izpolnjenje is transparent but establishes proof-procedure vocabulary and should be checked against future repeated uses and authority feedback.

title: Izrična hipoteza o nenulovom idealu
isv: Ideal razny od nulovogo ideala jest izrična forma korotšego nenulovy ideal. Byla izbrana, aby kontrast nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala ostal čitlivy pri prěhode do prstena ostatkov. Pasaža prědstavjaje takovy ideal kako produkt konečno mnogyh vzajemno prostyh primarnyh idealov. Ona odrěđuje ješče svojstvo jih pridruženih prostyh idealov; ta čest ne dolžna propasti pri skračenju frazy. Razny i različny sut varianty jezyčnogo vyraženja, ne dva različne matematične uslovja.
en: Ideal razny od nulovogo ideala is an explicit form of the shorter nonzero ideal. It was chosen to keep the zero–unit contrast legible when passing to residue rings. The passage expresses such an ideal as a product of finitely many relatively prime primary ideals. It also specifies a property of their associated prime ideals; that part must survive any shortening of the phrase. Razny and različny are variants of expression, not two different mathematical conditions.

comparisons.title_isv: Nulovy ideal i pridružene proste idealy
comparisons.title_en: The zero ideal and associated prime ideals
comparisons.text: Obě česti formulacije noset matematične uslovja.
comparisons.english: Both parts of the formulation carry mathematical conditions.

passages.quote: \noindent Teorija idealov v $\mT$ jest dana slědujučim teoremom:\footnote{Idealtheorie, \S 7, 3.} v $\mT$ vsaky ideal razny od nulovogo ideala može jednoznačno byti prědstavjen kako produkt konečno mnogyh po parah vzajemno prostyh primarnyh idealov, ktoryh pridružene proste idealy ne imajut nikakogo vlastnogo dělitelja raznogo od jediničnogo ideala.

Nehaj $p$ bude prosty element iz $\mo$, t. j. glavny ideal $\mo p$, izvedeny iz $p$ v $\mo$, jest prosty ideal iz $\mo$, razny od nulovogo i jediničnogo idealov; odgovarjajuče označimo prěz $\mT p$ glavny ideal, izvedeny iz $p$ v $\mT$. Prsten klasov ostatkov

original_reasons.text: Use the explicit null-ideal phrasing rather than only `nonzero ideal`, because later reductions pass between ideals and residue-class rings where the zero/unit contrast is structural.

title: izvedena funkcionalna oblast / polje kvocientov
isv: Izvedena funkcionalna oblast i polje kvocientov prodolžujut terminologiju odděla 7. Izvedena izjasnjaje odnos konstrukcije, a polje kvocientov imenuje algebraičny objekt. Razlog jest transparentnost i doslědnost tųh izrazov v tom samom argumentu.
en: The two expressions continue the terminology of Section 7. Izvedena conveys the derivational relation; polje kvocientov names the algebraic object. The recorded reasons are transparency and consistency within the argument.

original_reasons.text: Continues §7 Entry01 vocabulary. Interslavic uses transparent Slavic `izvedena` plus established `funkcionalna oblast` and `polje kvocientov`.

title: izvedeny glavny ideal
isv: Izvedeny glavny ideal zachovuje imenovanje iztočnika. Zapis izrično odklanjaje tihu zaměnu opisom ideala generovanogo diskriminantom: tak opis by byl interpretacija, ne sam prěvod iztočnoj konstrukcije.
en: The expression retains the source's designation. The record explicitly rejects silently replacing it with an ideal-generated-by-the-discriminant paraphrase: that would be an interpretation rather than a translation of the construction itself.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether's derived-principal-ideal construction rather than silently replacing it with a modern ideal-generated-by-discriminant paraphrase.

title: izvodženje formul
isv: Izvodženje jest kandidat za proces vyvodženja formul, sravnjany s obyčnym ruskim i ukrajinskim matematičnym vyraženjem. Zapis navęzuje na izvod v drugom dělu, ale izrično označaje morfologiju i prirodnost konstrukcije kako otvorjene pytanja.
en: The candidate denotes the derivation of formulas, compared with ordinary Russian and Ukrainian mathematical phrasing and the earlier izvod family in Paper 2. The record explicitly leaves its morphology and idiomatic naturalness open to assessment.

original_reasons.text: Ukrainian/Russian use normal modern math-speak. Interslavic izvodženje continues the existing izvod/izvodženje lane in earlier Paper 02 material but remains authority-review because morphology and stylistic naturalness matter here.

title: Izvor mora byti dohvatny

title: Javno, jasno i jednoznačno
isv: Javno v slovniku znači ‘publicly’; jasno znači ‘clearly’. Osm německyh offenbar/ersichtlich kontekstov potrěbuje jasno, ne javno. Sedm explizit kontekstov istorija prěvodi familijeju jednoznačn-, ktorej slovničny smysl vključaje explicit i unambiguous. Ale eksplicitnost i jednoznačnost matematično ne sut to že: formula može byti jednoznačno oprěděljena bez eksplicitnogo izraza. Zato ta polisemija potrěbuje kontekstualnu prověrku, ne opiru samo na anglijskoj glosi. Dvanadset glagolnyh jav- form jest druga kategorija i ne podleži toj zaměně.
en: Dictionary javno means ‘publicly’, while jasno means ‘clearly’. Eight German offenbar/ersichtlich contexts require jasno rather than javno. Seven explizit contexts were historically rendered with jednoznačn-, whose dictionary gloss includes both explicit and unambiguous. But mathematical explicitness and uniqueness are not the same: a formula can be uniquely determined without an explicit expression. This polysemy needs contextual checking, not reliance on the English gloss alone. Twelve jav- verbs belong to another category and are outside this substitution.

title: Jedin element poraždaje ideal
russian: p порождает сам этот простой идеал
ukrainian: p породжує сам цей простий ідеал
isv: Poraždaje čuva izbrany glagol za algebraično generovanje. Zapis ne prědlagaje novu konkurentnu formu, ale prodolžaje uže upotrěbjany jezyk dokaza. V rabotě 31, §8, sam $p$ poraždaje prosty ideal, zato že jego glavny ideal ima točno prvu stepen jedinogo dopuščenogo prostogo idealnogo faktora. To znači ravnost idealov, ne samo pripadnost $p$ idealu. Rečenica zavisi od navedenogo svojstva multiplikacionnogo prstena i jedinstvenosti prostogo ideala različnogo od nulovogo i jediničnogo. Slovo sam podčrtaje, že ne potrěbny druge generatory; ne tvrdži, že generator jest jedinstveny. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože čuvajut glagol za generovanje.
en: Poraždaje retains the selected verb for algebraic generation. The record proposes no new competing form; it continues the proof's existing terminology. In Paper 31, §8, $p$ itself generates the prime ideal because its principal ideal has exactly the first power of the only allowed prime-ideal factor. This asserts equality of ideals, not merely membership of $p$ in the ideal. The sentence depends on the stated multiplication-ring properties and uniqueness of the prime ideal other than zero and the unit ideal. Itself emphasizes that no additional generators are needed; it does not assert uniqueness of the generator. The Russian and Ukrainian parallels likewise retain the generation verb.

comparisons.title_en: A generator of the prime ideal
comparisons.text: Uslovja raboty 31, §8, dajut, že glavny ideal od $p$ jest ravny razgledanomu prostomu idealu. Poraždaje vyražaje tu ravnost. Pripadnost jednogo elementa idealu ne byla by dovoljna; ni slovo sam ne ustanavljaje jedinstvenost generatora.
comparisons.english: The hypotheses of Paper 31, §8, make the principal ideal of $p$ equal to the prime ideal in question. Generates expresses that equality. Membership of one element would not suffice; itself does not establish uniqueness of the generator.

passages.quote: \noindent 1. Nehaj $\mo$ bude multiplikacijsko prsten, to jest prsten bez děliteljev nula i s jediničnym elementom, v ktorom vsaky ideal, različny od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala, jednoznačno može byti prědstavjen kako produkt stepenjev prostyh idealov, i kde ti prosty idealy ne imajut vlastnogo dělitelja, različnogo od jediničnogo ideala.\footnote{K aksiomatice multiplikacijskyh prstenov srav. \emph{Idealtheorie}, napr. uvod.} Nehaj dalje $\Omega,K,\mO,\mT$ budut oprěděljene kako v §7, 1; togda v $\mT$ imaje město tam ukazana teorija idealov.\footnote{\emph{Idealtheorie}, §3, 2 i §7, 3.}

\noindent Osoblivo, ako multiplikacijsko prsten $\mo$ imaje samo jedin prosty ideal, različny od nulovogo i jediničnogo ideala, togda $\mo$ jest prsten glavnyh idealov. Zato že ako izberemo element $p$, čij glavny ideal jest dělimy točno prvoju stepenju togo prostogo ideala, togda $p$ sam poraždaje tot prosty ideal; iz prědstavjenja v obliku produkta stepenjev togda slěduje, že i vsi ostali idealy sut glavne idealy.

original_reasons.text: Uses the established generate/erzeugen verb family. Interslavic `poraždaje` remains the logged algebraic-generation choice.

historical_form: p sam poraždaje tot prosty ideal

title: jedine koeficienty pri t v |tE-C|
isv: Koeficienty pri $t$ jest zabilěžena fraza, izbrana blizko ruskoj i ukrajinskoj upotrěbě. Vse tri jezyčne razloga insistuju na množinskom tvrdženju o koeficientah determinanta $|tE-C|$. Německo einzelnen znači oddělne koeficienty, ne jedinstveny koeficient; slovo jedine v kandidatu ne treba čitati kak tvrdženje o unikalnosti. Izvorni polja s jezyčnymi imenami sodržuju anglijske razloge, ne citaty na tyh jezykah.
en: Koeficienty pri $t$ is the recorded phrase, chosen close to Russian and Ukrainian usage. All three language-specific rationales insist on a plural statement about the coefficients of $|tE-C|$. German einzelnen refers to the individual coefficients, not a unique coefficient; jedine in the proposal must not be read as a uniqueness claim. The source fields labelled by language contain English rationales, not quotations in those languages.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the statement formulaic and transparent; 'koeficienty pri t' is intentionally close to Ukrainian/Russian mathematical usage.
Uses 'при t' in the usual coefficient-of-variable idiom and preserves the scan-restored fact that all such coefficients are class invariants.
Uses the standard Russian coefficient idiom 'при t' and keeps the plural statement from the scan witness.

title: jedini?ny klas
isv: Jediničny klas prodolžuje imena klasov iz oddělov 3 i 5 v formulah (22)–(24). Razlog povezuje jego s jediniceju jednoj komponentnoj podgrupy. On ne opravdaje zaměnu imenika klas slovom element bez očuvanja kvocientnoj struktury. Cěla ruska i ukrajinska grafija i jedna čest medžuslovjanskoj formy ne sut zachovane; slovnična rekonstrukcija to naznačaje.
en: Jediničny klas continues the class terminology of Sections 3 and 5 in formulas (22)–(24). The rationale relates it to the unit of a constituent subgroup. It does not justify replacing class by element without retaining the quotient structure. The Russian and Ukrainian lettering and part of the Interslavic spelling have not survived; the dictionary makes this explicit.

original_reasons.text: The class corresponding to the unit of a constituent subgroup is central in formulas (22)-(24). The existing unit-class term is preserved to maintain continuity with Sections 3 and 5.

title: jedinica iz [Omega]
isv: Jedinica iz [Omega] povezuje naziv jedinicy s označenoju oblastju. Ediny zachovany razlog govori, gde izraz jest potrěbny: v definicijah V′ i VIII′ i v zaoštrjenom pomoćnom teoremu. On ne dava sravnjenje leksičnyh alternativ ani samostatnu definiciju jedinicy. Oznaka [Omega] ostavaje tako, kako jest zapisana; iz samej zaglavnoj formy ne možno ustanoviti njezin izvorni tipografski oblik.
en: Jedinica iz [Omega] relates the unit term to a designated domain. The sole preserved rationale says where the expression is needed: Definitions V′ and VIII′ and the sharpened auxiliary theorem. It supplies neither a comparison of lexical alternatives nor a separate definition of unit. [Omega] remains as recorded; the headword alone does not determine its original typography.

original_reasons.text: Needed for Definition V', Definition VIII', and the sharpened auxiliary theorem.

title: jedinice
isv: Jedinice jest kratko nazvanje obrativyh elementov, postavjeno v kontrast s nulovymi děliteljami. Razlog izrično dava toj kratkoj formě prednost prěd dolgom frazoju obrativne elementy. To jest argument za ekonomiju nazvanja pri sohranjenu smyslu, ne izključjenje možnosti objasniti termin pri prvom pojavjenju. Jedinica ne znači v tom množinskom kontekstu samo jediničny element $1$.
en: Jedinice is the short name for invertible elements, contrasted with zero divisors. The rationale expressly prefers it to the longer invertible-elements phrase. This is an argument for economy without loss of sense, not against explaining the term at first occurrence. In this plural context, unit does not mean only the identity element $1$.

original_reasons.text: Chosen over a longer 'invertible elements' phrase because Noether contrasts units directly with zero divisors here.

title: jedinice grupy ostatkov / ra?unanje s jedinicami
source: Einheiten der Restgruppe / Rechnen mit Einheiten
isv: Jedinice grupy ostatkov ovde imenovaju izbrane klasy, ktore v računju razkladov imaju idempotentnu, projekciji podobnu funkciju. Izvorni razlog ne poistovjetnjaje jih s libovoljnymi obrativymi elementami, i zato sovrěmenno značenje unit ne treba vnesti avtomatično. Bukvy ruskoj i ukrajinskoj frazy sut utratjene, a čest medžuslovjanskoj grafije jest povrědžena. Funkcija opisana v razlogu ne rekonstruuje te bukvy.
en: Jedinice grupy ostatkov here names selected classes with an idempotent, projector-like role in decomposition calculations. The rationale does not identify them with arbitrary invertible elements, so the modern sense of unit must not be imported automatically. The Russian and Ukrainian lettering is lost, and part of the Interslavic spelling is damaged. The function described in the rationale does not reconstruct those letters.

original_reasons.text: Section 5 treats selected residue classes as idempotent unit-like projectors for decompositions. The targets keep unit terminology rather than replacing it by generic identity elements, because the objects are decomposition units inside the residue group calculus.

title: jedinična matrica
isv: Jedinična matrica svęzuje matričny zapis s jediničnym operatorom, ale ostavaje imenikovoj frazoj za matricu. Razlog daje prednost poznavajemoj osnově matric- prěd novym užšim tvorjenjem. On ne govori, že operator i njegova matrica jesut jeden i toj samy objekt nezavisno od izbora prědstavjenja. Paralelne ruske i ukrajinske formy podpiraju oblik nazvanja.
en: Jedinična matrica connects the matrix expression with the identity operator but remains a noun phrase naming a matrix. The rationale favours the recognizable matric- family over a narrower new coinage. It does not identify an operator and its matrix as the same object independently of a representation. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support the form of the name.

original_reasons.text: The matrix term must align with the operator term but remain a matrix noun phrase. Interslavic 'matrica' is the obvious cross-Slavic/international form and avoids inventing a narrower coinage.

title: jediničny element
isv: Jediničny element imenuje konkretno multiplicativno jedinstvo, od ktorogo addicijeju i odčitanjem tvorjat se cěle veličiny prostogo polja v danoj konstrukciji. Dva razloga povezuju frazu v rabotah 9 i 10. Oni ne tvrdžu, že samo addicija i odčitanje davajut vse elementy vsakogo prostogo polja; ne treba razširiti iztočno tvrdženje zamenjanjem cělyh veličin cělym poljem.
en: Jediničny element names the particular multiplicative identity from which the whole quantities of the prime field are generated by addition and subtraction in the construction. Two rationales connect its use in Papers 9 and 10. They do not assert that addition and subtraction alone generate every element of every prime field; the source claim must not be enlarged by replacing its whole quantities with the entire field.

original_reasons.text: A literal unit-element term is needed because the whole quantities of the prime field are generated from the unit by addition/subtraction.
Same prime-field construction vocabulary as Paper 09 Section 10.

title: jediničny element e / modulna baza
isv: Jediničny element $e$ i modulna baza ostavaju dva odvojene algebraične nazvanja. Razlog izrično odlišaje element od jediničnogo ideala, iako oba imajut osnovu jediničn-. Ruska paralela imaje базис, a ukrajinska база; takva razlika ne čini dva različne matematične objekty. Identifikator $e$ služi točnomu odkazivanju, ne novomu prěvodnomu nazvanju.
en: Jediničny element $e$ and modulna baza remain separate algebraic names. The rationale expressly distinguishes the element from the unit ideal although both use the jediničn- stem. Russian has базис while Ukrainian has база; this lexical difference does not produce different mathematical objects. The identifier $e$ provides precise reference, not a new translated name.

original_reasons.text: Keeps `identity element` distinct from `unit ideal`; both use the one/unit root, but the nouns separate the algebraic objects. Russian keeps `базис` in the module-basis phrase, consistent with prior Russian lane usage.

title: jediničny ideal
isv: Jediničny ideal prodolžuje ranějšu familiju jedinica i jediničny. Tri razloga naglašaju doslědnost idealnoj terminologije i razlikovanje ideala od elementa. Točny imenik jest suščestvenny: jedin ideal moglo by značiti samo čislo idealov, a jediničny element jest drugi objekt. Kakvu jediničnu funkciju ideal ima v danej teoriji, treba ustanoviti iz definicije i operacije, ne samo iz pridevnika.
en: Jediničny ideal continues the earlier jedinica/jediničny family. Three rationales emphasize consistent ideal terminology and the distinction between ideal and element. The noun matters: one ideal might merely count ideals, while identity element denotes a different object. Which identity role the ideal has in the theory must be established from its definition and operation, not from the adjective alone.

original_reasons.text: A literal unit/identity-ideal term is stable across the Slavic lanes and matches earlier ideal-theory usage.
Matches earlier Interslavic `jedinica/jediničny` unit vocabulary and keeps the identity-object meaning clearer than a generic 'one ideal'.
Continues the unit-ideal term already used in §6 no.1's footnote. The adjective matches `jediničny element`, but the log explicitly separates element and ideal to prevent later conflation.

title: jediničny ideal / jediničny element
isv: Para jediničny ideal i jediničny element zachovuje obšču osnovu za jedinstvo, ale imenik razděljuje tipy objektov. Izvorni razlog odlišaje ih takože od obyčnyh jedinic, to jest obrativyh elementov v odgovarjajučem kontekstu. Slovnična povezanost ne daje prava utožniti ideal, njegov element i množenstvenu grupu jedinic.
en: The pair jediničny ideal and jediničny element retains a common unity stem while the nouns distinguish object types. The rationale also separates them from ordinary units, meaning invertible elements in the relevant context. Lexical relatedness does not license identifying an ideal, one of its elements, and a group of units.

original_reasons.text: The paired adjective keeps the identity ideal distinct from ordinary units while matching Noether's unity language.

title: jediničny ideal / nulovy ideal / \frako kako jediničny ideal
russian: единичный идеал / нулевой идеал / \frako как единичный идеал
ukrainian: одиничний ідеал / нульовий ідеал / \frako як одиничний ідеал
isv: Jediničny ideal i nulovy ideal ne směšajut se, iako simboličny zapis možet čitatelju vspomněti nulu. Razlog odkazuje na definiciju iz odděla 1 raboty 24 i odvojeno spominanje nulovogo ideala v primětce odděla 4. Makro imenuje tipografsku oznaku; smysl ideala mora slědovati definiciji, ne vněšnej podobnosti znakov. Tuto jest konkretna notacijna opasnost, ne nova definicija nuly.
en: Jediničny ideal and nulovy ideal must not be conflated, even if a symbol visually suggests zero. The rationale refers to Paper 24's Section 1 definition and a separate mention of the zero ideal in the Section 4 footnote. The macro names a typographical symbol; the ideal's meaning must follow the definition, not a resemblance between characters. This is a specific notational hazard, not a new definition of zero.

original_reasons.text: Paper24 explicitly defines \frako as the unit ideal in § 1. Section 4's footnote separately mentions the zero ideal, so these two must not collapse.

title: jediničny ideal \mo / jediničny element / jediničny klas
russian: единичный идеал \mo / единичный элемент / единичный класс
ukrainian: одиничний ідеал \mo / одиничний елемент / одиничний клас
isv: Jediničny ideal, jediničny element i jediničny klas moraju ostati tri odvojene izraza. Oba razloga iz odděla 7 govorju, že ideal vseh elementov može obstajati i pri otsutnosti multiplicativnogo jediničnogo elementa v prstenu, dokolě odgovarjajuče polje klasov ima jediničny klas. Zato ne možno iz slova jediničny ideal samo po sobě zaključiti, že prsten imaje $1$. Tuta lokalna avtorska konvencija trěbuje osobno objasnjenje.
en: Jediničny ideal, jediničny element and jediničny klas must remain three distinct expressions. Both Section 7 rationales say that the ideal of all elements can exist even when the ring has no multiplicative identity element, while the associated field of classes has an identity class. Unit ideal alone therefore does not justify assuming that the ring has $1$. The author's local convention needs explicit explanation.

comparisons.title_isv: Jediničny ideal ne prědpoklada vsegda jediničny element
comparisons.title_en: A unit ideal need not presuppose an identity element
comparisons.text: Podnožna primětka raboty 30, odděla 7, izrično nazva $\mathfrak{o}$ idealom vseh elementov i dopušča, že v prstenu ne ima jediničnogo elementa, iako polje klasov ostatkov ima jediničny klas. Rabota 24, odděl 1, takože definira $\mathfrak{o}$ kako ideal vseh elementov. Primětka raboty 19, odděla 6, dodava drugo ograničenje: $\mathfrak{D}$ igra jediničnu rolu pri děliteljnosti i najmenšem občem kratnom, ne pri tvorjenju produkta. To sut različne konkretne upotrěby tojže familije slov. Prěvod ne smije vnesti sovrěmenny predpoklad, že vsak prsten ili modul iz teksta už jest zadany s jedinicoju i jediničnym dějstvom. Pasaže podpiraju razloge v TERM-0433–0435; ne dokazujut avtomatično smysl vsakego drugogo pojavjenja jedinica.
comparisons.english: The footnote in Paper 30, section 7 expressly calls $\mathfrak{o}$ the ideal of all elements and allows the ring to lack an identity element even though the residue-class field has an identity class. Paper 24, section 1 also defines $\mathfrak{o}$ as the ideal of all elements. Paper 19, section 6 adds a different restriction: $\mathfrak{D}$ has an identity role for divisibility and least common multiple, not for ideal multiplication. These are distinct contextual uses of the same word family. Translation must not import a modern assumption that every ring or module in the text already comes with an identity and a unital action. The passages substantiate the reasons in TERM-0433–0435, not automatically every other occurrence of jedinica.

passages.quote: igra rolu jedinice samo v odnosu k dělimosti i najmenšemu občemu mnogokratnomu, ne v odnosu k tvorjenju produkta.
$\frako$ vsegda označaje jediničny ideal sostoječi se iz vsih elementov.
ne trěba egzistovati jediničny element, hoti po 1 v prstenu klasov ostatkov egzistuje jediničny klas.

original_reasons.text: Section 7 explicitly warns that the unit ideal can exist as the ideal of all elements even when the ring lacks an identity element; the three terms must stay separate.
The section 7 footnote explicitly says the unit ideal can exist as the ideal of all elements even when R has no identity element, while the quotient field has an identity class.

title: jediničny ideal D
isv: Jediničny ideal $D$ ima v toj primětce omeženu jediničnu funkciju: pri děliteljnosti i pri najmenšem občem kratnom, ne avtomatično pri produktu idealov. Dva zapisa zachovuju jedin razlog s tym izričnym ograničenjem. Skračenje do prosto jedinica bez operacije moglo by proměniti matematično tvrdženje. Latinična oznaka $D$ ne jest nova leksična čest termina.
en: Jediničny ideal $D$ has a restricted identity role in the cited footnote: for divisibility and least common multiple, not automatically for ideal multiplication. Two records preserve one rationale with that explicit limitation. Shortening this to unit without naming the operation could change the mathematical claim. The identifier $D$ is not a new lexical part of the term.

original_reasons.text: Section06 footnote explicitly warns that D acts as a unit only for divisibility and least common multiple, not for ideal product formation. The translations therefore avoid implying a full multiplicative identity ideal.

title: jediničny klas / jedinica
isv: Jediničny klas jest klas, ktory sodrži $1$, i v toj konstrukciji jest označeny $e$. Jedinica imenuje jego funkciju, klas jego status. Razlog naglašaje, že oba aspekty sut potrěbne v oddělu 3 za popis cěloj grupy ostatkov. To ne jest dozvoljenje utožniti predstavitelja $1$ s njegovoju klasoju bez ukazanja prěhoda k klasam.
en: Jediničny klas is the class containing $1$, denoted $e$ in this construction. Jedinica names its role and klas its status. The rationale stresses that both aspects matter to Section 3's account of the entire residue group. This does not license identifying the representative $1$ with its class without acknowledging the passage to classes.

original_reasons.text: The residue class containing 1 acts as the unit class e. The wording keeps both class status and unit role visible because Section 3 uses it to range through the whole residue group.

title: jediničny modul
isv: Jediničny modul imenuje vtory dopustimy dělitelj v lokalnoj definiciji Primmodul. Razlog prodolžuje terminologiju jediničnogo klasa, no ostavjaje modul izričnym tipom objekta. Iz samej frazy ne slěduje sovrěmenna definicija prostogo ili prime modula bez čitanja iztočnogo uslovja o děliteljah.
en: Jediničny modul names the second permitted divisor in the local definition of Primmodul. The rationale continues the unit-class vocabulary while keeping module explicit as the object type. The phrase alone does not supply a modern definition of simple or prime module without reading the source's divisor condition.

original_reasons.text: The unit module is the second allowed divisor in the Primmodul definition. This preserves continuity with the earlier unit-class vocabulary while keeping module status explicit.

title: jediničny operator
isv: Jediničny operator imenuje dějstvo, ne samo element prstena. Razlog naglašaje razklad, pri ktorom toj samy jediničny element dějstvuje kako identičnost na jednom sumandu i kako nula na drugom. Avtomatično poistovjetnjenje jedinicy prstena s identičnym operatorom na cělom modulu by izbrisalo toj slučaj. Prěvod mora zachovati razliku medžu elementom i jego dějstvom.
en: Jediničny operator names an action, not merely a ring element. The rationale emphasizes a decomposition in which the same ring identity acts as identity on one summand and as zero on the other. Automatically identifying the ring's identity element with the identity operator on the entire module would erase that case. The translation must retain the distinction between an element and its action.

comparisons.title_isv: Element prstena i njegovo dějstvo na modulu
comparisons.title_en: A ring element and its action on a module
comparisons.text: Rabota 34, odděl 17, počinaje s modulom nad prstenom s jedinicoju, ale ne prědpoklada, že ta jedinica dějstvuje identično na cělom modulu. Ona razklada modul na $\mathfrak{M}_e+\mathfrak{M}_0$ s pomoču $m=em+(m-em)$. Na prvoj česti $e$ jest jediničny operator, na vtoroj nulovy. Tekst potom ograničuje razmatranje prědstavjenij na prvu čest, kde jedinici odgovarjaje jedinična matrica. Ta izrična poslědovatelnost pokazuje, začto element, operator i matrica ne mogut byti zaměnjene jednim neoprěděljenym nazvanjem jedinica.
comparisons.english: Paper 34, section 17 begins with a module over a ring with identity, without assuming that the identity acts identically on the whole module. It decomposes the module as $\mathfrak{M}_e+\mathfrak{M}_0$ using $m=em+(m-em)$. On the first part $e$ is the identity operator; on the second it is zero. The text then restricts its representation discussion to the first part, where the ring identity corresponds to the identity matrix. This explicit sequence explains why element, operator and matrix cannot be replaced by one undifferentiated unity term.

passages.quote: $\mo$ prsten s jedinico
\mM=\mM_e+\mM_0
jedinica jest jediničny operator
m=em+(m-em).
suma $\mM_e+\mM_0$ jest direktna.
jediničnomu elementu prirědžuje se jedinična matrica.

original_reasons.text: All lanes preserve the operator-level notion rather than collapsing it into the ring element. This is essential in the first decomposition, where the same ring unit acts as identity on one summand and as zero on the other.

title: jednačenja "bez afekta"
isv: Izraz bez afekta označaje historijnu klasu jednačenij. On ne jest tiho zaměnjen slovom nerazložime: v argumentu teorem Hilberta o nerazložimosti služi za prěhod od prostogo parametričnogo jednačenja k toj klasě. Prěvod zachovuje razliku medžu nazvanjem i mehanizmom dokaza.
en: Without affect is retained as a historical class designation. It is not silently replaced by irreducible: Hilbert's irreducibility theorem supplies the mechanism connecting the simple parametric equation to that class. The wording distinguishes the designation from the proof mechanism.

original_reasons.text: Kept as a visibly historical Hilbert-era term. It is not silently replaced by irreducible equations, because Noether immediately invokes Hilbert's irreducibility theorem as the mechanism moving from the simple parametric equation to this historical class.

title: Jednako nazvanje pri upučenju v slědujuči paragraf
isv: Zapis čuva svez konca §5 s naslovom i dokazom §6, ne novu različnu matematičnu rěč. §5 obeščaje prostějšu konstrukciju pomoču racionalnoj bazy; §6 pod tym samym nazvanjem davaje definiciju i konstrukciju. Pri rěšenju užito jest kontinuitet upučenja: zaměna sinonimom samo v jednom iz tih měst mogla by stvoriti vtis novego objekta. Arhivny znak prěd čislom 6 ne jest zachovany dostatočno za ego samostojnu rekonstrukciju, ale směr upučenja jest čitliv iz sosednyh odstavkov i naslova. To jest izložiteljska konvencija, ktora potrěbuje prověrjenje oboju koncev upučenja, ne novu slovničnu jedinicu.
en: The record preserves the connection between the end of §5 and the heading and argument of §6, rather than introducing a distinct mathematical word. Section 5 promises a simpler construction using a rational basis; §6 supplies its definition and construction under that same name. Referential continuity governs the choice: replacing the term with a synonym at only one endpoint could suggest a new object. The archival character before the numeral 6 is not sufficiently preserved to reconstruct on its own, but the destination is readable from the adjoining paragraphs and heading. This is an expository convention requiring both ends of the reference to be checked, not a new lexical item.

comparisons.text: Upučenje i naslov upotrěbljajut isto nazvanje za objavljenu konstrukciju.
comparisons.english: The forward reference and heading use the same name for the promised construction.

passages.quote: $\mathfrak M(\mathfrak G)$, kogda $\mathfrak S$ proběgaje vse tako ograničene
sistemy. Struktura sistemov $\mathfrak S$ pokaže se prostěje v slědujučem
paragrafu pomoču «racionalnoj bazy»; tym jednočasno bude dostata polna analogija
s teoremami iz \S\ 4.
\section*{\S\ 6. Najobčejše oblasti iz cělyh transcendentnyh čisel pri osnovanju na racionalnoj bazi.}
V analogiji s algebraičnoj bazoj racionalnu bazu trěba definirati tako:
«Sistem $\Theta$ čisel $\vartheta$ imenuje se racionalna baza vsih čisel, ako

original_reasons.text: Kept literal because ?6 is announced as simplifying the construction under a rational basis; this term must match the next section heading and proof.

title_en: Consistent naming across a forward reference

title: Jednako: protivopostavjenje
isv: Jednako ima slovničny smysl ‘however, yet’ i stojí v gramatike medžu protivnymi spojkami. Dvadeset dva však pojavjenja odpovadajut dvadeseti aber, jednomu allerdings i jednomu dagegen. Izbor jednako čuva protivopostavjenje, ale ne dokazuje, že vsi ti německe izrazy vsigdá sut sinonimy. Však jest legitimna nacionalna forma, ne zato izbrana medžuslovjanska forma. Jednaky, jednakost i jednakovo imajut druge funkcii; podobnost korenja ne opravdava njih zaměnu so spojkoju.
en: Jednako has dictionary sense ‘however, yet’ and is listed as a contrastive conjunction in the grammar. The twenty-two však occurrences correspond to twenty aber, one allerdings and one dagegen. Selecting jednako preserves contrast but does not establish that these German expressions are always interchangeable. Však is a legitimate national-language form without thereby becoming the selected Interslavic form. Jednaky, jednakost and jednakovo have other functions; a shared root does not justify replacing them with the conjunction.
sources_isv: Slovnik, zaglavje 8296; Jan van Steenbergen, Gramatika: spojky.
sources_en: Dictionary entries 8296; Grammar: Conjunctions

evidence.finding: Jednako has dictionary sense ‘however, yet’ and is listed as a contrastive conjunction in the grammar. The twenty-two však occurrences correspond to twenty aber, one allerdings and one dagegen. Selecting jednako preserves contrast but does not establish that these German expressions are always interchangeable. Však is a legitimate national-language form without thereby becoming the selected Interslavic form. Jednaky, jednakost and jednakovo have other functions; a shared root does not justify replacing them with the conjunction.

title: jednakogo vida
source: von gleichem Typ / von gleicher Art in Section10 divisors
isv: Jednakogo vida naměrno povtarja raněje oprěděljenu relaciju, svjazanu s izomorfizmom; ne znači proste podobje zapisa. V Teoremu IX bytje prinajmenje dvuh takyh prostyh modulov jest kriterij beskonečno mnogyh razloženj, pri uslovju beskonečno mnogyh konstant i ostalyh ukazanyh hipotezah. Soglasovanje nazvy medžu paragrafami činji zavisimost dokaza vidlivoju. Ono ne dopušča opustiti te hipotezy ili zaměniti izomorfnost bukvalnoju jednakostju modulov.
en: Jednakogo vida deliberately repeats the previously defined relation linked to isomorphism; it does not mean mere similarity of notation. In Theorem IX the presence of at least two such simple modules is a criterion for infinitely many decompositions, assuming infinitely many constants and the other stated hypotheses. Consistency of the name across sections makes the proof's dependence visible. It permits neither removal of those hypotheses nor replacement of isomorphism by literal equality of modules.

comparisons.title_en: The same relation in a decomposition criterion
comparisons.text: Beskonečno mnogo konstant ostaje hipotezoju.
comparisons.english: Infinitely many constants remains an assumption.

passages.quote: Iz tu dokazanyh relacij jednakogo vida nyně slěduje (ponovno bez teorema konečnosti) izomorfija \(\mathfrak A_\sigma\) i \(\mathfrak B_\rho\). Izomorfija medžu \(\mathfrak B_\rho\) i \(\mathfrak B_\tau\) nahodi se odtud kompozicijom; za to ješče dajemo formuly. Položimo
\textbf{Teorem IX.}\footnote{Sravni \foreign{Loewy}, s. 106--107.} \textit{Ako modul \(\mathfrak M\) jest polno reducibilny i jest najmenše obče mnogokratno prostyh modulov \(\mathfrak P_1,
\ldots,

\mathfrak P_k\), ktore tvoret totalno vzajemno prostu sistemu, i ako oblast racionalnosti \(P\) sodrživaje beskonečno mnogo konstant, togda potrěbno i dostatočno uslovje za to, že \(\mathfrak M\) jest prědstavimy na beskonečno mnogo različnyh sposobov kako najmenše obče mnogokratno prostyh modulov, jest to, že prinajmenje dva iz modulov \(\mathfrak P_1,
\ldots,
\mathfrak P_k\) sut jednakogo vida.}
\textbf{Pomočny teorem.}\footnote{Sravni \foreign{Loewy}, s. 96.} \textit{Ako polno reducibilny modul \(\mathfrak M=[\mathfrak P_1,
\ldots,
\mathfrak P_k]\) jest dělitelny čerez prosty modul \(\mathfrak P'\), različny od vsih \(\mathfrak P_i\), togda prinajmenje dva iz \(\mathfrak P_i\) sut jednakogo vida.}

original_reasons.text: Theorem IX/X reuse the Section09 same-kind relation for simple modules/divisors. The term is deliberately carried forward unchanged so the reader sees the dependency on the preceding equivalence/isomorphism criterion.

title: jednakogo vida
isv: Jednakogo vida shranjaje Loewyjovu i Blumbergovu nazvu relacije, vměsto toho, aby byla od početka zaměnjena izomorfizmom. Definicija potrěbuje dva polinomy $P$ i $Q$ s uslovjami vzajemnoj prostosti i kongruencijami (25)–(28). Teorem VI teprve dokazuje ravnocěnnost s izomorfizmom grup ostatkov. Zato odrěđene nazvy morajut ostati razděljene: ih neposrědno sliti značilo by skryti matematičny sodržaj teorema. Historijna ograda o jezyčnoj formě ostaje.
en: Jednakogo vida retains Loewy's and Blumberg's name for the relation instead of replacing it with isomorphism from the outset. The definition requires polynomials $P$ and $Q$ satisfying coprimeness conditions and congruences (25)–(28). Theorem VI then proves equivalence with isomorphism of the residue groups. The names must therefore remain distinct: merging them immediately would hide the mathematical content of the theorem. The recorded linguistic reservation remains.

comparisons.title_en: The definition and the isomorphism theorem
comparisons.text: Zaměna nazvy izbrisala by tvrđenje o ravnocěnnosti.
comparisons.english: Replacing the name would erase the equivalence being asserted.

passages.quote: V tutom paragrafu pokazujemo, že pojem ``jednakogo vida'', znany pri diferencialnyh izrazah jednoj prěměnnoj, ako jest smyslno obobčen, vodi k izomorfiji naležečih grup ostatkov.

\textbf{Definicija.}\footnote{Za diferencialne izrazy jednoj prěměnnoj sravni formalnu definiciju Blumberga, na označenom městu, s. 25.} \textit{Dva modula \(\mM\) i \(\mN\) nazyvajut se modulami jednakogo vida, ako obstavajut dva polinomy \(P\) i \(Q\), pri čem \(P\) jest vzajemno prosty s \(\mM\), a \(Q\) vzajemno prosty s \(\mN\), tako že za vsako \(M\equiv0(\mM)\) i \(N\equiv0(\mN)\)}
MQ&\equiv0(\mN),\tag{25}\\
NP&\equiv0(\mM)\tag{26}
\textit{imaje město. Vzajemna prostost tu znači obstavanje dvoh polinomov \(X\) i \(Y\), tako že}
YQ&\equiv1(\mN),\tag{27}\\
XP&\equiv1(\mM)\tag{28}
\textit{imaje město.}
\textbf{Teorem VI.} \textit{Dva modula sut togda i samo togda jednakogo vida, kogda jih grupy ostatkov sut izomorfne.}

original_reasons.text: Section09 formalizes Loewy/Blumberg same-kind language by existence of polynomials P and Q satisfying the module coprimeness and relations (25)--(28), then proves equivalence with residue-group isomorphism. The target wording remains visibly same-kind/type rather than replacing it by isomorphism, because Theorem VI is exactly the bridge between the two concepts.

title: Jednaky tekst v samostojnoj i zbirnoj formě
title_en: The same text in separate and collected form
isv: Samostojna statja i zbirna kniga morajut davati jednaku prěkladanu frazu i formulu. Zapis odkril, že odvojeny tekst Paper 2, §11, ne byl točno toj tekst, ktory stajal v zbirnoj knigě. To ne jest novy termin ili nova matematična odluka: potrěbno bylo sjediniti dvě predstavy istego teksta, bez vračanja starějšeho prěklada. Povtorimost zato zahtěvaje sravnenje samogo teksta, ne toliko jednakogo nazvanja dokumenta.
en: The separate article and collected volume must give the same translated sentence and formula. The record found that the separate text of Paper 2, §11 was not exactly the text used in the collection. This is neither a new term nor another mathematical decision: the two representations of the same text needed reconciliation without reinstating an older translation. Reproducibility therefore requires comparison of the text itself, not merely matching document titles.

sources_en: Paper 2, §11; comparison of separate and collected texts

title: Jedno izdanje, ne směs dvuh redakcij
title_en: One edition, not a mixture of two redactions
isv: Paper 45 měl četyri svjazane odlomky pozdnějšej redakcije pod bibliografičnym nazvanjem statje iz Math. Annalen 97 (1927), 559–567. Izbor izvora dotyka teoremy II, lemmy II, dodatka o Bertini, eksponenta specializacije i teoremy IV s dokazami. Zaměniti toliko formulu (3) stvorilo by tretju, nesviděčenu směs. Arhivna odluka takože predlagala $xK_2/xK_3$ i $q^{(i)}$ vměsto tiskanych čitanij: to sut redakcijne emendacije, ne věrny doslovny prěpis. Poslědnja ima protivno tiskano sviděteljstvo $q_i$; bez nove kolacije ne směje byti predstavljena kako nesporna. Diplomatično izdanje i korigovano izdanje morajut byti razdělene.
en: Paper 45 contained four connected passages from a later redaction under the bibliographic identity of the article in Math. Annalen 97 (1927), 559–567. Choosing a witness affects Theorem II, Lemma II, the Bertini addition, the specialization exponent and Theorem IV with their proofs. The archived decision also proposed $xK_2/xK_3$ and $q^{(i)}$ against printed readings: these are editorial emendations, not diplomatic transcription. The latter has adverse printed evidence $q_i$ and must not be presented as settled without renewed collation. Diplomatic and corrected editions must remain distinct.
