title: jedno- i dvojnokratna svijanja
isv: Jedno- i dvojnokratna svijanja zachovuje dva točne čisla operacij v kratkoj paralelnoj konstrukciji. Prva čest s crticoju deli svoje poslednje nazvanje so vtoroju. Izvorni razlog daje prednost takvoj kompaktnosti i slovjanskoj prozračnosti, ale ne daje rezultat sravniteljnogo ispitovanja publiky.
en: Jedno- i dvojnokratna svijanja retains two exact operation counts in a compact parallel construction. The hyphenated first component shares the following name with the second. The reason favours compactness and Slavic transparency but supplies no comparative audience-test result.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the operation count explicit and compact. Interslavic uses a hyphenated Slavic-style compound pattern that remains readable across Slavic audiences.

title: jedno-jednozna?ny / jedno-jednozna?no prir??enje
isv: Izvorni razlog trěbuje injektivnost i obrativnost prirědženja medžu sistemami klasov ostatkov. Dvojno jedno- imaje odlišiti to od prostej jedinstvenosti. Medžuslovjansky zapis ima utratjene bukvy, a ruske i ukrajinske formy ne sut zachovane čitatelno. Razlog smyslovogo razlikovanja ostavaje dostupny, ale iz njega ne možno izmysliti točne historijne grafije.
en: The rationale requires injectivity and reversibility of the assignment between residue-class systems. Doubled jedno- is intended to distinguish this from simple uniqueness. Letters are missing in the Interslavic wording, and the Russian and Ukrainian forms have not survived legibly. The semantic reason remains recoverable, but it cannot establish the exact historical spellings.

original_reasons.text: The proof needs injectivity and reversibility of the assignment between residue-class systems. Interslavic uses the explicit doubled form to avoid confusing it with mere uniqueness.

title: jedno-jednoznačno
isv: Jedno-jednoznačno vyražaje bijektivno odgovaranje medžu prinaležečimi prostymi objektami i največšimi primarnymi normovymi faktorami. Dvojna forma naměrava učiniti odnos v obeh směrah vidimym bez dolge dodatne frazy. Zapis ne dava čislenu ocěnku ani sravnjenje s vzaimno jednoznačno. Povtorjenje jedne osnovy jest zabilěžena tvorba, ne dokaz, že ona jest obvezateljna jezyčna norma.
en: Jedno-jednoznačno expresses the bijective correspondence between the associated primes and largest primary norm factors. The doubled form is intended to make the two-way relation explicit without a long additional phrase. The record supplies neither a numerical rating nor a comparison with vzaimno jednoznačno. The repetition of a stem is a recorded formation, not evidence that it is a binding linguistic norm.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the one-to-one correspondence between associated primes and largest primary norm factors without overexplaining in prose.

title: jedno-jednoznačno / jedno-jednoznačno pridružiti
isv: Jedno-jednoznačno pridružiti govori o bijektivnom prirědženju komponentov v dvoh redukovanyh prědstavjenjah. Samo sravniti bylo by slabše tvrdženje. Dva zapisa zachovuju jedin razlog, a ruska i ukrajinska fraza vyražaju vzajemnu jednoznačnost. Razlog opravdaje nužny smysl prirědženja, ale ne dokazuje, že dvojna forma jest boljša od vseh drugyh medžuslovjanskyh konstrukcij.
en: Jedno-jednoznačno pridružiti concerns a bijective assignment of components in two reduced presentations. Merely compare would be a weaker claim. Two records preserve one rationale, and the Russian and Ukrainian phrases express mutual one-to-one correspondence. The rationale establishes the required sense of the assignment, not the superiority of the doubled form over every other Interslavic construction.

original_reasons.text: Noether states a bijective correspondence between the components in two reduced presentations. The targets keep the one-to-one force explicit instead of weakening it to a loose comparison.

title: jedno-jednoznačno i izomorfno odobraziti
isv: Jedno-jednoznačno i izomorfno odobraziti zachovuje oba německe opisy odobraženja. Razlog izrično odbacaje skračenje do sovrěmennogo izomorfne kako prsteny. Zadača jest věrno podati avtorsku formulaciju, ne ukloniti ono, što v pozdnějšej definiciji može izgledati izbytočno. O tom, kakve operacije sohranjaju se, odlučuje iztočna definicija, ne samo slovo izomorfno.
en: Jedno-jednoznačno i izomorfno odobraziti retains both German descriptions of the mapping. The rationale explicitly rejects replacing them with the modern shorthand isomorphic as rings. The purpose is to reproduce the author's formulation, not to delete what a later definition might make redundant. Which operations are preserved is determined by the source definition, not by the word izomorfno alone.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the early structural mapping language without replacing it by modern “isomorphic as rings” shorthand.

title: jedno-jednoznačno odgovarjanje
isv: Jedno-jednoznačno odgovarjanje imenuje odnos medžu děliteljami i odgovarjajučimi idealami pri prěhodu modulo prosty ideal. Razlog dava prednost izričnoj konstrukciji prěd skračenim nazvanjem. On ne nabraja alternativne kratke termine i ne dava težiny za njih. Zato slovnik objasnjaje argument za eksplicitnost, ne izmysljaje nezachovano natěkanje kandidatov.
en: Jedno-jednoznačno odgovarjanje names the correspondence between divisors and the associated ideals in passing modulo a prime ideal. The rationale prefers an explicit expression to a compressed name. It lists neither alternative short terms nor weights for them. The dictionary therefore explains the argument for explicitness without inventing a lost candidate comparison.

original_reasons.text: Used for the divisor/quotient-ideal correspondence modulo a prime ideal; the chosen wording is explicit rather than compressed.

title: jedno-jednoznačno pridruženje / izomorfny
isv: Jedno-jednoznačno pridruženje jest čestju definicije izomorfizma sistemov klasov ostatkov, v ktorej treba zachovati addiciju i dějstvo polinomov. Ne dostačaje prosto spočtati objekty na obeh stranah. Zapis naměrava prozračnu frazu, ale ostavjaje njezin idiom za sravnjenje. Takva otvorjena ocěnka ne može byti predstavljena kako potvrđeno čitatelsko prěimuščestvo.
en: Jedno-jednoznačno pridruženje belongs to a definition of isomorphism for systems of residue classes that requires preservation of addition and polynomial action. Merely counting the objects on either side is insufficient. The record aims at a transparent expression but leaves its idiom open to comparison. That provisional judgment cannot be presented as a demonstrated advantage for readers.

original_reasons.text: Noether defines isomorphism for systems of residue classes by preserving addition and polynomial action. The Interslavic phrase is intentionally transparent and reviewer-flagged.

title: Jednočasno razgledanje form
isv: Pri jednovrěmennom razsmotrenju jest uslov postupka, ne samo časovy ukazatelj. V redukcijnoj primětke trěba razgledati skupaj navedene formy i njihove razklady; ignorovanje drugoj skupiny moglo by proměniti ono, čto se reducira. Aktualna fraza pri jednočasnom razgledanju jest kračša i znači to samo. Arhiv označuje izvorno formulovanje kako potrěbujuče jezyčnu prověrku. Slovnik sohranjaje tu ogradu, ale objasnjaje dokaznu ulogu bez služebnogo jezyka.
en: Pri jednovrěmennom razsmotrenju is a condition on the procedure, not merely a time marker. In the reduction note the listed forms and their decompositions must be considered together; ignoring the second group could change what is being reduced. The current phrase pri jednočasnom razgledanju is shorter and expresses the same relation. The archive marks the earlier phrasing as needing linguistic review. The dictionary preserves that reservation while explaining the phrase's role in the argument.

comparisons.title_isv: Společny postup, ne dvě nesvezane operacije
comparisons.title_en: A joint procedure, not two unrelated operations
comparisons.text: Jednočasno razgledanje spojuje navedene formy s njihovymi razkladami.
comparisons.english: Considering the forms together connects them with their decompositions.

passages.quote: \noindent\textit{Redukcije:} Razklad $(K_l(KLu)^3,s,u)^2$, $(H_\vartheta(\theta H^2u)^3,s,u)$, $((K,H\cdot L,u)^5,s,u)$ po \S\ 3. \mbox{2)}, \mbox{c)}; t.j. pri jednočasnom razgledanju razkladnyh form $(K_l(KLu)^2,s,u)^3$, $(H_\vartheta(\theta H'u)^2,s,u)^2$, $((K,H\cdot L,u)^4,s,u)^2$.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the simultaneous-consideration condition in the final reduction note; Interslavic phrasing is review-needed but semantically clear.

title: jednoelementny / mnogočlenny bazis modula
isv: Jednoelementny i mnogočlenny imenuju čislo generatorov izbranoj modulnoj bazy. Razlog izrično odbacaje zaměnu gotovym sovrěmennym nazvanjem glavnogo modula, ibo predmetom sravnjenja jest sama baza. Imenovanje elementov ne daje dopolniteljne tvrdnje o ih linearnoj nezavisnosti. Različne osnovy element- i člen- jesut zabilěžene, ale njihov stilističny kontrast ne jest odvojeno opravdany.
en: Jednoelementny and mnogočlenny name the number of generators in the chosen module basis. The rationale explicitly rejects substituting a modern principal-module shorthand because the basis itself is under discussion. Naming its members does not add an assertion of linear independence. The different stems element- and člen- are recorded, but their stylistic contrast is not separately justified.

original_reasons.text: Section12 contrasts principal-looking one-polynomial bases with genuinely multiple-generator module bases. Element-count wording is clearer than a modern principal-module shortcut, since Noether is talking about the chosen module basis.

title: jednoformny slučaj
isv: Jednoformny slučaj jest bukvalny kandidat za lokalno uslovje, svęzano s jednoju formoju ili prostym redom. Razlog dava prednost vidimoj strukturi německogo nazvanja prěd sovrěmennoju parafrazoju, ktora mogla by skryti toj lokalny pojem. Slučaj ne jest opisan kako prosto jednoobrazny stil; konkretny matematičny smysl treba čitati iz definicije raboty.
en: Jednoformny slučaj is a literal candidate for a local condition involving one form or a simple row. The rationale prefers the visible structure of the German name to a modern paraphrase that might obscure the local concept. This is not merely a case of uniform style; its precise mathematical sense must be read from the work's definition.

original_reasons.text: Noether's one-form/simple-row case is technical but local; a transparent calque is preferable to hiding it behind a modern paraphrase.

title: Jednoj: ženska forma čislovnika jedin
title_en: Jednoj: the feminine oblique of jedin
isv: Čislovnik jedin imaje ženske oblike jedna, jednoj i jednu. Sedmdeset pet jednej pojavjenij s ženskymi objektami potrěbuje jednoj v odpovědajučem kosom padežu. To jest paradígma, ne novy korenj i ne dokaz, že německe eines samo po sobě izbiraje žensky rod: rod kontroluje medžuslovjanski imenovnik. Šest povtorjenij v samostojnyh statjah sut kopije istih izborov, ne šest nezavisnyh jezyčnyh sviděteljstv.
en: The numeral jedin has feminine forms jedna, jednoj and jednu. Seventy-five jednej occurrences with feminine referents require jednoj in the relevant oblique case. This is a paradigm, not a new root; German eines alone does not select feminine gender, which is controlled by the Interslavic noun. Six repetitions in separate articles are copies of the same decisions, not six independent linguistic attestations.
sources_isv: Slovnik, zaglavje 531; Jan van Steenbergen, Gramatika: čislovniki, jedin.
sources_en: Dictionary entries 531; Grammar: Numerals, jedin

evidence.finding: The numeral jedin has feminine forms jedna, jednoj and jednu. Seventy-five jednej occurrences with feminine referents require jednoj in the relevant oblique case. This is a paradigm, not a new root; German eines alone does not select feminine gender, which is controlled by the Interslavic noun. Six repetitions in separate articles are copies of the same decisions, not six independent linguistic attestations.

title: jednokratna transvekcija
isv: Jednokratna transvekcija stavjaje jedin korak v kontrast s blizkimi povtorjenymi ili dvojnymi redukcijami. Čislo operacij jest glavni zabilěženy razlog. On ne ustanovjaje, že vsaka redukcija jest transvekcija, ni ne opravdaje avtomatično prěvoditi vsako Überschiebung tojže imeniceju bez konteksta. Sravniteljne formy zachovuju meždunarodnu osnovu transvekc-.
en: Jednokratna transvekcija contrasts one step with nearby repeated or double reductions. Operation count is the principal recorded reason. It does not establish that every reduction is a transvection, or justify translating every Überschiebung this way regardless of context. The comparanda retain the international transvection stem.

original_reasons.text: Chosen to distinguish a single transvection step from repeated/double reductions nearby.

title: jednokratno svijanje
isv: Jednokratno svijanje zachovuje čislo operacij: svijanje izvršaje se jedin raz. Razlog prodolžuje tu kratku frazu iz ranějših oddělov. Jednokratno ne znači prosto neponovimo događanje; v dokazě jest važno, kolikokrat operacija priměnjaje se. Zapis ne sravnjava jeho s drugym historijnym oblikom jednorazovo.
en: Jednokratno svijanje retains the operation count: folding is performed once. The rationale continues the short phrase from earlier sections. Jednokratno does not simply describe a unique event; the number of applications matters to the proof. The record does not compare it with the other historical form jednorazovo.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the operation count visible and continues the established single-folding phrase from earlier sections.

title: Jednolike formy i kontekstne izključki
isv: V redakciji byli izbrany takože (vměsto takodže), togda (tada), trěba (treba), nehaj (neka v postavjenjah), ješče (jošče), už (uže), tu (tut), ponovno (znovu), poręd- (porjad-), libovoljny (matematično proizvoljny) i možno (možno jest/jest možno). To ne sut jedinnadset jednakovyh pravopisnyh popravok. Už i uže stojat v jednom slovničnom zaglavju, a tu i tut imajut odvojene zaglavja: kratše formy sut prednosti redakcije, ne zabrana drugih form. Pri nehaj trěba razlikovati postavjenje od něktory, ktory izražaje neoprěděljenost. Libovoljny ima slovnične značenja optional i arbitrary, no tip 3 i směšany jazykovy profil; proizvoljny takože jest zaglavje. Izbor v matematičnom smislu ne daje pravo nazvati libovoljny opće priznatym ili najbolje razumljivym. Možno jest kratka bezosobna konstrukcija, ne novo slovo. Čislo 1433 v zapisu opisuje obseg intervencije, ne rezultat vagovanja. Nynějšny osnovny pravopis može pisati pored- vměsto etymologičnogo poręd-.
en: The edition selected takože (for takodže), togda (tada), trěba (treba), nehaj (neka in stipulations), ješče (jošče), už (uže), tu (tut), ponovno (znovu), poręd- (porjad-), libovoljny (mathematical proizvoljny), and možno (možno jest/jest možno). These are not eleven equivalent spelling corrections. Už and uže share a dictionary entry, while tu and tut have separate entries: the shorter forms are editorial preferences, not prohibitions on the alternatives. Nehaj requires a distinction between stipulation and the indefinite něktory. Libovoljny is glossed optional and arbitrary but has type 3 and a mixed language profile; proizvoljny is also a headword. The mathematical preference therefore cannot be described as universally established or demonstrably best understood. Možno is a shorter impersonal construction, not a newly coined word. The recorded total of 1,433 describes the intervention's extent, not a weighting result. Present basic orthography may write pored- instead of etymological poręd-.
sources_isv: Slovnik, zaglavja 1716, 2120, 13042, 9558, 1076, 114, 1758, 15606, 5961, 3145, 22300, 22318, 926; razlikovanje nehaj/něktory: odgovarjajuče zaglavje niže.
sources_en: Dictionary entries 1716, 2120, 13042, 9558, 1076, 114, 1758, 15606, 5961, 3145, 22300, 22318, 926; see the separate entry on nehaj/něktory.

evidence.finding: Dictionary admits už/uže and tu/tut; libovoljny is type 3, not an unqualified pan-Slavic winner.

title: jednorazovo svijanje
isv: Jednorazovo svijanje vyražaje isto čislo operacij, ktoro v drugom zapisu imenuje jednokratno svijanje. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela takože izrično govorju o jednom priměnjenju. Razlog naglašaje kontinuitet vyraženja, ale ne dava razlog za prednost osnovy -raz- prěd -krat-. Tute zapisy zato dokumentuju formnu variaciju, ne dva razne matematične postupky.
en: Jednorazovo svijanje expresses the same operation count named elsewhere by jednokratno svijanje. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda also explicitly denote one application. The rationale stresses continuity of wording but gives no reason to prefer the -raz- stem over -krat-. These records document formal variation, not two different mathematical procedures.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the count modifier explicit in all lanes; Interslavic follows the same jednorazovo/svijanje lane used in previous folding sections.

title: jednorazovy prěnos
isv: Jednorazovy prěnos jest drugy historijny kandidat za Überschiebung. Razlog imenuje jeho prozračnym, ale izrično ostavjaje izbor otvorjenym do sravnjenja s terminologijeju teorije invariantov. Takva napomena ne jest dokaz, že prěnos už byl potvrđeny autoritetnym iztočnikom. Razlika od transvekcija v TERM-0444 potrěbuje kontekstualno i terminologično sravnjenje, ne tihu zaměnu istorije izbora.
en: Jednorazovy prěnos is another historical candidate for Überschiebung. The rationale calls it transparent but expressly leaves the choice open pending comparison with invariant-theory terminology. That reservation is not evidence that an authoritative source had already confirmed prěnos. Its relationship to transvekcija in TERM-0444 requires contextual and terminological comparison, not silent rewriting of the choice's history.

original_reasons.text: Carries the existing transvection-like Überschiebung lane. Interslavic prěnos is transparent but should be checked against any authority-preferred invariant-theory term.

title: jednoredna matrica
isv: Jednoredna matrica imenuje matricu s jednim redom. Razlog daje toj kratkoj tvorbě prednost prěd težšim meždunarodnym vyraženjem, ale ne zachovuje jeho točnu formu. Jednoredna ne znači matrica ranga jedan: čislo redov i rang sut različne informaciji. Kratkost izbora zato ne smije izbrisati konkretnu dimenzionalnu kvalifikaciju.
en: Jednoredna matrica names a matrix with one row. The reason prefers this compact formation to a heavier international expression, but does not preserve the alternative's exact wording. One-row does not mean rank-one matrix: row count and rank are different information. The choice's brevity must not erase that specific size qualification.

original_reasons.text: Uses ordinary row-matrix vocabulary; Interslavic chooses transparent jednoredna rather than a heavier international phrase.

title: jednostavne idealy
isv: Jednostavne idealy jest naměrny izbor za Noetherino uslovje, že ideal ne ima vlastnogo dělitelja v danom smyslu. Proste idealy už imenuju prime idealy, i dva razloga izrično trěbuju izběgnuti to směšenje. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela izbiraju elementarny, ne prosty. To pokazuje konkretnu strategiju razlikovanja smyslov, ne obšče izključjenje slova prosty iz vseh nazvanj prostyh algebraičnyh struktur.
en: Jednostavne idealy deliberately names Noether's condition that an ideal have no proper divisor in the specified sense. Proste idealy is already used for prime ideals, and both rationales expressly seek to avoid that conflation. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda choose elementary rather than simple. This is a context-specific strategy for separating senses, not a general exclusion of prosty from all names of simple algebraic structures.

original_reasons.text: Avoids collapsing Noether's simple/no-proper-divisor condition into the already occupied prime-ideal term.
Avoids confusing Noether's no-proper-divisor condition with prime ideals, which are already прості/простые/proste idealy.

title: jednostranne / dvustranne idealy
isv: Jednostranne i dvustranne idealy prodolžuju terminologiju nekomutativnyh uslovij iz ranějših rabot. Strana govori o množenju, ne o prostorovoj formě ideala. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela tak samo zachovuju kontrast jednoj i dvoh stran. Kratky razlog ne dava nove definicije, ale trěbuje ne izgubiti tu informaciju pri prěvodu.
en: Jednostranne and dvustranne idealy continue the terminology of noncommutative side conditions from earlier works. Side concerns multiplication, not an ideal's spatial shape. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda likewise preserve the one-sided/two-sided contrast. The short rationale adds no new definition but requires that the information survive translation.

original_reasons.text: Carries forward the noncommutative side-condition vocabulary from Paper17/Paper19.

title: jednostranne moduly
isv: Jednostranne moduly jesut objekty zatvorjene pri množenju s jednoj strany v smyslu odděla 3. Izvorni razlog izrično zabrana poistovjetniti jih s obyčnymi dvustrannymi idealami. Imenik modul i pridevnik jednostranny zato oba nosat matematično sodržanje. Obšče nazvanje ideal bez kvalifikacije izgubilo by upotrěbjenu strukturnu razliku.
en: Jednostranne moduly are objects closed under multiplication on one side in the sense of Section 3. The rationale explicitly rejects collapsing them into ordinary two-sided ideals. Both modul and jednostranny therefore carry mathematical content. An unqualified ideal label would lose the structural distinction used in the passage.

original_reasons.text: Section 3 distinguishes modules closed under multiplication on only one side. The target terms keep the side-condition explicit and avoid collapsing the object into ordinary two-sided ideals.

title: jednostranno prosty ideal
isv: Jednostranno prosty ideal zachovuje i prostost, i stranu idealnogo uslovja. Razlog povezuje izraz s prěhodom od idempotentov k razščepljenju v teoriji prědstavjenij. Izpustiti jednostranno moglo by pretvoriti uslovje o lěvyh ili pravyh idealah v uslovje o dvustrannyh idealah. Dve kvalifikacije imajut različne funkcije i ne zaměnjaju jedna drugu.
en: Jednostranno prosty ideal retains both simplicity and the side on which the ideal condition applies. The rationale connects it with the passage from idempotents to splitting in representation theory. Omitting jednostranno could turn a left- or right-ideal condition into a two-sided-ideal condition. The two qualifications have different functions and cannot replace one another.

original_reasons.text: Keeps the left/right one-sided ideal mechanism explicit; this is the representation-theoretic bridge from idempotents to splitting.

title: jednozna?no opred?ljeno preslikanje / obratno jednozna?no
isv: Zapis razlikuje dobro oprěděljeno odobraženje od obratno jednoznačnogo odobraženja. Po razlogu, dokaz najprvo konstruuje odobraženja medžu grupami ostatkov, a potom osobno dokazuje obrativnost s pomoču konečnoj modulnoj bazy. Izraz vzaimno jednoznačno zato ne treba prědnesti v ranějši krok. Několike bukvy medžuslovjanskoj formy sut utratjene; tablica ih ne rekonstruuje po domyslu. Opis odobraženij kako podobnyh surjektivnym ne jest dokaz surjektivnosti.
en: The record distinguishes a well-defined mapping from an invertibly one-to-one mapping. Its rationale says that the proof first constructs maps between residue groups, then separately proves invertibility using a finite module basis. Bijective terminology must therefore not be introduced into the earlier step. Several letters of the Interslavic form are lost; the table does not reconstruct them by conjecture. The rationale's description of the maps as surjective-looking is not evidence of surjectivity.

original_reasons.text: The proof first constructs well-defined surjective-looking maps Phi and Psi between residue groups, then separately proves invertible one-to-one behavior by contradiction using the finite module basis of the system S. The translations therefore distinguish well-defined/unambiguous from bijective/invertibly one-to-one.

title: jednoznačna sootvětnost / jednoznačnost
isv: Jednoznačna sootvětnost imenuje jednoznačno zadano odgovaranje prěd dokazom injektivnosti. Razlog zato izrično odbacaje prědrěmenny prěvod slovom izomorfizm. Jednoznačnost rezultata za danu vhodnu veličinu sama ne znači, že različnym vhodam odgovarjaju različne izhody. Ruska i ukrajinska paralela podpiraju to razlikovanje; zapis ne razsudžaje leksičnu prednost sootvětnost prěd odgovaranje.
en: Jednoznačna sootvětnost names a single-valued assignment before injectivity has been proved. The rationale therefore explicitly rejects prematurely calling it an isomorphism. A unique output for each input does not itself imply different outputs for different inputs. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda support that distinction; the record does not settle a lexical preference for sootvětnost over odgovaranje.

original_reasons.text: Preserves Noether’s one-valuedness before injectivity is proved; not collapsed into isomorphism too early.

title: jednoznačno byti predstavjen
isv: Jednoznačno byti predstavjen zachovuje dva obvezateljne elementy: predstavjenje postoji i jest jedinstveno v smyslu danogo tvrdženja. Razlog izbira obšču osnovu predstav- takože za slědujuče produktne i razkladne vyraženja. Takva svęz medžu izrazami ne dava prava vynechati množenje, additivnost ili druge uslovja tam, kde iztočnik ih ustanovjaje. Ruska i ukrajinska sravnjenja vyražaju jedinstveny sposob, ne prosto jasnost opisa.
en: Jednoznačno byti predstavjen retains two necessary elements: a representation exists and is unique in the sense of the particular statement. The rationale chooses the predstav- family for use also in subsequent product and decomposition expressions. This lexical continuity does not license omitting multiplication, additivity, or other qualifications where the source specifies them. The Russian and Ukrainian comparanda express a unique manner of representation, not simply clarity of description.

original_reasons.text: Preserves the uniqueness force of `eindeutig` while leaving room for later product/decomposition statements to use the same `representation` family.

title: jednoznačno oprěděljene / mnogoznačnost
isv: Jednoznačno oprěděljene i mnogoznačnost razděljujut dva slučaja v teoremu XIII: izolovane komponenty sut jedinstveno oprěděljene, a nejednoznačnost ostavaje pri neizolovanyh komponentah. Slučaje ne možno zameniti slabšim tvrdženjem, že komponenty možno izbrati. Dva zapisa zachovuju jedin razlog. Mnogoznačnost tuta govori o nejedinstvenosti razklada, ne o mnogoznačnom slově ili o nejasnosti dokaza.
en: Jednoznačno oprěděljene and mnogoznačnost separate two cases in Theorem XIII: isolated components are uniquely determined, while nonuniqueness is confined to non-isolated components. This cannot be weakened to saying that components can be chosen. Two records preserve one rationale. Here mnogoznačnost concerns nonuniqueness of a decomposition, not a word with several senses or an unclear proof.

original_reasons.text: Theorem XIII separates the uniquely determined isolated components from ambiguity confined to non-isolated components. The target wording uses direct uniqueness/ambiguity terms, not a looser “can be chosen” formulation.

title: jednoznačno produktno predstavjenje črez nerazložime polinomy oblasti
source: eindeutige Produktdarstellung durch irreduzible Polynome des Bereichs
russian: однозначное произведенное представление через неприводимые полиномы области
ukrainian: єдине добуткове подання через незвідні поліноми області
isv: Produktno predstavjenje zachovuje množenje nerazložimyh polinomov oblasti kako izričny predmet tvrdženja. Razlog povezuje frazu s vtorym priměrom i s teorijeju eliminacije; skračenje do razklada moglo by poměšati razklad polinoma na faktory s razkladom ideala. Jednoznačnost ne daje bez dodatnyh uslovij doslovnu ravnost vsakoj zapisanoj listy faktorov. Pravila o poredku ili jedinicah moraju izhoditi iz matematičnogo teksta, ne iz samogo slovničnogo nazvanja.
en: Produktno predstavjenje keeps multiplication of irreducible polynomials in the domain as the explicit subject of the statement. The rationale links the phrase to the second example and elimination theory; shortening it to decomposition could conflate polynomial factorization with ideal decomposition. Uniqueness does not, without further qualifications, mean literal equality of every written list of factors. Conventions about order or units must come from the mathematical text, not from the dictionary label alone.

original_reasons.text: This phrase is the algebraic obstruction driving the second example and the equivalence with elimination theory. Product representation is kept explicit so it does not collapse into ideal decomposition terminology.

title: jednoznačno razloženje
isv: Jednoznačno razloženje jest izbrano v kontekstu zakonov razklada na faktory. Razlog izrično govori, že ti zakony mogut ne važiti v $J$. Slovnična oznaka zato ne može proměniti negativno ili uslovno tvrdženje v obšče tvrdženje o jedinstvenoj faktorizaciji. Německo Zerlegbarkeit imenuje svojstvo možnosti razklada, kdežto razloženje može imenovati i rezultat; točna rečenica mora zachovati razlikovanje.
en: Jednoznačno razloženje is chosen in the context of factorization laws. The rationale explicitly says that these laws may fail in $J$. The dictionary label must therefore not turn a negative or conditional statement into a general assertion of unique factorization. German Zerlegbarkeit names a property of decomposability, whereas razloženje can also name the resulting decomposition; the surrounding sentence must preserve the distinction.

original_reasons.text: Modern unique-factorization vocabulary; the text states explicitly that these laws may fail in J.

title: jednoznačno vzajemna sootvětnost
isv: Jednoznačno vzajemna sootvětnost jest zabilěžena fraza za bijektivno odgovaranje, postavjena pokraj izomorfizma prstenov klasov ostatkov. Ta dva izraza ne sut prosti sinonimi: vtory imenuje strukturno soglasje, ne samo odgovaranje množin. Razlog govori o sovrěmennom idiomu, ale ne podpiraje osobnym citatom slovo sootvětnost ni toj poredok slov.
en: Jednoznačno vzajemna sootvětnost is the recorded phrase for bijective correspondence, paired with isomorphism of residue-class rings. The expressions are not simply synonyms: the latter names structural compatibility, not just a correspondence of sets. The rationale invokes modern idiom but supplies no separate citation for sootvětnost or this word order.

original_reasons.text: Uses the modern mathematical idiom for bijective correspondence, keeping it paired with residue-class-ring isomorphism.

title: jednoznačno vzajemno ... razlika i množenje tym samym elementom
source: eineindeutig ... Differenz und Multiplikation mit demselben Element
russian: взаимно однозначно ... разность и умножение на один и тот же элемент
ukrainian: взаємно однозначно ... різниця і множення на той самий елемент
isv: Fraza zachovuje i bijektivnost, i soglasje s razlikoju i množenjem tym samym elementom. Razlog izrično dava uslovje: iz odgovaranja $\alpha\sim\beta$ slěduje $\gamma\alpha\sim\gamma\beta$. Poredok faktorov ne možno zaměniti. Bijekcija sama po sobě ne jest operatorny izomorfizm. Pozvanje na pečatny iztočnik jest historijna dokazova tvrdnja zapisa, ne nova kolacija izvršena pri pisanju togo objasnjenja.
en: The phrase preserves both bijectivity and compatibility with difference and multiplication by the same element. The rationale explicitly gives the condition: $\alpha\sim\beta$ implies $\gamma\alpha\sim\gamma\beta$. The order of the factors must not be reversed. A bijection alone is not an operator isomorphism. The appeal to the printed witness is the record's historical evidential claim, not a fresh collation performed for this explanation.

original_reasons.text: Restores the scan witness's operator-isomorphism condition, including the explicit multiplication compatibility alpha~beta implies gamma alpha~gamma beta.

title: jednoznačnost
isv: Jednoznačnost prědavava jedinstvenost objektov $R$ i $S$, ktora jest cěljom dokaza. Rusky i ukrajinsky izraz davajut imena jedinstvenosti, a medžuslovjansky izbor pokračuje ranějšu skupinu jednoznačno. Dva zapisa zachovuju jedin razlog. Česte pojavjenje slova v korpusu ne dokazuje, že vsako pojavjenje ima točno toj smysl; jedinstvenost objektov treba razlikovati od jednoznačnosti značenja funkcije.
en: Jednoznačnost conveys the uniqueness of the objects $R$ and $S$ that the proof seeks to establish. The Russian and Ukrainian forms name uniqueness, while the Interslavic choice continues the existing jednoznačno family. Two records preserve one rationale. Frequent occurrence in the corpus does not show that every occurrence has this precise sense; uniqueness of objects must be distinguished from single-valuedness of a function.

original_reasons.text: The proof is a uniqueness proof for R and S; Ukrainian/Russian use modern theorem-prose wording, while Interslavic uses the already productive `jednoznačno` family.

title: jednoznačny additivny razklad grupy ostatkov
isv: Jednoznačny additivny razklad imenuje jedinstveny zapis vsakoj klasy ostatkov kak summy iz dvoh komponentnyh sistemov. Razlog privezuje izraz k formuli (11) i naglašaje, že množenje klasov bylo izključeno v oddělu 3. Additivny jest zato matematično suščestvenny, ne izbytočny pridevnik. Fraza ne tvrdži jedinstvenost vsakoj vozmožnoj razkladnoj struktury grupy; ona ostavaje svęzana s danoj formuloju.
en: Jednoznačny additivny razklad names the unique expression of each residue class as a sum from the two component systems. The rationale connects the wording with formula (11) and stresses that multiplication of residue classes was excluded in Section 3. Additive is therefore mathematically substantive, not a redundant adjective. The phrase does not assert uniqueness of every possible decomposition structure of the group; it remains tied to the stated formula.

original_reasons.text: Formula (11) is a unique additive decomposition of each residue class into the two component systems. The wording stays additive to avoid suggesting multiplication of residue classes, which Section 3 excluded.

title: Ješče
isv: Ješče bylo izbrano vměsto paralelnogo još, kogda kontekst ne dava razliku smysla. Slovnik povezuje ješče s vostočnymi i zapadnymi formami, ale takože s južnymi še, još, jošte, ušte i ošte. Etymologična srodnost ne znači bukvalnu grafičnu jednakost. Arhiv govori o pozitivnoj ocěnkě vsih jazykov, no sam profil ima približne ocenky dlja slovenskogo i srbskogo; to ograničenje trěba sohraniti. Upotrěba jednogo zaglavja jest redakcijna konvencija, ne dokaz, že vsak čitatelj bez usilja razlikuje vse smysly still, yet i even.
en: Ješče was preferred to parallel još where the context supplied no difference in meaning. The dictionary relates ješče to East and West Slavic forms but also to southern še, još, jošte, ušte and ošte. Etymological kinship does not mean literal identity of spelling. The archive speaks of positive assessments for every language, but the profile itself marks Slovene and Serbian only approximately; that qualification must be retained. Using one headword is an editorial convention, not proof that every reader effortlessly distinguishes all the senses still, yet and even.
sources_isv: Medžuslovjansky slovnik, zaglavje 1076.
sources_en: Interslavic Dictionary, entry 1076.

evidence.finding: Slovene and Serbian carry approximate ~ marks, not uniformly positive + marks.

title: Ješče i ide
isv: Ješče znači still/even/yet, a ide jest tretje lice jedinstvenogo čisla idti. Dvadeset sedm ještě i 29 jde/idé form v zapisě davajut eti slovnične obliky. Češske jde jest pravilno v češskom; ono ne jest izbrana medžuslovjanska forma. Ide o v matematičnoj prozě znači ‘reč jest o’, ne obyčno fizično idenje. Ješče može označati trajanje, dodatok ili usiljenje; konkretny obseg ne směje byti izravnen do jednogo ‘still’. Izbor slovničnogo oblika čuva tu kontekstnu polisemiju.
en: Ješče means still/even/yet, while ide is third-person singular idti. Twenty-seven ještě occurrences and 29 jde/idé forms yield those dictionary forms. Czech jde is correct Czech, but not the selected Interslavic form. Mathematical ide o means concerns/is about rather than ordinarily denoting physical motion. Ješče may express continuation, addition or emphasis; its contextual scope must not be flattened into a single still. Selecting the dictionary form preserves that contextual polysemy.

sources_en: Dictionary entries 1076, 2104; Grammar, Verbs, idti.

Ješče may express continuation, addition or emphasis; its contextual scope must not be flattened into a single still. Selecting the dictionary form preserves that contextual polysemy.

title: jest algebraično cěla nad
isv: Algebraično cěla nad vyražaje odnos integralnosti v argumentu o konečnosti. Prědlog nad čini osnovu odnosa izričnoju i odliča tuto od obyčnoj algebraičnoj zavisimosti. Forma cěla jest kontekstna ženska forma, ne druga definicija integralnosti.
en: The phrase expresses integrality over a base in the finiteness argument. Nad makes the base relation explicit rather than suggesting ordinary algebraic dependence. Cěla is the contextual feminine form, not a different definition of integrality.

original_reasons.text: Rendered as 'integral over' in running prose, because this is the mathematical relation Noether uses in the finiteness argument.

title: jest algebraično cěla nad T
isv: Nad T dava sučasno algebraično vyraženje odnosa integralnosti. Avtorsko vyraženje zavisimosti ostavaje objasnjeno v věte, tako da terminologično osuvrěmenjenje ne izbriše obsah iztočnogo uslovja.
en: Nad T gives the modern algebraic expression of integrality. The explanatory sentence preserves the author's dependence formulation, so terminological modernization does not erase the source condition.

original_reasons.text: Uses current commutative-algebra phrasing “integral over T” while preserving Noether’s dependence wording in the explanatory sentence.

title: jest algebraično cěly nad
isv: Německo vyraženje zavisimosti jest tumačeno kako byti integralnym nad osnovoju. Izbor izběgaje směšenje s obyčnoju algebraičnoju zavisimostju ili nezavisimostju. Tuto jest izrično terminologično osuvrěmenjenje, ktoro mora ostati svazano s iztočnym uslovjem.
en: The German dependence wording is interpreted as being integral over a base. The reason is to avoid confusion with ordinary algebraic dependence or independence. This is an explicit terminological modernization that must remain tied to the source condition.

original_reasons.text: Modernizes the dependence wording as integral over; avoids confusion with ordinary algebraic dependence/independence.

title: jest algebraično cěly nad
source: algebraisch ganz von ... abhängt / algebraisch-ganz abhängig
isv: Izraz prodolžuje čitanje integralno nad iz odděla 10. Obě německe formulacije dostavajut isti odnos, ale ne slivajut se s opčim pojmom algebraičnoj zavisimosti. Razlog jest semantična razlika i doslědnost susědnyh oddělov.
en: The expression continues the integral-over interpretation of Section 10. Both German formulations denote that relation without being merged into ordinary algebraic dependence. Semantic distinction and continuity between sections motivate the choice.

original_reasons.text: Continues the Section 10 modern integral-over reading and avoids confusion with ordinary algebraic dependence.

title: jest dělimy kvadratom prostogo ideala
source: durch das Quadrat eines Primideals teilbar
isv: Jest dělimy kvadratom prostogo ideala nastavlja formulaciju o děliteljnosti na kvadrat iz odděla 7. Kvadrat i prosty ideal ostavajut izrične, da by specialny slučaj ostal svazany s kriterijem vlastno primarnoj komponenty. Prosta děliteljnost idealom ne vyražaje tuto silnějše uslovje.
en: Jest dělimy kvadratom prostogo ideala continues section 7's square-divisibility formulation. Square and prime ideal remain explicit so that the specialization stays connected to the properly primary component criterion. Divisibility by the ideal alone would express a weaker condition.

original_reasons.text: Echoes section 7's Dedekind-style square-divisibility formulation and keeps the specialization visibly aligned with the proper-primary-component criterion.

title: jest ispolnjen diskriminantny teorem (§7, 3)
isv: Jest ispolnjen diskriminantny teorem (§7, 3) zachovuje izrično pozvanje na opreděljany rezultat. Smysl jest upotrěba ranějšego teorema, ne njegovo novo prěformulovanje. Pridavnikova forma diskriminantny teorem jest historijna alternativa konstrukciji teorem o diskriminantu; sam zapis ne razrěšaje jejich stilistično sravnjenje.
en: Jest ispolnjen diskriminantny teorem (§7, 3) preserves the explicit reference to a particular result. The point is to invoke an earlier theorem, not restate it. Adjectival diskriminantny teorem is a historical alternative to teorem o diskriminantu; this record alone does not settle their stylistic comparison.

original_reasons.text: Keeps theorem-reference language direct and avoids rephrasing the theorem itself.

title: Jezyk bibliografije ne zavisi od jezyka knigy
title_en: Bibliographic language need not match the book's language
isv: The Madison Colloquium 1913 čuva anglijsko nazvanje, Neue Begründung der algebraischen Zahlentheorie německo. R. Hölzer i W. Krull sut imena, Zürich i Göttingen města. Dvadset takyh izrazov čuva se v originalnoj formě zato, že ih funkcija jest identifikacija, ne objašnjenje matematiky. Slovjansko objašnjenje možno dodati oddělno, ale ne vměsto originalnogo nazvanja.
en: The Madison Colloquium 1913 retains its English title and Neue Begründung der algebraischen Zahlentheorie its German title. R. Hölzer and W. Krull identify people; Zürich and Göttingen identify places. Twenty expressions retain their original forms because their function is identification, not mathematical explanation. A Slavic gloss can be supplied separately, but should not replace the original title.

title: Jih: čije objekty?
isv: Jih jest nesklanjajemo posvojno zaimeno ‘their’. Gramatika predstavlja jego, jej i jih kako najčestějše tretjelicne formy, a jihny dopuščaje kako pridavnikovu alternativu. Zapis izbiraje jih v 22 njihov- posvojenijah. Svoj ne jest zaměna: ono bi povezalo posvojitelja s subjektom frazy, čego eti konteksty po zapisě ne izražajut. Rod i čislo posědanogo objekta ne menja jih. Nacionalno njihov nije ‘loš jazyk’; rěšenje bira medžuslovjansku konstrukciju. Slovničny tip 1 podpiraje preferenciju, ale ne daje universalno pozitivnu razumljivost.
en: Jih is the indeclinable possessive their. The grammar presents jego, jej and jih as the commonest third-person forms and permits adjectival jihny as an alternative. The record selects jih for twenty-two njihov- possessives. Svoj is not interchangeable: it would identify the possessor with the clause's subject, which the recorded contexts do not express. The possessed object's gender and number do not alter jih. National njihov is not ‘bad language’; this chooses an Interslavic construction. Type 1 supports the preference but does not imply universally positive comprehension.

sources_en: Dictionary entries 2601, 6258; Grammar, Pronouns, possessives and reflexive svoj.

title: Jordan–Hölder: citovano ime teoremy
isv: Jordan–Hölder i Hilbert–Furtwängler v citovanoj formě čuvajut oba prezimena. Isto pravilo obejma nazvanja i časopisne izrazy v ostalyh petnadseti zapisanyh cělinah. Dva nestandardne znaky v jednom nazvanju ne činjut dva termina. Cěla bibliografična fraza može zahranjati godinu i stranicu; njen obseg treba določiti po čitanju, ne po čislu bukv, ktore program ne poznaje.
en: Jordan–Hölder and Hilbert–Furtwängler retain both surnames in their cited forms. The rule also covers titles and publication expressions among the fifteen recorded units. Two nonstandard letters within one title do not make two terms. A complete bibliographic expression may include its year and pages; its extent must be determined by reading, not by counting characters a program does not recognize.

title: K čemu odnosi se citacija teorema
isv: Citacija H.-N., teorem VIII, odnosi se k drugoj vrsti formule (4) v Paper 24, ne k slědujučoj prozě. Jej poměščenje jest čest smysla: čitatelj mora znati, ktoro tvrđenje podpiraje citovany rezultat. Zato citacija i jej koma stojat pri formuli, a prodolženje počinaje s malym i dalje. Samo nazvanje teorema ne bylo potrěbno prěvoditi inako. Položenje nomera formule jest oddělno tipografično pytanje.
en: The citation H.-N., theorem VIII qualifies the second row of formula (4) in Paper 24, not the following prose. Placement affects meaning: readers must know which assertion the cited result supports. The citation and its comma therefore belong with the formula, and the continuation begins with lowercase i dalje. The theorem's wording did not require a different translation. The equation number's position is a separate typographic question.
